Gao Di Street, Guangzhou, China | Sustainable design | Sep 2024 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 漂浮森林
zh-Hant.description:
在廣州最炎熱的老街區之一高第街，巷道上方的塑膠雨棚被替換為種滿植物的天篷，為街道遮蔭降溫。

中國廣州高第街｜永續設計｜2024 年 9 月｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Master plan of Gao Di Street: green shades over the lanes, green roofs and the water system.
高第街總平面：巷道上方的「綠蔭」、綠屋頂與水系。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In recent years the annual average temperature in China has risen significantly, and Guangzhou, a hot and humid city with high-intensity development, suffers a serious heat island effect. Gao Di Street in Yuexiu District is a heat island block with a strong heat load and weak heat dissipation, with plant coverage below 10 %, messy plastic awnings and a high rate of hardened ground.
captions: Background — high-temperature days in China, the average temperature from 1980 to 2023, and the heat island intensity of Guangzhou and Yuexiu District.
Site analysis — land use, plant coverage and sunshine radiation on a summer day.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 近年來中國的年平均氣溫顯著上升；廣州氣候濕熱、開發強度高，熱島效應嚴重。越秀區的高第街是一個熱負荷強、散熱弱的熱島街區，植被覆蓋率不到 10%，塑膠雨棚雜亂，硬化地面比例很高。
captions: 背景——中國的高溫日數、1980–2023 年的平均氣溫，以及廣州與越秀區的熱島強度。
基地分析——土地使用、植被覆蓋與夏日的日照輻射強度。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Existing greening methods, large green spaces, roof gardens and vertical greening, and tall trees, are hard to achieve here because of land-use conflicts, legacy historical issues and the impact on infrastructure. In the past there was a natural environment, now plastic canopies are everywhere, and in the future they could turn into a floating forest.
captions: Inspiration, vision and strategy — neighbourhood comfort, environmental issues and community identity, towards a future forest floating above the city streets.
Selection of the pilot area — the historical water system, the main commercial street and the existing green space, with one-way, double-end and T-shaped lanes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 既有的綠化方式——大面積綠地、屋頂花園與垂直綠化、種植高大樹木——在此都因用地衝突、歷史遺留問題與對基礎設施的影響而難以實現。過去這裡是自然環境，如今塑膠雨棚無所不在；未來，它們或許能化為一片漂浮的森林。
captions: 靈感、願景與策略——鄰里舒適、環境問題與社區認同，邁向一片漂浮在城市街道上方的未來森林。
試點區的選擇——歷史水系、主要商業街與既有綠地，以及單向巷、雙出口巷與 T 形巷。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A conceptual model tested how green canopies could thread through the dense blocks. Typologies combine the canopies with water features, commercial streets and open space, each in four variations.
captions: Conceptual model — green canopies threading through the blocks.
Typology — T1 with water features, T2 with commercial streets, T3 with open space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 概念模型測試了綠色天篷如何穿行於密集的街區之間。類型學把天篷分別與水景、商業街與開放空間結合，各發展出四種變化。
captions: 概念模型——穿行於街區之間的綠色天篷。
類型學——T1 結合水景、T2 結合商業街、T3 結合開放空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Each canopy is built from vegetation on a geotextile substrate over a tensioned, anti-root waterproof fabric, held by masts, cables and anchor plates, and creates light therapy, shaded seating, an activity square, a dry spray fountain and a plant landscape. A physical model experiment grew Sedum morganianum on the fabric from September 2024 to January 2025.
captions: Key node design — structure, activity and function, vegetation list and construction details.
Plant growth — from the first roots on 30 September 2024 to lush cuttings on 1 January 2025.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每座天篷由種植在土工布基材上的植物、張拉式防根防水膜，以及桅桿、鋼索與錨板組成，創造出光療、遮蔭座椅、活動廣場、旱噴泉與植物景觀。實體模型實驗自 2024 年 9 月至 2025 年 1 月，在膜上培育了玉綴（Sedum morganianum）。
captions: 關鍵節點設計——結構、活動與機能、植物清單與構造詳圖。
植物生長——從 2024 年 9 月 30 日初生的根系，到 2025 年 1 月 1 日茂盛的插枝。

sections.heading: Floating Forest - Turning Cluttered Awnings Into Green Shade Over the Lanes
sections.body: Average temperatures have climbed markedly in recent years, and a hot, humid city of intense development suffers a serious heat island effect. The old block chosen for the project carries a heavy heat load and sheds heat poorly, with plant cover below a tenth, untidy plastic awnings and a high share of hard ground. Familiar ways of greening, large green spaces, roof gardens, vertical planting and tall trees, are hard to achieve here because of land-use conflicts, inherited historical issues and the strain on infrastructure. Once there was a natural setting, now plastic canopies are everywhere, and in the future they might become a floating forest. A concept model tests how green canopies can thread through the dense blocks, and typologies pair them with water features, shopping streets and open space, each in four variations. Every canopy grows plants on a geotextile bed over a tensioned, root-proof waterproof membrane held by masts, cables and anchor plates, offering light therapy, shaded seats, an activity square, a dry fountain and planting. A physical model grew trailing succulents on the fabric over several months, showing that greenery can hang in the air and cool the lanes beneath.

zh-Hant.heading: 漂浮森林-讓雜亂雨棚化為街巷綠蔭
zh-Hant.body: 近年來年平均氣溫顯著上升，一座濕熱而高強度開發的城市，熱島效應日益嚴重。作品所在的老街區熱負荷強、散熱弱，植被覆蓋不到一成，塑膠雨棚雜亂，硬化地面比例極高。大面積綠地、屋頂花園、垂直綠化與種植高大喬木等既有綠化方式，都因用地衝突、歷史遺留問題與對基礎設施的影響而難以實現。未來，無所不在的雨棚或能化為漂浮的森林。概念模型測試綠色天篷如何穿行於密集的街廓之間，類型學則把天篷分別與水景、商業街與開放空間結合，各發展出四種變化。每座天篷由種在土工布基材上的植物、張拉式防根防水膜，以及桅桿、鋼索與錨板組成，創造出光療空間、遮蔭座椅、活動廣場、旱噴泉與植物景觀。一項歷時數月的實體模型實驗，在膜上培育出垂掛的多肉植物，為悶熱的街巷撐起一片清涼。

pins.title: Doomsday Garden
pins.description:
Six survival modules for six imagined ends of the world, from extreme cold and heat to flood, drought, nuclear war and a siege of waste.

Anthropocene, Gaia | Concept project | Oct 2023 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 末日花園
zh-Hant.description:
為六種想像中的世界末日設計六個生存模組：從極寒與酷熱，到洪水、乾旱、核戰與垃圾圍城。

人類世，蓋亞｜概念設計｜2023 年 10 月｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Extreme cold: sealed, insulated survival modules linked by wooden walkways, with ice fishing and snow activities.
極寒：密封、高隔熱的生存模組以木棧道相連，並結合冰釣與雪上活動。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project asks what the world would become if it turned into an ocean or a desert, were covered in ice or enveloped in heat, or were destroyed by nuclear war or filled with garbage. Due to environmental degradation, urban structures have collapsed and human living spaces have rapidly condensed into two basic types.
captions: Before the disaster, the disaster occurs, after the disaster — mixture expanded functional spaces (commerce, farm, amuse, working, medical) and primary residential spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案提問：如果世界變成海洋或沙漠、被冰覆蓋或被高溫籠罩，又或是毀於核戰、被垃圾填滿，它將演變成什麼模樣。由於環境惡化，城市結構崩解，人類的生活空間迅速濃縮為兩種基本類型。
captions: 災前、災變、災後——混合擴展的機能空間（商業、農業、娛樂、工作、醫療）與基本居住空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Extreme climate and resource scarcity force the reorganisation of complex multifunctional spaces. Each scenario gets a survival module that combines the primary residential spaces with the functions life needs.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 極端氣候與資源匱乏，迫使複雜的多機能空間重新組織。每一種情境都有一個生存模組，把基本居住空間與生活所需的機能結合起來。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: In extreme heat the survival module is sunken, built with heat-resistant clay and surrounded by drought-tolerant plants, with shading devices and temperature regulation. In a flood it rests on floating platforms and elevated structures, with aquatic crops, boats and a closed-loop water system, and in a drought fog collection and purification devices sit at its core, enclosed by sea buckthorn and stones.
captions: Extreme hot — the sunken module with clay walls, shading and drought-tolerant planting.
Flooding — floating platforms, aquatic crops and boating.
Drought — fog collection at the core, drought-tolerant crops, sea buckthorn and stones.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在酷熱中，生存模組下沉，以耐熱黏土建造，四周種植耐旱植物，並配置遮陽裝置與溫度調節系統。在洪水中，它立於漂浮平台與架高結構之上，以水生作物、船隻與封閉的水循環系統維生；在乾旱中，集霧與淨水裝置位於核心，四周以沙棘與石塊圍合。
captions: 酷熱——黏土牆、遮陽與耐旱植栽的下沉模組。
洪水——漂浮平台、水生作物與以船代步。
乾旱——核心的集霧裝置、耐旱作物、沙棘與石塊。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: After a nuclear war the module is compressed underground, with thick walls and radiation shielding, and its medical, sterilisation, agricultural and energy systems closely integrated. Under a waste siege it stands on an elevated platform of recycled materials, the medical area is kept apart from the living area, and waste is processed into organic fertiliser and renewable energy.
captions: Nuclear war — the underground module with radiation shielding.
Waste siege — the elevated platform of recycled materials, with separate medical areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 核戰之後，模組被壓縮到地下，以厚牆與輻射屏蔽層保護居民，醫療、消毒、農業與能源系統緊密整合。在垃圾圍城的情境中，它立於以回收材料建造的架高平台上，醫療區與居住區分開，廢棄物則被處理為有機肥料與再生能源。
captions: 核戰——設有輻射屏蔽的地下模組。
垃圾圍城——以回收材料建造的架高平台，醫療區獨立設置。

sections.heading: Doomsday Garden - Survival Modules for Six Ends of the World
sections.body: The project asks what the world would become if it turned into ocean or desert, lay under ice or burning heat, were ruined by nuclear war or buried in garbage. As the environment degrades, urban structures collapse and human living space condenses rapidly into two basic types. Extreme climate and scarce resources force complex, many-sided spaces to be reorganised, and each scenario receives a survival module that joins basic dwelling to the functions life requires. In extreme heat the module sinks into the ground, built of heat-resistant clay and ringed by drought-tolerant plants, with shading and temperature control. In a flood it rests on floating platforms and raised frames, living on aquatic crops, boats and a closed water loop, and in drought, fog collectors and purifiers sit at its core within a ring of sea buckthorn and stone. After a nuclear war it is pressed underground behind thick walls and radiation shielding. Under a siege of waste it stands on a platform of recycled material, keeping care apart from living and turning refuse into fertiliser and energy. Each module is a small garden holding on to life amid ruin.

zh-Hant.heading: 末日花園-六種世界盡頭的生存模組
zh-Hant.body: 作品提出一個問題：如果世界化為海洋或沙漠，被冰封或被酷熱籠罩，毀於核戰或被垃圾填滿，它將變成什麼模樣？環境惡化之下，城市結構崩解，人類的生活空間迅速濃縮為兩種基本類型。每一種情境都對應一個生存模組，把基本的居住空間與生活所需的機能結合在一起。在酷熱之中，模組沉入地下，以耐熱黏土建造，四周種植耐旱植物。洪水來臨時，它立於漂浮平台與架高結構上，以水生作物、船隻與封閉的水循環維生；在乾旱裡，集霧與淨水裝置位居核心，外圍以沙棘與石塊圍合。核戰之後，模組被壓縮至地下，以厚牆與輻射屏蔽守護居民。在垃圾圍城的情境中，它立於回收材料築成的高台，醫療區與居住區分隔，廢棄物則被轉化為有機肥料與再生能源。每一座模組，都是在廢墟中守住生命的一方小園。

pins.title: Resilient Urban Design of Nansha
pins.description:
Under global warming and sea-level rise, a resilient coast, tidal parks and density prototypes let a new district in Nansha adapt as the water rises.

Nansha, Guangzhou | Urban design | Graduation design, group work (individual part) | Spring term 2023–2024 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 南沙韌性城市設計
zh-Hant.description:
在全球暖化與海平面上升的背景下，以韌性海岸、潮汐公園與密度原型，讓南沙的新城區隨水位上升而調適。

廣州南沙｜城市設計｜畢業設計，小組作品（個人部分）｜2023–2024 學年春季學期｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Aerial view render: the new district on the river delta, crossed by elevated roads and laced with green, wetland and water.
鳥瞰透視：河口三角洲上的新城區，高架道路穿越其間，綠地、濕地與水網交織。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Under the dual environmental pressure of climate change and reclamation, Nansha must keep its coastal shorelines safe and cope with rainstorms, floods, typhoons, salty tides, storm surges, ocean currents and future sea-level rise. The board puts the rise at 98–188 mm by 2100, with US$1.4 trillion lost by 2100.
captions: The site in Nansha, with expressways, trunk roads, airports, harbours, train stations, the direction of tidal encroachment and typhoon attack, and the degree of sea-level-rise inundation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在氣候變遷與填海造地的雙重環境壓力下，南沙必須確保海岸線安全，並因應暴雨、洪水、颱風、鹹潮、風暴潮、洋流以及未來的海平面上升。圖面指出，到 2100 年海平面將上升 98–188 毫米，損失達 1.4 兆美元。
captions: 位於南沙的基地，標示高速公路、主幹道、機場、港口、火車站、潮水侵入與颱風來襲方向，以及海平面上升的淹沒程度。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sea-level rise superimposed on storm surges was mapped for 2030, 2050 and 2100, showing how much village and urban construction land, farmland, forest, wetland and river would be inundated. A section through industrial docks, petrochemical companies, logistics yards, the expressway, paddy fields, villages and mangrove forests sets these elements against the future water levels.
captions: Submerge Elements — the 2030, 2050 and 2100 scenarios and the section against the 2024 to 2100 water levels.
Storm surge disasters, swell channel, surface subsidence, the waterfowl ecological corridor and current land use.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案繪製 2030、2050 與 2100 年海平面上升疊加風暴潮的情境，顯示村莊與城市建設用地、農地、林地、濕地與河流將被淹沒的比例。一道剖面穿過工業碼頭、石化企業、物流園區、高速公路、稻田、村莊與紅樹林，將這些要素與未來水位並置比較。
captions: 淹沒要素——2030、2050 與 2100 年情境，以及對照 2024 至 2100 年水位的剖面。
風暴潮災害、湧浪通道、地表沉降、水鳥生態廊道與現況土地使用。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Problems in agriculture, traffic, the river system and development control lead to a strategy of a resilient coast, a sustainable community, flexible transport and competitive industries around live, work and ecology. Along the sea coast, river shores and creek banks, prototypes such as offshore reefs, mangrove wetlands, green slopes, plank roads and water streets form a tidal park system.
captions: Problem consideration, structural prototypes and the four strategies.
Marine resilience and ecological protection — three steps from sea coast to river shores and creek banks.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 從農業、交通、水系與開發管制的問題出發，本案圍繞生活、工作與生態，提出韌性海岸、永續社區、彈性交通與競爭力產業四項策略。沿著海岸、河岸與溪岸，離岸礁石、紅樹林濕地、綠坡、棧道與水街等原型共同組成潮汐公園系統。
captions: 問題思考、結構原型與四項策略。
海洋韌性與生態保護——從海岸、河岸到溪岸的三個步驟。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Residential, service, commercial and industrial units each have a FAR range and low-, medium- and high-density prototypes, which are then placed across the district under intensity guidelines. A timeline shows how land use changes as sea levels rise, from 2030 and 2050 to 2100 and beyond.
captions: Four prototypes of creative units, each in low, medium and high density.
Development intensity guidelines, dominated function units and overall intensity control.
Land use changes as sea levels rise: 2030, 2050, 2100 and the further future.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 居住、服務、商業與工業單元各有容積率範圍，以及低、中、高密度的原型，再依開發強度準則配置於整個城區。一條時間軸呈現土地使用如何隨海平面上升而改變，從 2030、2050 年到 2100 年及更遠的未來。
captions: 四類創意單元原型，各有低、中、高密度版本。
開發強度準則、主導機能單元與整體強度管控。
土地使用隨海平面上升的變化：2030、2050、2100 年與更遠的未來。

sections.heading: Tidal Resilience - A Reclaimed District Planning Its Future by the Sea Level
sections.body: Under the twin pressures of climate change and land reclamation, a coastal new district must keep its shoreline safe against rainstorms, floods, typhoons, salty tides, storm surges, currents and future sea-level rise. Sea-level rise combined with storm surge is mapped for three future years, showing how much village and urban land, farmland, forest, wetland and river would go under. A section through industrial docks, petrochemical plants, logistics yards, the expressway, paddy fields, villages and mangroves sets each element against the water to come. Problems in agriculture, traffic, the river system and development control lead to four strategies around living, working and ecology: a resilient coast, a sustainable community, flexible transport and competitive industry. Along the sea coast, river shores and creek banks, prototypes such as offshore reefs, mangrove wetlands, green slopes, boardwalks and water streets form a tidal park system. Residential, service, commercial and industrial units each carry a range of density and low, medium and high prototypes placed under intensity guidelines, and a timeline shows land use shifting as the water rises.

zh-Hant.heading: 潮汐韌性-讓填海新城隨海平面調整未來
zh-Hant.body: 在氣候變遷與填海造地的雙重壓力下，一片濱海新區必須守住海岸線的安全，並承受暴雨、洪水、颱風、鹹潮、風暴潮、洋流與未來海平面上升的考驗。研究繪製三個年份海平面上升疊加風暴潮的情境，顯示村莊與城市建設用地、農地、林地、濕地與河流將被淹沒的比例。一道剖面穿過工業碼頭、稻田、村莊與紅樹林，把這些要素並置於未來的水位之前。從農業、交通、水系與開發管制的問題出發，策略圍繞生活、工作與生態，提出韌性海岸、永續社區、彈性交通與具競爭力的產業。沿著海岸、河岸與溪岸，離岸礁石、紅樹林濕地、綠坡、棧道與水街等原型，共同組成潮汐公園系統。各類單元依密度原型與強度準則配置於全區。一條時間軸則呈現土地使用如何隨水位上升而逐步改變，讓城市學會與潮汐共處。

pins.title: Retrieving Folklore
pins.description:
Under the guidance of community co-construction, an elevated walkway and a chain of small public spaces turn Chaji village into a culture and business experience area.

Chaji Village, Foshan | Urban design | Urban Design 1, individual work | Spring term 2022–2023 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 重拾民俗
zh-Hant.description:
在社區共建的引導下，以一條高架步道與一連串小型公共空間，將茶基村轉化為文化與商業體驗區。

佛山茶基村｜城市設計｜城市設計一，個人作品｜2022–2023 學年春季學期｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Physical model: the village on both banks of the river, with a winding elevated walkway linking the middle school, the village and the commercial district.
實體模型：河道兩岸的村落，一條蜿蜒的高架步道串連中學、村落與商業區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Although Chaji village has experienced the modern gentrification of urbanization, local residents still stick to it, where the strong street smoke infuses everyone who passes by. The old street is also the base of the village's prosperity, so the transformation must balance the original residents, modern commercial activities and the conservation and dissemination of local traditional culture.
captions: Four paths through the village, thirteen cultural arches, and what a boy, a lady, an old lady and a girl said about the place.
Location and massing of the village and its river.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 雖然茶基村經歷了城市化帶來的現代士紳化，在地居民仍堅守於此，濃厚的街頭煙火氣感染著每一位路過的人。老街也是村落繁榮的根基，因此改造必須在原住居民、現代商業活動，以及在地傳統文化的保存與傳播之間取得平衡。
captions: 穿越村落的四條路徑、十三處文化節點，以及一位男孩、一位女士、一位老婦人與一位女孩對這個地方的看法。
村落與河道的區位與量體。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Chaji village has a wealth of traditional folk activities, such as dragon boats, martial arts lions and Cantonese opera, and every Dragon Boat Festival people crowd the narrow lanes to watch the “floating dragon boat” make a rapid turn. The interviews list both the problems, such as narrow roads, local population loss and a lack of retail, and the strengths, such as a prosperous clan, a spacious riverside and rich folk activities.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 茶基村擁有豐富的傳統民俗活動，例如龍舟、武術醒獅與粵劇；每年端午節，人們擠滿狹窄的巷弄，觀看「趴龍舟」急速轉彎。訪談同時列出問題，例如道路狹窄、本地人口流失與零售不足，也列出優勢，例如宗族興旺、河岸開闊與民俗活動豐富。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A combination of culture and business experience area under the guidance of community co-construction rests on people's participation, business vitality and cultural revival. Three steps prepare the canvas with small-scale greenery and DIY parks, sketch the traffic by adding lanes, replanning parking and removing cars, and work on textures by readapting existing structures and adding urban furniture.
captions: People's participation, business vitality and cultural revival, and Steps 1–3: environment, traffic and buildings.
Benign growth and organic renewal: the plan, with the commercial district, the tea plantation and four layers of services, access, greenery and community.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在社區共建引導下的文化與商業體驗區，以居民參與、商業活力與文化復興為基礎。三個步驟依序以小尺度綠化與 DIY 公園準備畫布，以增設步道、重新規劃停車與移除車輛梳理交通，再以改造既有建築與增設街道家具處理紋理。
captions: 居民參與、商業活力與文化復興，以及步驟一至三：環境、交通與建築。
良性生長與有機更新：總平面，含商業區、茶園，以及服務、可達性、綠地與社區四個層次。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A winding elevated walkway threads an intangible cultural heritage base, a dragon boat pavilion, a music hall, an outdoor stage, a lion dance club, a commercial street, a teahouse and homestays along the river. Green spots, a green corridor and a green district, widened streets, enriched outdoor space and revitalized blocks then open a chain of public spaces from a viewing plaza to a mobile market.
captions: Rendering explosion diagram of the programmes along the walkway.
Activities render: dragon boats, the walkway and daily life along the river.
Plane generation, dwelling renovation and the public open spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一條蜿蜒的高架步道沿河串連非物質文化遺產基地、龍舟亭、音樂廳、戶外舞台、醒獅館、商業街、茶館與民宿。綠點、綠廊與綠區，加上拓寬的街道、豐富的戶外空間與活化的街區，開展出從觀景廣場到流動市集的一連串公共空間。
captions: 沿步道配置的各項機能之爆炸透視圖。
活動渲染圖：龍舟、步道與河岸的日常生活。
平面生成、民居改造與公共開放空間。

sections.heading: Retrieving Folklore - An Elevated Walk Linking Dragon Boats and Street Life
sections.body: A village has lived through the gentrification that urbanisation brings, yet its residents hold on, and the thick smoke and bustle of its street touch everyone who passes. The old street is also the root of the village's prosperity, so any change must balance original residents, modern commerce, and the keeping and sharing of traditional culture. The village is rich in folk activity, dragon boats, martial lion dance and local opera, and every Dragon Boat Festival crowds pack the narrow lanes to watch the boats make their swift turn. Interviews name problems such as narrow roads, population loss and too little retail, and strengths such as a thriving clan, a broad riverside and lively custom. Guided by community co-construction, a zone for culture and business rests on participation, commercial vitality and cultural revival. Three steps follow: small greenery and DIY parks prepare the canvas, added lanes, replanned parking and fewer cars sketch the traffic, and adapted buildings and street furniture work the texture. A winding elevated walk then threads a heritage base, a dragon boat pavilion, a music hall, a stage, a lion dance club, a teahouse and homestays along the river.

zh-Hant.heading: 重拾民俗-以高架步道串起龍舟與煙火的老街
zh-Hant.body: 一座村落雖然經歷了城市化帶來的士紳化，在地居民仍堅守於此，濃厚的街頭煙火氣感染著每一位路過的人。老街也是村落繁榮的根基，改造因此必須在原住居民、現代商業，以及傳統文化的保存與傳播之間取得平衡。村裡有豐富的民俗活動，龍舟、武術醒獅與地方戲曲；每逢端午，人們擠滿狹窄巷弄，觀看龍舟急速轉彎。在社區共建的引導下，文化與商業體驗區以居民參與、商業活力與文化復興為基礎。三個步驟依序展開：以小尺度綠化與自建公園準備畫布，梳理交通，再以改造既有建築與增設街道家具處理紋理。一條蜿蜒的高架步道沿河串連非遺基地、龍舟亭、音樂廳、戶外舞台、醒獅館、茶館與民宿，從觀景廣場到流動市集，讓民俗在日常裡重新流轉。

pins.title: Hongkong {female} ∈ London
pins.description:
Anti-homogeneity urban design based on the female perspective: a female-friendly autonomous community in London for women who have moved from Hong Kong.

London, UK | Urban design | Comprehensive Social Investigation, individual work | Spring term 2021–2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 香港 {女性} ∈ 倫敦
zh-Hant.description:
基於女性視角的反同質化城市設計：在倫敦為從香港移居的女性打造一個對女性友善的自治社區。

英國倫敦｜城市設計｜綜合社會調查，個人作品｜2021–2022 學年春季學期｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: A-A'-1 section: residential towers opened up floor by floor beside the office buildings.
A-A'-1 剖面：逐層剖開的住宅大樓，與一旁的辦公建築並列。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: With high-density development in the process of urbanization, Southeast Asian women in traditional society are facing more severe injustices, which coincides with the upsurge of Hong Kong immigrants to Britain. The project hopes to build a female-friendly regional autonomous community in London by thinking from the perspective of women.
captions: The site on the Thames, with 2.5 km and 5 km radii, residential, industrial and commercial zones, greenland and transportation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在城市化進程中的高密度開發下，傳統社會中的東南亞女性正面臨更嚴重的不公，這恰逢香港移民赴英的熱潮。本案希望從女性的視角思考，在倫敦打造一個對女性友善的區域自治社區。
captions: 泰晤士河畔的基地，標示 2.5 公里與 5 公里半徑，以及住宅、工業與商業區、綠地與交通。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The background maps the distribution of immigrants to the UK and British immigration sources, then the gender and age proportion of BN(O) arrivals, their self-assessed English level and their interest in social and cultural activities. It also records the sectors in which BN(O)s are working and aspects of their health and wellbeing.
captions: Background: distribution and sources of immigrants, gender and age, English level, activities, work sectors and wellbeing.
User analysis: a pregnant woman, an elderly woman, a new mother, a female vendor, a toddler mother and an office lady.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 背景研究繪製移民在英國的分布與移民來源，再分析 BN(O) 移民的性別與年齡比例、自評英語程度，以及對社交與文化活動的興趣。研究也記錄了 BN(O) 移民從事的行業，以及他們健康與福祉的各個面向。
captions: 背景：移民的分布與來源、性別與年齡、英語程度、活動、從業行業與福祉。
使用者分析：孕婦、年長女性、新手媽媽、女性攤販、幼兒母親與上班族女性。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each user gets a design response: emergency call buttons on street lamps at 15 m intervals for pregnant women, shaded, wheelchair-accessible seating for older women, and more space in public bathrooms for mothers and babies. A street-level space lets female vendors work apart from the road, and enclosed, separate office cubicles ensure privacy and equity at work, while the concept plan arranges commercial, office and residential bands around Olympia House.
captions: Concept design plan and the abstract spatial structure of commercial, office and residential bands.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每一類使用者都有對應的設計：為孕婦在路燈上每隔 15 公尺設置緊急呼叫按鈕，為年長女性設置有遮蔭、可供輪椅使用的座位，並在公共廁所為母親與嬰兒預留更多空間。街道層的空間讓女性攤販能遠離車道工作，獨立封閉的辦公隔間則確保工作上的隱私與平等；概念平面以奧林匹亞大樓為中心，配置商業、辦公與住宅帶。
captions: 概念設計平面，以及商業、辦公與住宅帶的抽象空間結構。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The master plan lays courtyard blocks along the river with sections A-A'-1 and A-A'-2 and three viewpoints for residence, office and commerce. The sections show the community from its opened-up towers to a festive waterfront with a ferry and fireworks.
captions: Master plan with sections A-A'-1 and A-A'-2 and viewpoints 1–3.
Activities render — viewpoint 1 residence, viewpoint 2 office, viewpoint 3 commercial.
A-A'-2 section: the waterfront at night.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 總平面沿河配置合院式街廓，並標示 A-A'-1 與 A-A'-2 剖面，以及住宅、辦公與商業三個視點。剖面呈現這個社區的樣貌：從逐層剖開的大樓，到有渡輪與煙火的節慶水岸。
captions: 總平面，標示 A-A'-1、A-A'-2 剖面與視點一至三。
活動渲染圖——視點一住宅、視點二辦公、視點三商業。
A-A'-2 剖面：夜間的水岸。

sections.heading: A Community of Welcome - A Female-Friendly Neighbourhood for Women Who Migrate
sections.body: Under the high-density development of urbanisation, women in traditional Asian societies face harsher injustice, and this coincides with a wave of migration abroad. Thinking from the perspective of women, the project hopes to build a female-friendly, self-governing community in the new home. Background research maps where migrants settle and where they come from, then the gender and age of new arrivals, their own sense of their language level and their interest in social and cultural life, along with the sectors they work in and their health and wellbeing. Each user receives a concrete response: emergency call buttons on street lamps every fifteen metres for pregnant women, shaded, wheelchair-friendly seats for older women, and more room in public toilets for mothers and babies. A street-level space lets women vendors work away from traffic, and enclosed private office cubicles secure privacy and fairness at work, while the concept plan lays commercial, office and residential bands around an existing building. The master plan sets courtyard blocks along the river with three viewpoints toward home, office and commerce, and the sections run from opened-up towers to a festive waterfront.

zh-Hant.heading: 她城之約-為移居女性打造友善的自治社區
zh-Hant.body: 在城市化的高密度開發下，傳統社會中的亞洲女性面臨更嚴峻的不公，這恰與一波向海外移民的熱潮相互交疊。作品希望從女性的視角出發，在異地打造一個對女性友善的區域自治社區。背景研究繪製移民的分布與來源，再分析新移民的性別與年齡比例、自評的語言程度，以及對社交與文化活動的興趣。每一類使用者都得到具體的設計回應：為孕婦在路燈上每隔十五公尺設置緊急呼叫按鈕，為年長女性設置有遮蔭、可供輪椅使用的座位，並在公共廁所為母親與嬰兒預留更多空間。街道層的空間讓女性攤販遠離車道工作，獨立封閉的辦公隔間則確保工作上的隱私與平等。總平面沿河排列合院式街廓，三個視點分別望向住宅、辦公與商業。剖面從逐層剖開的大樓，一路延伸到有渡輪與煙火的節慶水岸。

pins.title: URU Fairy Land
pins.description:
Fluid urbanism design based on human-body sensation: body parts are flattened into lines and rebuilt by a formula into the forms of a mobile city.

Urban design | Spring term 2019–2020 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: URU 仙境
zh-Hant.description:
基於人體感知的流動都市主義設計：將身體部位壓平為線條，再以公式重建為流動城市的形態。

城市設計｜2019–2020 學年春季學期｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Overall form: the combined body-part models joined into one fluid volume.
整體形態：由各身體部位模型組合成的流動量體。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The city is “mobile” in the sense that people's five senses are shifted by the activities and the rich religious beliefs of the student's hometown, and the impression of the city changes with them. Using the body as a starting point, the project explores the possibility of a mobile city through the spatial translation of body parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 城市是「流動的」：人的五感會隨著家鄉的各種活動與豐富的宗教信仰而轉移，對城市的印象也隨之改變。本案以身體為起點，透過身體部位的空間轉譯，探索流動城市的可能。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Step 1, Flatten, takes the brain, eye, mouth, neck, vessels, torso, hands, skin and bone one by one. Each part is drawn as four line studies that extract its form.
captions: Form extraction: four line studies for each of nine body parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 第一步「壓平」，依序處理大腦、眼睛、嘴巴、頸部、血管、軀幹、雙手、皮膚與骨骼。每個部位都以四張線稿萃取出它的形態。
captions: 形態萃取：九個身體部位，各四張線稿。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Since the senses work synergistically with each other, a few elements from the different form-extraction studies that match the imagery are combined. The formula (A + B) × C multiplies two forms by a motion, and each combination generates a 3D model.
captions: Formula: (A + B) × C, form times motion.
Rebuild, first row: three combinations and their 3D models.
Rebuild, second row.
Rebuild, third row.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 由於感官彼此協同運作，本案從不同的形態萃取中挑選符合意象的元素加以組合。公式 (A + B) × C 以兩種形態乘上一種運動，每一組組合都生成一個 3D 模型。
captions: 公式：(A + B) × C，形態乘以運動。
重建第一列：三組組合及其 3D 模型。
重建第二列。
重建第三列。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The models are mapped back onto the body as the foot sole, intestinal tract, skin, joint, blood vessel, arms, eyes and cervical spine, each with an action such as winding, smooth, plastic, interspersed, distort, extend and reverse. Together they form the overall form of the fluid city.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這些模型再對應回身體，成為腳掌、腸道、皮膚、關節、血管、手臂、眼睛與頸椎，各自帶有纏繞、平滑、可塑、穿插、扭曲、延伸與反轉等動作。它們共同組成流動城市的整體形態。

sections.heading: URU Fairy Land - Translating the Body Into a Fluid City
sections.body: The city is mobile in the sense that, in the student's hometown, the five senses are carried along by its many activities and rich religious beliefs, and the image of the city changes with them. Taking the body as a starting point, the project explores a fluid city through the spatial translation of its parts. A first step, Flatten, takes the brain, eye, mouth, neck, vessels, torso, hands, skin and bone one by one, and each is drawn in four line studies that distil its form. Because the senses work in concert, elements from different studies that match the imagery are then brought together. A formula adds two forms and multiplies them by a motion, and every combination grows into a three-dimensional model, so that abstract feeling can be touched. The models are mapped back onto the body as foot sole, intestine, skin, joint, blood vessel, arm, eye and cervical spine, each carrying an action such as winding, smoothing, moulding, interweaving, distorting, extending or reversing. Linked and seeping into one another, they compose the whole form of the fluid city, less a set of blocks than a body that breathes and feels.

zh-Hant.heading: URU仙境-以身體轉譯一座流動之城
zh-Hant.body: 城市是「流動的」：在學生的家鄉，人的五感隨著各式活動與豐富的宗教信仰而轉移，對城市的印象也隨之改變。作品以身體為起點，透過身體部位的空間轉譯，探索一座流動城市的可能。第一步「壓平」，依序處理大腦、眼睛、嘴巴、頸部、血管、軀幹、雙手、皮膚與骨骼，每個部位都以四張線稿萃取出它的形態。由於感官彼此協同運作，研究再從不同的形態萃取中，挑選符合意象的元素加以組合。一道公式以兩種形態相加、再乘上一種運動，每一組組合都生成一個立體模型。這些模型隨後被對應回身體，化為腳掌、腸道、皮膚、關節、血管、手臂、眼睛與頸椎，各自帶著纏繞、平滑、可塑、穿插、扭曲、延伸與反轉等動作。它們共同組成流動城市的整體形態。城市因此像一具會呼吸、會感受的身體。

pins.title: Under the Midnight Sun
pins.description:
A theater in front of the Taipei Fine Arts Museum lets visitors walk through Keigo Higashino's “White Night Journey” chapter by chapter, led by a detective or on their own.

Taipei Fine Arts Museum, Taipei | Theater design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 白夜行
zh-Hant.description:
在臺北市立美術館前的劇場，讓參觀者逐章走進東野圭吾的《白夜行》，跟隨偵探，或自行探索。

臺北市立美術館，臺北｜劇場設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Hand-made model: stacked timber frames and coloured planes, explored by hand to find the form of the space.
手作模型：堆疊的木框架與彩色板片，以手作探索空間的形態。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Keigo Higashino's mystery novel “White Night Journey” cleverly reveals the connection between its two characters, and its film adaptation raised the question of whether the charm of words can be conveyed through spatial design. Immersing oneself in a book involves recreating crime scenes and embodying the text in a designed space.
captions: The site: an empty space in front of the Taipei Fine Arts Museum, where designers are invited to create new works every year.
Put a book in the real world: from book to movie, and from places to stories.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 東野圭吾的推理小說《白夜行》巧妙地揭示兩位主角之間的關聯；它被改編成電影，引出一個問題：文字的魅力能否透過空間設計傳達。沉浸在一本書中，意味著重現犯罪現場，並把文字具體化為一個被設計的空間。
captions: 基地：臺北市立美術館前的空地，每年邀請設計師在此創作。
把書放進真實世界：從書到電影，從場所到故事。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The plot is mapped across five chapters, from a dark childhood, high school life and a dirty commercial to university life and death, together with the scenes where the characters are. Traversing the space then lets visitors understand the book's narrative and activates their perceptual systems for a unique entertainment experience.
captions: Different scenes where the characters are, chapter by chapter.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案把情節拆解為五個章節，從黑暗的童年、高中生活、骯髒的交易，到大學生活與死亡，並標示角色所在的各個場景。穿越空間，讓參觀者理解書中的敘事，也喚醒他們的感知系統，帶來獨特的娛樂體驗。
captions: 角色所在的不同場景，逐章呈現。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Hand-made models explore a space that integrates play, performance and leisure, a fantasy city about walking on white nights. Five coloured blocks for the five chapters are raised, scattered, connected by a main channel and cut into pentagons, in pink, red and white taken from Xuesui's cloth.
captions: Model studies of the frame-and-plane space.
Bulk formation: raise, scatter, connect, reshape into a pentagon and cut.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以手作模型探索一個融合遊戲、表演與休閒的空間，一座關於在白夜中行走的幻想城市。代表五個章節的五個彩色量體被抬升、打散，以主要通道相連，再切割成五角形；粉紅、紅與白三色取自雪穗的衣料。
captions: 框架與板片空間的模型研究。
量體生成：抬升、打散、串連、改為五角形，再切割。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Five chapters become five areas, and each small space is about one story. Visitors first meet a detective who leads them to the first scene, and then either follow the detective's way through the building or explore the plot freely, guided by two colours of stairs.
captions: Spatial streamline and composition: five chapters to five areas, the detective way and the free way.
Section display, with stair and C-stud partition details.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 五個章節化為五個區域，每一個小空間都關於一段故事。參觀者先遇見一位偵探，由他帶到第一個場景；之後可以跟隨偵探的路線走完整棟建築，也可以自由探索情節，兩種顏色的樓梯為他們引路。
captions: 空間動線與構成：五個章節化為五個區域，偵探路線與自由路線。
剖面展示，附樓梯與 C 型鋼隔間細部。

sections.heading: Under the Midnight Sun - Five Chapters of a Mystery Novel Made Walkable
sections.body: A mystery novel cleverly reveals the bond between its two protagonists, and its film adaptation raised a question: can the charm of words be carried by spatial design? To be immersed in a book here means recreating its crime scenes and giving the text a body as designed space. The plot is mapped across five chapters, from a dark childhood, high school and a sordid deal to university life and death, together with the scenes where the characters stand. Moving through the building lets visitors grasp the narrative and wakes their senses for a singular kind of entertainment. Hand-made models explore a space that joins play, performance and leisure, a fantasy city about walking through white nights. Five coloured blocks for the five chapters are raised, scattered, joined by a main channel and cut into pentagons, in pink, red and white drawn from the heroine's cloth. Each chapter becomes an area and each small room holds one story. Visitors first meet a detective who leads them to the opening scene, then either follow the detective's route or roam the plot freely, guided by stairs of two colours, piecing the truth together.

zh-Hant.heading: 白夜行-把推理小說的五章化為可行走的城
zh-Hant.body: 一部推理小說巧妙地揭示兩位主角之間的牽連，它被改編成電影，也引出一個問題：文字的魅力能否透過空間設計傳達？沉浸在一本書裡，意味著重現犯罪現場，並把文字具體化為一個被設計的空間。情節被拆解為五個章節，從黑暗的童年、高中生活、骯髒的交易，到大學生活與死亡，並標示出角色身處的每一個場景。手作模型探索一個融合遊戲、表演與休閒的空間，一座關於在白夜中行走的幻想之城。代表五章的五個彩色量體被抬升、打散，以主要通道相連，再切割為五角形，粉紅、紅與白三色取自女主角的衣料。五個章節化為五個區域，每個小空間都訴說一段故事。參觀者先遇見一位偵探，被引領至第一個場景；之後可以跟隨偵探的路線走完整棟建築，也可以在兩種顏色的樓梯指引下自由探索情節。

pins.title: Home and Life
pins.description:
A family home in Changzhou is redesigned to change with each stage of life, from babyhood to adulthood, around a dynamic space that becomes a vertical playground.

Changzhou, Jiangsu | Residential design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 家與生活
zh-Hant.description:
重新設計常州的一棟家宅，讓它隨著人生的每個階段而改變：從嬰兒期到成年，以一個可化為垂直遊樂場的動態空間為核心。

江蘇常州｜住宅設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Physical model: the three-storey home opened up, with the activity platforms, the children's activity room and the study.
實體模型：剖開的三層住宅，可見活動平台、兒童活動室與書房。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: This is a home the student has lived in since birth and never moved from, yet with each age the interior seemed to change, and the space used in each period was different. Because the home is fixed, much of its space use became unreasonable and life less convenient.
captions: The venue in Changzhou, Jiangsu, beside a commercial street, with noise level, predominant wind and people and vehicles moving in the area.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這是學生自出生起就居住、從未搬離的家；然而隨著年齡增長，家中的內部似乎也在改變，每個時期使用的空間都不同。由於住宅是固定的，許多空間的使用變得不合理，生活也不那麼方便。
captions: 位於江蘇常州的基地，緊鄰商業街，並分析噪音、盛行風以及人車動線。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The building sits on the side of a street surrounded by residential areas and a commercial street that has gradually become lonely, so the building needs to keep changing with the times. As family members' needs shift from babyhood and childhood to teenage time and adulthood, the frequency of use of each space shifts too.
captions: The frequency of use in different periods of home space.
Decode box, the problems in the floor plan of the original home and the new space division.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 建築位於街道一側，周邊是住宅區與一條日漸冷清的商業街，因此建築也需要隨時代持續改變。隨著家庭成員的需求從嬰兒期、童年、青少年走到成年，每個空間的使用頻率也跟著轉移。
captions: 住宅空間在不同時期的使用頻率。
解碼盒、原有住宅平面的問題，以及新的空間劃分。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Inspired by a childhood dream of a home that can move, the middle of the house becomes a versatile dynamic space that connects to the other rooms and transforms into a vertical playground. The rooms are arranged downstairs, separated by a bathroom for privacy, and the living spaces are placed in the upper part.
captions: Room layout, fixed space and dynamic space, and the mechanism principle.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 受到童年時對一座會移動的家的想像啟發，住宅中央成為一個多功能的動態空間，連接其他房間，並可轉化為垂直遊樂場。臥室配置在下層，以浴室分隔以確保隱私，起居空間則置於上層。
captions: 房間配置、固定空間與動態空間，以及機構原理。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: On each floor the spaces change through babyhood, childhood, teenage time and adulthood: a sliding door shields the kitchen, an activity table expands for weekend dinners and a wall opens into a sunshade for chatting with neighbours. When the child leaves for college a raised platform creates new space for the parents, and a stair secured by a password lock opens to a small secret room.
captions: F1: entrance, grandparent's room, garden, living room, kitchen and dining room through four periods.
F2: parents' room, child's room, bathroom and activity platform.
F3: study, mom's working room, child's playing room and the stairs.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每一層的空間都隨著嬰兒期、童年、青少年與成年而改變：拉門隔開廚房油煙，活動餐桌在週末家族聚餐時展開，一面牆打開即成為與鄰居聊天的遮陽棚。孩子離家上大學後，抬升的平台為父母創造新的空間；以密碼鎖固定的樓梯打開後，則通往一間小小的密室。
captions: 一樓：入口、祖父母房、庭院、客廳、廚房與餐廳，歷經四個時期。
二樓：父母房、孩子房、浴室與活動平台。
三樓：書房、媽媽的工作室、孩子的遊戲室與樓梯。

sections.heading: Home Through the Years - A House That Changes Shape as Its Family Grows
sections.body: This is the home the student has lived in since birth and never left, yet with each passing age the interior seemed to change, and every period used the space differently. Because the house itself stays fixed, much of its layout slowly became unreasonable and daily life less convenient. The building stands on a street lined with housing and a shopping street that has grown quiet, so the house too must keep changing with the times. As the needs of the family move from babyhood and childhood to the teenage years and adulthood, the use of each room shifts with them. Inspired by a childhood dream of a home that could move, the middle of the house becomes a versatile, dynamic space that links the other rooms and can turn into a vertical playground. Each floor changes with the stages of life: a sliding door screens the kitchen, a table expands for weekend family dinners, and a wall opens into a sunshade for chatting with neighbours. When the child leaves for college, a raised platform frees space for the parents, and a locked stair leads to a small secret room.

zh-Hant.heading: 家與年歲-一座隨成長而變形的住宅
zh-Hant.body: 這是學生自出生起便居住、從未搬離的家；然而隨著年歲增長，屋內彷彿也跟著變化，每個時期使用的空間都不相同。由於住宅本身是固定的，許多空間的用法漸漸變得不合理。建築位於街道一側旁的商業街日漸冷清，因此房子也需要隨時代持續改變。隨著家人的需求從嬰兒期、童年、青少年走到成年，每個空間的使用頻率也悄悄轉移。受到童年時對一座會移動的家的想像啟發，住宅中央成為一個多功能的動態空間，連接其他房間，並能轉化為垂直遊樂場。每一層都隨著人生階段而變：拉門隔開廚房的油煙，活動餐桌在週末家族聚餐時展開，一面牆打開即成為與鄰居閒聊的遮陽棚。孩子離家上大學後，抬升的平台為父母騰出新的空間；以密碼鎖固定的樓梯，則通往一間小小的密室，收藏一家人的時光。

pins.title: Urban Cat Island
pins.description:
A one-stop rescue center for stray cats turns the south plaza of Guangzhou East Railway Station into a green park with a cat island.

South plaza, Guangzhou East Railway Station, Guangzhou | Architecture | Practice, individual work | 2023 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 城市貓島
zh-Hant.description:
一座流浪貓一站式救助中心，將廣州東站南廣場轉化為擁有貓島的綠色公園。

廣州東站南廣場，廣州｜建築設計｜實務，個人作品｜2023 年｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Perspective view: the 24-hour sterilization center, the cat island, the pedestrian overpass and the adoption center in the plaza.
透視圖：廣場中的 24 小時絕育中心、貓島、人行天橋與領養中心。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The main source of urban stray cats is the abandonment of pet cats and their free reproduction, and with its higher population density the city center is the worst-hit area. Existing shelters are few, far away and hard to contact, in poor condition and with low adoption rates, while survey results show that Guangzhou residents are positive about rescuing stray cats.
captions: Site location selection: shelters in Guangzhou, their accessibility and capacity, and the site at the south plaza of Guangzhou East Railway Station.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 城市流浪貓主要來自寵物貓遭棄養後的自由繁殖；市中心人口密度較高，因此成為受害最嚴重的地區。現有收容所數量少、位置偏遠又難以聯繫，條件不佳、領養率也低；而調查顯示，廣州市民對救助流浪貓抱持正面態度。
captions: 基地選址：廣州的收容所及其可達性與容量，以及位於廣州東站南廣場的基地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: At the south plaza the boundary is too enclosed, the landscape is inaccessible and the plaza is empty, flat and boring, while a large number of electric vehicles clog the sidewalk. Sun path, wind direction, noise sources and the surrounding functional zones were mapped before the strategy was set.
captions: Site conditions.
Site issues, the three design strategies (one-stop center, five animal welfare, urban green space) and the planning sketches.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 在南廣場，基地邊界過於封閉、景觀難以進入，廣場空曠、平坦而乏味，大量電動車堵塞人行道。在確立策略之前，先分析了日照路徑、風向、噪音來源與周邊機能分區。
captions: 基地現況。
基地問題、三項設計策略（一站式中心、五大動物福利、城市綠地）與規劃草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sunken terrain lets the soil become the first wall separating cats from noise, foot traffic and other hazards, and two green landscapes on the east and west block noise and part of the car exhaust. Because Guangzhou is rainy and its summer sun is hot, the main garden paths run on two levels, and open-worked roofs and building units serve as public spaces.
captions: Physical models 1:100, sections 1 and 2.
Site plan: cat hospital, cat island, parking, garden landscape, adoption center, pools and sports lawn, entrance plaza and cafe.
Volume generation in six steps.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 下沉地形讓土壤成為第一道牆，把貓與噪音、人流及其他危險隔開；東西兩側的綠色景觀阻擋噪音與部分汽車廢氣。由於廣州多雨、夏季日照炎熱，主要的園路分為上下兩層，鏤空的屋頂與建築單元則作為公共空間。
captions: 實體模型 1:100，剖面一與剖面二。
總平面：貓醫院、貓島、停車場、庭園景觀、領養中心、水池與運動草坪、入口廣場與咖啡館。
六個步驟的量體生成。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: An all-in-one Cat Island Rescue Center keeps the original green space and the public square while upgrading them into a green park along Guangzhou's central axis. A one-step medical system takes each cat from capture and reception through examination, treatment, surgery, rehabilitation, isolated living and training, and the cat island meets five kinds of animal welfare.
captions: The 24-hour sterilization center, the cat island and the pedestrian overpass.
One-step medical system and the cat island.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一座整合式的貓島救助中心保留原有的綠地與公共廣場，並將其升級為廣州中軸線上的綠色公園。一站式醫療系統讓每一隻貓依序經過捕捉與接收、檢查、治療、手術、復健、隔離生活與訓練；貓島則滿足五個面向的動物福利。
captions: 24 小時絕育中心、貓島與人行天橋。
一站式醫療系統與貓島。

sections.heading: Urban Cat Island - A Sunken Refuge for Stray Cats in the City Centre
sections.body: Most urban stray cats come from abandoned pets and their unchecked breeding, and the dense city centre is where the problem is worst. Existing shelters are few, far away and hard to reach, in poor condition and with low adoption rates, yet surveys show residents feel warmly about rescuing strays. At the south plaza of the site the edges are too closed, the landscape cannot be entered, the plaza is empty, flat and dull, and crowds of electric scooters clog the pavement. Sunken ground lets the soil itself become the first wall, keeping cats apart from noise, foot traffic and other dangers, while green bands to the east and west block noise and some exhaust. Because the climate is rainy and summer sun is fierce, the main paths run on two levels, and open-worked roofs and building units serve as public space. An all-in-one rescue centre keeps the green space and square while lifting them into a park on the central axis of the city. A one-step medical system carries each cat from reception through treatment, surgery and rehabilitation to training, meeting five kinds of animal welfare.

zh-Hant.heading: 城市貓島-在市中心為流浪貓下沉一座庇護
zh-Hant.body: 城市裡的流浪貓，大多來自遭棄養的寵物貓及其自由繁殖；人口密集的市中心，正是受害最深的地區。現有收容所數量少、位置偏遠、難以聯繫，條件不佳，領養率也低，而調查顯示市民對救助流浪貓抱持正面態度。基地南廣場的邊界過於封閉，景觀難以親近，廣場空曠、平坦而乏味。下沉的地形讓土壤成為第一道牆，把貓與噪音、人流及其他危險隔開；東西兩側的綠帶阻擋噪音與部分汽車廢氣。由於多雨、夏日炎熱，主要園路分為上下兩層，鏤空的屋頂與建築單元則成為公共空間。一座整合式的貓島救助中心保留原有綠地與廣場，並將其升級為城市中軸線上的綠色公園。一站式醫療系統讓每隻貓依序經過接收、檢查、治療、手術、復健、隔離與訓練，貓島也同時滿足五個面向的動物福利。

pins.title: The Rebirth of Cloth Fabric
pins.description:
An old academic building at the University of Liverpool becomes a fabric recycling centre with designer studios, workshops, a shop and an exhibition tower.

Chadwick Building, University of Liverpool, Liverpool, UK | Architecture, renovation | Academic, individual work | 2023 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 布料重生
zh-Hant.description:
將利物浦大學的一棟老舊教學大樓，改造為擁有設計師工作室、工作坊、商店與展覽塔樓的布料回收中心。

利物浦大學 Chadwick Building，英國利物浦｜建築設計，改造｜課程作業，個人作品｜2023 年｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Facade and material strategy: the facade explosion and the axonometric scene of the eighth floor.
立面與材料策略：立面爆炸圖與八樓的軸測場景。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Every year graduates of the University of Liverpool leave behind a large amount of unwanted clothing and fabric, and the community around the university generates a lot of clothing waste. The project renovates the Chadwick Building, an old academic building, into studios for independent designers, an exhibition space and an events room that use this waste as their material.
captions: Site analysis: the existing structure, climate, fabric waste sources, function zones and accessibility.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 利物浦大學的畢業生每年留下大量不要的衣物與布料，大學周邊社區也產生許多服裝廢棄物。本案將老舊的教學大樓 Chadwick Building 改造為獨立設計師工作室、展覽空間與活動室，並以這些廢棄物作為材料。
captions: 基地分析：既有結構、氣候、布料廢棄物來源、機能分區與可達性。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A new recycling process replaces the old linear production process: donation bins on campus and partner stores supply fabric, and designers decide whether to mend, recycle or reuse each garment. The three design drivers are sustainability, human well-being and circulation, so that the staff and the students and daily visitors do not disturb each other but blend in.
captions: Design concept, fabric recycle upgrade, and the three design drivers.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 新的回收流程取代舊有的線性生產流程：校園中的捐衣箱與合作服飾店提供布料，設計師再依每件衣物的狀況決定修補、回收或再利用。三項設計驅動力是永續、人的福祉與動線，讓工作人員與學生、日常訪客互不干擾，又能彼此交融。
captions: 設計概念、布料回收升級，以及三項設計驅動力。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Because each floor of the tower is small, the tower is changed together with the single-storey building, an atrium and an open courtyard bring in light and air, and the north lift is kept while a new fire escape is added to the south. As much of the original structure as possible is retained to preserve its embodied carbon, and a two-storey facade system with shading solves daylight, warmth and ventilation.
captions: Volume generation in six stages.
Design explain: the programme floor by floor.
Ground floor plan 1:100: entrance, laundry, shop, cloth repair and hire, workshop, cafe and donation room.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 由於塔樓每層面積很小，塔樓與單層建築一併改造；中庭與開放庭院引入光線與空氣，保留北側電梯，並在南側新增逃生梯。盡可能保留原有結構以保存其隱含碳，再以兩層樓高、附遮陽的立面系統解決採光、保暖與通風。
captions: 六個階段的量體生成。
設計說明：逐層的機能配置。
一樓平面 1:100：入口、洗衣房、商店、衣物修補與出租、工作坊、咖啡館與捐贈分類室。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Designers' creations are sold in a shop on the first floor and shown in an exhibition space in the tower, and regular workshops let students take part in recycling old clothes. The fabric sunshade screen uses two layers of differently coloured strings whose overlap creates a moiré effect, and groups of panels can twist individually to suit each area of the building.
captions: Mezzanine to roof plans.
North short section and east long section.
North short elevation and east long elevation with material.
Structural strategy, physical model 1:200 and environmental strategy.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 設計師的作品在一樓的商店販售，並在塔樓的展覽空間展出；定期的工作坊讓學生參與舊衣回收。布料遮陽屏由兩層不同顏色的繩線構成，重疊後產生疊紋效果；各組面板可個別扭轉，以適應建築中不同區域的需求。
captions: 夾層至屋頂平面。
北向短向剖面與東向長向剖面。
北向短向立面與東向長向立面（含材料）。
結構策略、1:200 實體模型與環境策略。

sections.heading: Cloth Reborn - Graduates' Leftover Fabric Remakes an Old Academic Building
sections.body: Every graduation season, students leave behind a large amount of unwanted clothing and fabric, and the community around the university produces plenty of clothing waste of its own. The project turns an old academic building into studios for independent designers, an exhibition space and an events room that take this waste as their material. A recycling loop replaces the old linear chain: donation bins on campus and partner shops supply fabric, and designers decide whether each garment is mended, recycled or reused. Sustainability, well-being and circulation drive the design, so that staff, students and daily visitors never disturb one another yet still mingle. Because each floor of the tower is small, it is remade together with the single-storey wing; an atrium and courtyard bring in light and air. As much structure as possible is kept to hold its embodied carbon, and a two-storey shaded facade handles daylight, warmth and ventilation. Designers sell work in a ground-floor shop and show it in the tower, while a sunshade of two coloured strings overlaps into a moiré.

zh-Hant.heading: 舊衣新生-以畢業留下的布料改造教學大樓
zh-Hant.body: 每年畢業季，大學的畢業生都留下大量不再需要的衣物與布料，校園周邊社區也產生許多服裝廢棄物。作品把一棟老舊的教學大樓，改造為獨立設計師工作室、展覽空間與活動室，並以這些廢棄物作為材料。新的回收流程取代舊有的線性生產：校園捐衣箱與合作服飾店提供布料，設計師再依每件衣物的狀況決定修補、回收或再利用。永續、人的福祉與動線是三項設計驅動力。由於塔樓每層面積小，塔樓與單層建築一併改造，中庭與庭院引入光與空氣。盡可能保留原有結構以保存隱含碳，並以遮陽立面調節光、熱與風。設計師的作品在一樓商店販售、在塔樓展出，定期工作坊讓學生參與舊衣回收。布料遮陽屏由兩層異色繩線交疊出疊紋，面板可各自扭轉，讓被遺棄的布料在立面上重新呼吸。

pins.title: Birkenhead Music College
pins.description:
An abandoned parking lot in Birkenhead city centre becomes a four-storey brick music college with a 200-seat music hall.

Chester Street, Birkenhead, UK | Architecture | Academic, individual work | 2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 伯肯黑德音樂學院
zh-Hant.description:
將伯肯黑德市中心一座廢棄停車場，改造為擁有 200 席音樂廳的四層磚造音樂學院。

英國伯肯黑德 Chester Street｜建築設計｜課程作業，個人作品｜2022 年｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Section perspective: the 200-seat music hall at the centre, with practice rooms and teaching spaces around and above it.
剖透視：中央是 200 席的音樂廳，練習室與教學空間環繞並位於其上方。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project renovates an abandoned private parking lot on Chester Street in Birkenhead city centre into a music college. The clients may ask it to provide a place where local people enjoy music performances, encourage them to come to the city centre and attract people from Liverpool to visit Birkenhead.
captions: Clients, stakeholders and main users, and the site analysis of Birkenhead.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案將伯肯黑德市中心 Chester Street 上一座廢棄的私人停車場改造為音樂學院。業主可能要求它成為在地居民欣賞音樂演出的場所，吸引他們走進市中心，也吸引利物浦的人前來伯肯黑德。
captions: 業主、利害關係人與主要使用者，以及伯肯黑德的基地分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A residential building hugs the southern boundary, tall buildings stand to the south and west, and two electric boxes on the open north side cannot be moved. Winds are strong from the west and south, and the surroundings are mostly red and brown brick, so brick is used as the main body, with thick walls and sunk windows for passive design.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一棟住宅緊貼基地南側邊界，南側與西側有高樓，開闊的北側則有兩座無法移動的電箱。西風與南風強勁，周邊多為紅褐色磚造建築，因此以磚作為主體，並以厚牆與內凹窗戶進行被動式設計。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The college is divided into three functional blocks, auditorium, teaching and public, and their combinations are tested in concept models, plans, sections and massing models. Each round lists its problems, from an auditorium that is too high to a foyer that is too small, and the next round answers them.
captions: Project design process: design drivers, concept comparisons, plan and section development and facade studies.
Final design explosive view: the main circulation tube and the public and private circulation.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學院被劃分為禮堂、教學與公共三個機能區塊，並以概念模型、平面、剖面與量體模型測試各種組合。每一輪都列出問題，從禮堂過高到門廳過小，再由下一輪回應。
captions: 設計過程：設計驅動力、概念比較、平面與剖面推演，以及立面研究。
最終設計爆炸圖：主要動線筒與公共、私密動線。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The four-storey college is divided into a public lower half and a private upper half, with red brick, concrete and a robust timber beam-column structure in harmony with its surroundings. A music hall for 200 people hosts regular concerts, and the third and fourth floors hold a 40-seat lecture hall, many small practice rooms and other teaching spaces.
captions: Third floor plan 1:200.
The other floor plans.
Structural, material and environmental strategy.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 四層樓的學院分為公共的下半部與私密的上半部，以紅磚、混凝土與堅固的木樑柱結構與周邊環境相協調。可容納 200 人的音樂廳定期舉辦音樂會；三、四樓則設有 40 席的講堂、許多小型練習室與其他教學空間。
captions: 三樓平面 1:200。
其他樓層平面。
結構、材料與環境策略。

sections.heading: Music in Brick - A Disused Car Park Becomes a Music College
sections.body: The project turns an abandoned private car park in a town centre into a music college, a place where local people can enjoy performances, a reason to come into the centre, and a draw for visitors from the larger city across the river. A house hugs the southern edge of the site, tall buildings rise to the south and west, and two electrical boxes on the open north side cannot be moved. Winds blow hard from the west and south, and the neighbours are mostly red and brown brick, so brick forms the main body, with thick walls and deep-set windows for passive design. The college is split into three blocks, auditorium, teaching and public, and their combinations are tested in concept models, plans, sections and massing models. Each round lists its own problems, from an auditorium that is too tall to a foyer that is too small, and the next round answers them. Four storeys divide into a public lower half and a private upper half in red brick, concrete and a sturdy timber frame. A two-hundred-seat hall hosts regular concerts, and upper floors hold a lecture room and many small practice rooms.

zh-Hant.heading: 磚中樂聲-把廢棄停車場改為音樂學院
zh-Hant.body: 作品把市中心一座廢棄的私人停車場，改造為一所音樂學院；它既要成為在地居民欣賞演出的場所，也要吸引河對岸大城市的訪客前來。基地南側緊貼一棟住宅，南面與西面有高樓，開闊的北側則立著兩座無法移動的電箱。西風與南風強勁，周邊多是紅褐色的磚造建築，於是磚成為主體材料，以厚牆與內凹的窗戶進行被動式設計。學院被劃分為禮堂、教學與公共三個機能區塊，以各種模型反覆測試組合。每一輪都列出問題，從禮堂過高到門廳過小，再交由下一輪回應。四層樓的學院分為公共的下半部與私密的上半部，以紅磚、混凝土與堅固的木樑柱結構，與周遭街景相互協調。可容納兩百人的音樂廳定期舉辦音樂會，三、四樓則設有四十席講堂、許多小型練習室與其他教學空間，讓磚牆之內四季流淌著樂聲。

pins.title: Emerged to the Surface
pins.description:
A narrative architecture on the development of feminism in China: a route from childhood castles to a tunnel of thorns that asks visitors to rethink women's lives.

Nanshan District, Shenzhen | Narrative architecture | Competition, individual work | 2023 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 浮出地表
zh-Hant.description:
一座關於中國女性主義發展的敘事建築：從童年城堡到荊棘隧道的路徑，邀請參觀者重新思考女性的生命。

深圳南山區｜敘事建築｜競圖，個人作品｜2023 年｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Design display: a route of towers, carousels and workshops that descends underground and finally emerges to the surface.
設計展示：一條由塔樓、旋轉木馬與工坊組成的路徑，先沉入地下，最後浮出地表。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: This narrative architecture aims to awaken Chinese feminine subjectivity, based on an examination of the social situations and mindsets of women at different periods in Chinese history and of the intense discussions about feminism online. The research reveals an urgent need for Chinese women to ignite a spirit of self-centred resistance, breaking free from the male “rescue” fantasy and the shaping influence of a patriarchal society.
captions: Location and site plan in Nanshan district, Shenzhen, Guangdong.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這座敘事建築旨在喚醒中國女性的主體意識；設計建立在對中國歷史上不同時期女性的社會處境與心態的考察，以及對當前網路上女性主義激烈討論的觀察之上。研究顯示，中國女性迫切需要點燃以自我為中心的反抗精神，擺脫男性「拯救」的幻想與父權社會的塑造。
captions: 位於廣東深圳南山區的區位與基地平面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Feminism in China is traced from a traditional period, through the 1890s when it was led by reformist men and 1949 when it was led by central political consciousness, to the 1980s when it was discussed among scholars and 2021 when it came to the attention of the larger public. Current online topics, from bride price to the male gaze, show how women are still shaped into society's notion of “good women”.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案梳理中國女性主義的發展：從傳統時期，到 1890 年代由改良派男性主導、1949 年由中央政治意識主導，再到 1980 年代在學者間討論、2021 年引起大眾關注。當前從彩禮到男性凝視等網路話題，顯示女性至今仍被塑造成社會所謂的「好女人」。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The architecture narrates Chinese women's transformation from daughters to single women, and then from wives to mothers. Each stage becomes a space: the castles of childhood, a doll production chain, a dizzying carousel of the male gaze, the options of career and romantic love, roses and falls, a high tower, endless waves and an illusory utopia.
captions: A Castles of Childhood: false preferences; B Dolls Production Chain: social discipline; C Dizzying Carousel: male gaze and beauty servitude; D Options: career misogynistic traits and the romantic love trap.

E Roses and Falls: obsessed with being loved and eager to be recognised; G Hightower: women's strength and patience; F Endless Waves: contemporary professional women and the traditional division of family roles; H Illusory Utopia: poor in spirit.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 建築敘述中國女性從女兒到單身女性、再從妻子到母親的轉變。每一個階段都化為一個空間：童年的城堡、玩偶生產線、男性凝視的眩暈旋轉木馬、職業與愛情的選擇、玫瑰與墜落、高塔、無盡的波浪，以及虛幻的烏托邦。
captions: A 童年城堡：虛假的偏好；B 玩偶生產線：社會規訓；C 眩暈旋轉木馬：男性凝視與美貌奴役；D 選擇：職場厭女特質與愛情陷阱。
E 玫瑰與墜落：渴望被愛、急於被認可；G 高塔：女性的力量與堅忍；F 無盡波浪：當代職業女性與傳統家庭分工；H 虛幻烏托邦：精神的貧乏。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In a dizzying space of linear mirrors women keep seeing their own faces, workshops “mould” their bodies and ideas, and a curved glass wall stands for unequal pay and discrimination at work. At the end, visitors choose between flowers and sunshine or a tunnel of thorns that leads up a narrow tower, so that whether trapped underground or emerging above ground they contemplate the dominant consciousness in women's lives.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在線性鏡面構成的眩暈空間中，女性不斷看見自己的臉；工坊「塑造」她們的身體與觀念；一道彎曲的玻璃牆象徵同工不同酬與職場歧視。最後，參觀者要在花朵與陽光，或一條通往狹窄高塔的荊棘隧道之間做出選擇；無論受困地下或浮出地表，都將反思主導女性生命的意識。

sections.heading: Emerged to the Surface - A Narrative Building That Awakens Female Selfhood
sections.body: This narrative architecture sets out to awaken female subjectivity, grounded in a study of the social situations and mindsets of women across different periods of history and of fierce online debates about feminism. The research finds an urgent need for women to kindle a self-centred spirit of resistance, breaking free from the fantasy of being rescued and from the shaping hand of a patriarchal society. Online topics from bride price to the male gaze show women still moulded into the idea of good women. The building narrates the passage from daughter to single woman, then from wife to mother, and each stage becomes a space: castles of childhood, a doll production line, a dizzying carousel of the gaze, the choice of career or love, roses and falls, a high tower, endless waves and an illusory utopia. Linear mirrors return one's own face again and again, workshops mould bodies and ideas, and a curved glass wall stands for unequal work. At the end, visitors choose between flowers and sunlight or a tunnel of thorns.

zh-Hant.heading: 浮出地表-一座喚醒女性主體的敘事建築
zh-Hant.body: 這座敘事建築意在喚醒女性的主體意識，建立在對歷史上不同時期女性處境與心態的考察，以及對網路上女性主義激烈辯論的觀察之上。研究顯示，女性迫切需要點燃以自我為中心的反抗精神，擺脫被「拯救」的幻想與父權社會的形塑。從彩禮到凝視的網路話題，顯示女性至今仍被塑造成社會所謂的「好女人」。建築敘述女性從女兒到單身、再從妻子到母親的轉變，每個階段都化為一個空間：童年的城堡、玩偶生產線、凝視的眩暈旋轉木馬、職業與愛情的抉擇、高塔、波浪與虛幻的烏托邦。線性鏡面讓人不斷看見自己的臉，工坊「塑造」身體與觀念，一道彎曲的玻璃牆象徵職場的不平等。最後，參觀者在花與陽光，或通往窄塔的荊棘隧道之間抉擇，於地下或地表反思主導女性生命的意識。

pins.title: Seawater Thermal Pollution
pins.description:
Beside Taiwan's third nuclear power plant, an offshore lagoon mixes waste hot water with the sea and gives fisheries and tourism back to the local community.

Nan Bay, Hengchun, Pingtung, Taiwan | Urban and landscape design | Jul–Sep 2023 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 海水熱污染
zh-Hant.description:
在臺灣第三核能發電廠旁，以一座離岸潟湖讓溫排水與海水混合，並把漁業與觀光還給在地社區。

臺灣屏東恆春南灣｜城市與景觀設計｜2023 年 7–9 月｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Master plan: the offshore lagoon in Nan Bay, with water inlet, mixing area, outlet and wetlands, jetty and fish farming areas.
總平面：南灣的離岸潟湖，含進水口、混合區、出水口與濕地、棧橋及養殖區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The waters around Taiwan's third nuclear power plant are known for their abundance of coral and marine life, but the plant continuously discharges a large amount of waste hot water into the sea to cool itself. To cool 2,000 MW of waste heat it must discharge 43,906 kg of water per second at a temperature difference of 8 °C, and above 6 °C coral bleaching and algal blooms greatly reduce the local biodiversity.
captions: Location and problems: Nan Bay, Nuclear Power Plant III, Kenting National Park and Houbi Lake, with the rise in sea temperature and the decline in local biodiversity.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 臺灣第三核能發電廠周邊海域以豐富的珊瑚與海洋生物聞名，但電廠為了冷卻，持續把大量溫排水排入海中。要冷卻 2,000 MW 的廢熱，電廠每秒須排放 43,906 公斤、溫差 8 °C 的海水；當水溫上升超過 6 °C，珊瑚白化與藻類大量繁殖，使在地生物多樣性大幅下降。
captions: 區位與問題：南灣、核三廠、墾丁國家公園與後壁湖，以及海水溫度上升與在地生物多樣性下降。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The nuclear station cannot be stopped, but the decline of marine biology due to the increase of sea temperature can. The tide can take hot water away, and a lagoon with levees, helped by rock at its entrance, can mix the hot water with the sea instead of discharging it directly.
captions: So they achieve this form: taking and mixing, in sketch section and plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 核電廠無法停下，但海洋生物因海水升溫而衰退的趨勢可以被阻止。潮汐可以把熱水帶走；一座設有堤防、入口處佈有礁石的潟湖，則能讓熱水與海水混合，而不是直接排放。
captions: 由此得出形態：帶走與混合的剖面與平面草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Using the forces of nature, tides, currents and natural patterns, the design gently takes away hot water, mixes it with the sea and forms the dune area of an offshore lagoon. The dam is built where the warm water stagnates, the mix area is shaped by dispersion patterns learned from water-saving irrigation and from Von Kármán vortices, and the form is refined over time.
captions: The overall concept and how it benefits the local community.
Development of the specific form over time.
Period 1: build the lagoon dam; Period 2: shape the mix area with two dispersion patterns.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計運用自然的力量——潮汐、洋流與自然紋理——溫和地帶走熱水，使其與海水混合，並形成離岸潟湖的沙丘區。堤壩建在溫水滯留之處，混合區的形態則取自節水灌溉與卡門渦街的擴散模式，並隨時間逐步調整。
captions: 整體概念，以及它如何回饋在地社區。
特定形態隨時間的發展。
第一期：興建潟湖堤壩；第二期：以兩種擴散模式塑造混合區。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Hot water is cooled to within about 2 °C of the ambient sea temperature between about 500 m and 800 m from the discharge. Once the lagoon is formed, the dam, a nearshore reef, a tide energy channel, fishing farms and tourism give back to the local community and restore the fisheries that have been impacted.
captions: Axonometric drawing: tourism, the tide energy channel, fishing farm, the dam and the nearshore reef.
Section view of the dam.
The multi-functional structure jetty at low and high tide.
Model display: aerial and plan views, the dry state and the water intake state.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在距離排放口約 500 至 800 公尺之間，熱水被冷卻到與周邊海水溫差約 2 °C 以內。潟湖成形後，堤壩、近岸礁石、潮汐能渠道、養殖場與觀光共同回饋在地社區，並恢復受到衝擊的漁業。
captions: 軸測圖：觀光、潮汐能渠道、養殖場、堤壩與近岸礁石。
堤壩剖面。
多功能結構棧橋在低潮與高潮時的樣貌。
模型展示：鳥瞰與平面視角、乾燥狀態與進水狀態。

sections.heading: Warm Water to the Sea - A Lagoon That Gently Disperses Reactor Heat
sections.body: The waters around a nuclear power plant are known for rich coral and marine life, yet the plant keeps pouring waste hot water into the sea to cool itself. To shed two thousand megawatts of waste heat it must discharge some forty-four thousand kilograms of water a second at eight degrees above the sea, and beyond six degrees coral bleaching and algal blooms strip away local biodiversity. The plant cannot be stopped, but the decline of sea life under warming water can. Tides can carry heat away, and a lagoon with levees and rock at its mouth can mix the hot water with the sea instead of releasing it directly. Working with tides, currents and natural patterns, the design gently draws the heat away and forms the dunes of an offshore lagoon. The dam sits where warm water stagnates, and the mixing zone follows dispersion patterns learned from water-saving irrigation and Kármán vortices. Between five and eight hundred metres from the outlet, the water cools to within about two degrees of the sea. Reef, tidal energy channel, fish farms and tourism then give back to the community and restore its fisheries.

zh-Hant.heading: 溫水入海-以潟湖讓核電廢熱溫柔散去
zh-Hant.body: 一座核能電廠周邊的海域，以豐富的珊瑚與海洋生物聞名，電廠卻為了冷卻，持續把大量溫排水排入海中。要冷卻兩千兆瓦的廢熱，每秒須排出四萬多公斤、溫差八度的海水；一旦升溫超過六度，珊瑚白化與藻類滋生便使生物多樣性大幅下降。核電廠無法停下，但海洋生物因升溫而衰退的趨勢可以被扭轉。潮汐能把熱水帶走，一座設有堤防、入口佈滿礁石的潟湖，則能讓熱水與海水先行混合，而非直接排放。設計借助自然的力量溫和地帶走熱水，並形成離岸潟湖的沙丘區。堤壩建在溫水滯留之處，混合區的形態取自節水灌溉與卡門渦街的擴散模式。在距離排放口五百至八百公尺之間，熱水已冷卻到與周邊海水相差約兩度。潟湖成形後，堤壩、近岸礁石、潮汐能渠道、養殖場與觀光回饋在地社區，讓漁業復甦。

pins.title: New Life in Open Pit Mines
pins.description:
Overdevelopment, abandonment, conflict and renewal: engineering measures and urban planning turn the depleted Haizhou open-pit coal mine in Fuxin into a park for the city.

Haizhou open-pit coal mine, Fuxin, Liaoning | Urban design | Individual work | Sep 2022–Nov 2023 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 露天礦坑的新生
zh-Hant.description:
過度開發、廢棄、衝突與更新：以工程措施結合都市計畫，將枯竭的阜新海州露天煤礦轉化為城市公園。

遼寧阜新海州露天煤礦｜城市設計｜個人作品｜2022 年 9 月–2023 年 11 月｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Master plan: the Haizhou pit turned into a park, with a lake at the bottom, greenhouses, trails and viewing points on its slopes.
總平面：海州礦坑化為公園，坑底是湖泊，坡面上有溫室、步道與觀景點。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Fuxin's coal mining history began in 1897, and the Haizhou open-pit coal mine, the largest in Asia, produced 210 million tons of coal from 1953 to 2003. Resource depletion then led to bankruptcy and the loss of tourism, specialty products, industry and talented people, and a national mine park planned since 2005 only completed its entrance plaza and museum before it was deserted.
captions: The open-pit mine is a 10-minute drive from downtown Fuxin, beside the thermal power station, residences and the railway station.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 阜新的煤礦開採史始於 1897 年；亞洲最大的海州露天煤礦在 1953 至 2003 年間產出 2.1 億噸煤。資源枯竭隨後導致破產，觀光、特產、產業與人才也隨之流失；2005 年起規劃的國家礦山公園，只完成了入口廣場與博物館便遭廢棄。
captions: 露天礦坑距阜新市中心僅 10 分鐘車程，緊鄰熱電廠、住宅區與火車站。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A field survey of the pit recorded gangue rock piled up, unstable soil and loose stones, water unable to drain and raised sand and dust. South of the pit a huge power station and a great amount of gangue show the monolithic nature of the pit economy's industry.
captions: Field survey on mining pits: site issues and current situation, with boundary sections I and II.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 對礦坑的實地調查記錄了矸石堆積、土壤不穩與碎石鬆動、排水不良，以及揚沙揚塵等問題。礦坑南側巨大的電廠與大量的矸石，顯示礦坑經濟產業的單一性。
captions: 礦坑實地調查：基地問題與現況，以及邊界剖面一與二。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Three engineering measures support the expectations for the pit: a water system that forms a lake at its bottom in coordination with existing plans for a pumped storage power plant, light timber piles that use gravity to repair the stability of the slope, and the recycling of coal gangue. The gangue is sorted and converted into building materials for pit rehabilitation and into fertilizers for plant growth.
captions: Foundation: the engineering measures on a model of the pit.
Waste recycling system: the process of thinking for coal gangue.
Light structural facility system and the four-step light structural experiment.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三項工程措施支撐礦坑的願景：配合既有抽水蓄能電廠計畫、在坑底形成湖泊的水系統；以重力修復坡面穩定的輕型木樁；以及煤矸石的回收再利用。矸石經過分類，轉化為礦坑修復用的建材與植物生長所需的肥料。
captions: 基礎：工程措施在礦坑模型上的配置。
廢料回收系統：煤矸石的思考流程。
輕型結構設施系統與四步驟的輕型結構實驗。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: By reducing the gradient of the north slope that connects to the city and installing parks, green belts and rest and activity facilities, the pit opens up to the city and takes on public service, recreational and tourism value. Combined with urban planning, these strategies aim to revitalize the open-pit mine and transform it into a thriving urban centre once more.
captions: Development of the pit: connecting with the city, functional zoning and flow plan, and the connection method diagram.
Renderings: the centre lake and observation tower, outdoor adventure, the forest trail and the centre greenhouse platform.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 透過降低連接城市的北坡坡度，並設置公園、綠帶與休憩活動設施，礦坑向城市敞開，承擔公共服務、休閒與觀光的價值。這些策略結合都市計畫，目標是讓露天礦坑重獲生機，再次成為繁榮的城市中心。
captions: 礦坑的發展：與城市連結、機能分區與動線計畫，以及連接方式示意圖。
透視圖：中央湖泊與觀景塔、戶外探險、森林步道與中央溫室平台。

sections.heading: New Life in the Pit - Opening an Exhausted Coal Mine to Its City
sections.body: A coal city has been mining for more than a century, and the largest open-pit mine in Asia yielded over two hundred million tons of coal in half a century. When the resource ran out the mine went bankrupt, tourism, local products, industry and talent drained away, and a long-planned mine park was abandoned with only its entrance plaza and museum built. A field survey recorded piled gangue, unstable soil and loose stones, water that cannot drain, while a huge power station and mountains of gangue to the south show how narrow the pit economy was. Three engineering measures hold up the future of the pit: a water system that forms a lake at its bottom alongside planned pumped storage power, light timber piles that use gravity to steady the slopes, and the recycling of gangue. Sorted gangue becomes building material for the repair and fertiliser for new planting. By easing the north slope toward the city and adding parks, green belts and places to rest and play, the pit opens to the city, and with urban planning it can become a thriving centre once more.

zh-Hant.heading: 礦坑新生-讓枯竭的露天煤礦向城市敞開
zh-Hant.body: 一座煤礦城市的開採史已逾百年，亞洲最大的露天煤礦在半世紀間產出兩億多噸煤；資源枯竭之後，礦場破產，觀光、特產、產業與人才相繼流失，規劃多年的礦山公園只完成入口廣場與博物館便遭荒廢。實地調查記錄了矸石堆積、土壤不穩、排水不良與揚沙揚塵；礦坑南側的巨大電廠與成山的矸石，透露出礦坑經濟的單一。三項工程措施支撐礦坑的未來：配合既有的抽水蓄能電廠計畫，在坑底形成湖泊的水系統；以重力修復坡面穩定的輕型木樁；以及煤矸石的回收再利用。矸石經分類後，轉化為修復礦坑的建材與滋養植物的肥料。降低連接城市的北坡坡度，並設置公園、綠帶與休憩活動設施後，礦坑向城市敞開，承擔公共服務、休閒與觀光的價值。結合都市計畫，這些策略讓沉寂的巨坑重新成為城市的心臟。

pins.title: The Story Behind Oppenheimer
pins.description:
Remediation and regeneration of uranium-contaminated Navajo communities: a four-stage plan from cleaning the land to revitalizing the community.

Navajo Reservation, USA | Urban and landscape design | Coursework | Sep–Dec 2023 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 奧本海默背後的故事
zh-Hant.description:
受鈾污染的納瓦霍社區之整治與再生：從淨化土地到社區復興的四階段計畫。

美國納瓦霍保留區｜城市與景觀設計｜課程作業｜2023 年 9–12 月｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Stage 4 sections A-A and B-B: viewing platform, hiking trails, agricultural area, church, flexible architecture, medical company and wetlands.
第四階段剖面 A-A 與 B-B：觀景台、健行步道、農業區、教堂、彈性建築、醫療公司與濕地。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Over the summer Oppenheimer was screened in China, and the student learned that this history was set in the vast desert and highlands of the American Southwest, landscapes such as the Grand Canyon that had long fascinated them. Delving deeper, GIS data revealed a level of integrated development on the Navajo reservation that lags behind the rest of the United States.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個夏天《奧本海默》在中國上映，學生得知這段歷史發生在美國西南部廣闊的沙漠與高原，也就是大峽谷等他一直著迷的地景。深入研究後，GIS 數據顯示納瓦霍保留區的整體發展程度落後於美國其他地區。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Maps and data based on USGIS reveal severe impacts on the Navajo: high unemployment, low income, pollution and other challenges. Layers such as plumbing, unemployment, low household income, poverty and linguistic isolation show the relative backwardness of development on the reservation.
captions: Local GIS data analysis: why focus on the Navajo reservation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以 USGIS 為基礎的地圖與數據揭示納瓦霍族所受的嚴重衝擊：高失業率、低收入、污染與其他困境。管線設施、失業、家戶低收入、貧困與語言隔離等圖層，呈現保留區發展的相對落後。
captions: 在地 GIS 數據分析：為何聚焦納瓦霍保留區。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Once the relationships and ideas of the new system are clarified, a four-stage plan is implemented to realize it, from life and health and an abundance of food to economic income and improvement in the quality of life. Stage 1 remediates pollution in three types of land, water systems, contaminated areas and other land, with uranium-absorbing plants, soil replacement and greenhouses on new soil.
captions: Stage strategy to the new system, and the upper-level analysis and plan around the Red Water Pond Road community.
Stage 1, pollution remediation and land: three types of greenland restoration.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 釐清新系統的關係與構想後，以四個階段的計畫逐步實現：從生命健康、充足糧食，到經濟收入與生活品質的提升。第一階段針對水系、污染區與其他土地三類用地進行污染整治，運用吸收鈾的植物、更換土壤，並在新土上興建溫室。
captions: 通往新系統的階段策略，以及以 Red Water Pond Road 社區為中心的上位分析與計畫。
第一階段，污染整治與土地：三種綠地修復方式。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: After the uranium contamination is removed, a planting system responds to the living habits of the inhabitants, and the introduction of industries then boosts income and contributes to the restoration funds, starting in temporary low-cost buildings. In Stage 4, number four signifies cultural elements in Navajo philosophy, and diverse industries revitalize the polluted land to ensure stable income and employment.
captions: Stage 2: establishment of planting.
Stage 3: introduction of an industrial system.
A material production base for medical companies, and temporary infrastructure facilities based on the Navajo hogan.
Stage 4: community revitalization, with sections A-A and B-B.
Master plan.
Aerial views I and II.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 鈾污染清除後，種植系統回應居民的生活習慣；隨後引入的產業提高收入、挹注修復基金，並以臨時的低成本建築起步。在第四階段，數字四象徵納瓦霍哲學中的文化元素，多元產業讓受污染的土地重獲生機，確保穩定的收入與就業。
captions: 第二階段：建立種植系統。
第三階段：引入產業系統。
醫療公司的材料生產基地，以及以納瓦霍泥屋為原型的臨時基礎設施。
第四階段：社區復興，標示剖面 A-A 與 B-B。
總平面。
鳥瞰圖一與二。

sections.heading: Behind the Desert - Four Stages to Heal Land Poisoned by Uranium
sections.body: A film about the history of the atomic bomb led the student to learn that this story unfolded across a vast desert and highland, a canyon landscape long held in fascination. Deeper study showed through GIS data that an indigenous reservation there lags far behind in development. Maps and data reveal severe impacts: high unemployment, low income and pollution, while layers of plumbing, household income, poverty and linguistic isolation build up a picture of relative neglect. Once the relationships of a new system are clear, a four-stage plan carries it forward, from life and health and plentiful food to income and a better quality of life. Stage one cleans three kinds of land, water systems, contaminated areas and the rest, with uranium-absorbing plants, replaced soil and greenhouses on the new ground. With the contamination gone, a planting system answers the habits of residents, and new industries raise income and feed the restoration fund, starting in temporary low-cost buildings. In the fourth stage, the number four echoes the cultural meaning it holds in the people's own philosophy, as diverse industries bring the poisoned land back to life.

zh-Hant.heading: 沙漠背後-四個階段修復鈾礦污染的土地
zh-Hant.body: 一部講述原子彈歷史的電影上映，讓學生得知這段往事發生在一片廣闊的沙漠與高原，也就是長久以來令人著迷的峽谷地景。深入研究後，地理資訊數據顯示，當地原住民族保留區的整體發展遠遠落後。地圖與數據揭露嚴重的衝擊：高失業、低收入與污染。釐清新系統的關係與構想後，計畫分四個階段推進：從生命健康、充足糧食，到經濟收入與生活品質的提升。第一階段針對水系、污染區與其他土地進行整治，運用吸收鈾的植物、更換土壤，並在新土上興建溫室。污染清除後，種植系統回應居民的生活習慣；引入的產業提高收入、挹注修復基金。到了第四階段，數字四呼應族群哲學中的文化意涵，多元產業讓受污染的土地重獲生機，帶來穩定的收入與就業。

pins.title: Moving Golf Castle
pins.description:
Inspired by Kafka's The Castle, a speculative golf castle on the sea compresses Shenzhen's golf resorts and urban villages into one condensed world.

Shenzhen | Speculative landscape design | Creativity design | Jul–Aug and Nov–Dec 2023 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 移動的高爾夫城堡
zh-Hant.description:
受卡夫卡《城堡》啟發，一座海上的思辨性高爾夫城堡，將深圳的高爾夫度假村與城中村壓縮成一個濃縮的世界。

深圳｜思辨性景觀設計｜創意設計｜2023 年 7–8 月與 11–12 月｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The golf castle on the sea: golf castles loom large on the sea, vanity and wealth are laughed at, waves of mockery cover the sky.
海上的高爾夫城堡：高爾夫城堡在海上隱隱浮現，虛榮與財富被嘲笑，嘲諷的浪潮遮蔽天空。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Inspired by Kafka's novel The Castle, the student wanted to create a utopian world of their own that accommodated their social and political views. In Shenzhen, their hometown, golf and urban villages are the two most extreme spaces: the urban villages hold only a fifth of the city's floor space but are home to half of its population.
captions: Distribution of urban villages and golf courses in Shenzhen.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 受卡夫卡小說《城堡》啟發，學生想創造一個屬於自己、容納其社會與政治觀點的烏托邦世界。在家鄉深圳，高爾夫球場與城中村是最極端的兩種空間：城中村只占城市樓地板面積的五分之一，卻住著一半的人口。
captions: 深圳城中村與高爾夫球場的分布。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The urban villages are where most of the lower-middle-class people live, in dark, damp and crowded conditions where it is difficult to see any positive impact of modern landscape gardening. The project unfolds from the perspective of a landscape designer, expressing the current state of social class through glamorous golf and leisure resorts on the outside and the dark and complex city on the inside.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 城中村是多數中下階層居住的地方，陰暗、潮濕而擁擠，難以看見現代景觀造園帶來的任何正面影響。本案從景觀設計師的視角展開，以外部光鮮的高爾夫與休閒度假村、內部陰暗複雜的城市，表達當前的社會階級狀態。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A storyboard tells the story: in 2043 the Shenzhen Golf Company has become a monopoly because of its land in the city centre, and as revolt grows and losses mount, its staff look for solutions. They decide to move the golf course out of the city and compress all the industrial segments together, combining industry, poor housing and golf into one extremely condensed real world.
captions: Storyboard in nine frames: from the company's 2043 losses to the diagram of the target.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以分鏡講述故事：2043 年，深圳高爾夫公司因在市中心擁有大量土地而成為壟斷企業；隨著民眾反抗加劇、虧損擴大，公司員工尋求解方。他們決定把高爾夫球場移出城市，並把所有產業環節壓縮在一起，將工業、貧民住宅與高爾夫結合成一個極度濃縮的真實世界。
captions: 九格分鏡：從公司 2043 年的虧損到目標示意圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
