sections.body: The golf castle stacks a golf clubhouse, an outer surface mountain, a centre column for water and transport, factory and living quarters, workers' residences and the shell of the castle above ocean energy harvesting. Inside, the bottom of the castle, the living area, the industrial area and the residence area show the dark and complex city hidden under the glamorous resort.
captions: Exploded drawing of the golf castle.
Interior details: bottom of the castle, living area, industrial area and residence area.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 高爾夫城堡由上而下堆疊高爾夫俱樂部會所、外層山體、負責水與交通的中央柱、工廠與生活區、工人住宅與城堡外殼，最底層則是海洋能源採集。內部的城堡底部、生活區、工業區與住宅區，呈現隱藏在光鮮度假村之下陰暗而複雜的城市。
captions: 高爾夫城堡的爆炸圖。
內部細節：城堡底部、生活區、工業區與住宅區。

sections.heading: Moving Castle - Class Compressed Into a Golf Fortress
sections.body: Inspired by a novel about a castle, the student set out to build a utopia of one's own that could hold a set of social and political views. In the home city, golf courses and urban villages are the two most extreme kinds of space: the villages hold only a fifth of the city's floor area but house half of its people. Most of the lower middle class live in these dark, damp and crowded places. The project unfolds through the eyes of a landscape designer, expressing the present state of class through glamorous golf and leisure resorts on the outside and a dark, intricate city within. A storyboard tells a future tale: a golf company has become a monopoly through its land in the city centre, and as revolt grows and losses mount it decides to move the course out of the city and compress every industrial segment together, fusing industry, poor housing and golf into one dense and real world. From top to bottom the castle stacks a clubhouse, an outer mountain, factories, workers' homes and a shell above ocean energy harvesting, hiding a grim city beneath the resort.

zh-Hant.heading: 移動城堡-把階級壓縮成一座高爾夫要塞
zh-Hant.body: 受一部描寫城堡的小說啟發，學生想創造一個屬於自己的烏托邦，容納自身的社會與政治觀點。在家鄉的城市裡，高爾夫球場與城中村是最極端的兩種空間：城中村只占全市樓地板面積的五分之一，卻住著一半的人口。多數中下階層居住在陰暗、潮濕而擁擠的城中村。作品從景觀設計師的視角展開，以外部光鮮、內部陰暗的對照表達階級處境。一組分鏡講述未來的故事：一家高爾夫公司因掌握市中心大片土地而成為壟斷者，隨著民眾反抗與虧損加劇，公司決定把球場移出城市，並把所有產業環節壓縮在一起，讓工業、貧民住宅與高爾夫結合為一個極度濃縮的真實世界。城堡由上而下堆疊俱樂部會所、外層山體、工廠與生活區、工人住宅與外殼，最底層採集海洋能源。光鮮度假村之下，藏著陰暗而繁複的城市。

pins.title: Dead Sea
pins.description:
As the shrinking Dead Sea opens sinkholes near En Gedi, a route and a date palm boardwalk turn the hazard into a landscape and keep the harvest going.

En Gedi, Dead Sea | Landscape design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 死海
zh-Hant.description:
萎縮的死海在恩戈地附近形成天坑；一條路線與椰棗步道將危險轉化為地景，並讓採收得以延續。

死海恩戈地｜景觀設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Master plan near En Gedi: a route from the visitor centre and goat trail across a winter bridge and time corridor to a date palm boardwalk, a harvest site, a Dead Sea monument and a waterside platform.
恩戈地附近的總平面：一條路線從遊客中心與山羊步道出發，經過冬季橋與時間廊道，通往椰棗步道、採收體驗區、死海紀念碑與水岸平台。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In recent years the shrinking Dead Sea has led to the formation of sinkholes, transforming the karst landscapes while jeopardizing safety and disrupting daily lives. Access to date palm orchards is now elusive, and the tourism industry suffers as coastal retreat leads to the closure of Dead Sea beaches.
captions: The Dead Sea and En Gedi.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 近年來死海持續萎縮，形成大量天坑，改變了喀斯特地景，也危及安全、擾亂日常生活。人們難以進入椰棗園，海岸後退又使死海海灘關閉，觀光業因而受到衝擊。
captions: 死海與恩戈地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The Dead Sea area has intense heat and high evaporation, and climate change keeps raising average temperatures. Upstream canals pump water for northern plantations and cut off fresh water from the Jordan River, while potassium salt factories in the south pump seawater into evaporation ponds, and the Israel Geological Survey monitors the sinkholes and predicts new ones.
captions: Sinkhole monitoring, the shoreline from year to year, and how a sinkhole appears as fresh water dissolves underground salt.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 死海地區炎熱、蒸發量高，氣候變遷又使平均氣溫持續上升。上游運河為北部農園抽水，切斷了約旦河注入死海的淡水；南部的鉀鹽工廠則把海水抽進蒸發池，而以色列地質調查局持續監測天坑，並預測新天坑的出現。
captions: 天坑監測、逐年變化的海岸線，以及淡水溶蝕地下鹽層而形成天坑的過程。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Coconut dates make up one third of local residents' income, but sinkholes now appear in the date groves and harvesting machines cannot enter. Spanning a boardwalk over the small sinkholes lets the harvest continue and helps the agricultural economy recover.
captions: Geological structure, sinkholes in the date groves, the boardwalk solution and its structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 椰棗占在地居民收入的三分之一，但天坑如今出現在椰棗林中，採收機械無法進入。在小型天坑上架設步道，讓採收得以持續，也幫助農業經濟復甦。
captions: 地質構造、椰棗林中的天坑、步道解方及其結構。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The route links En Gedi with a visitor centre, a goat trail, a winter bridge, a time corridor, the date palm boardwalk, a harvest experience site, a Dead Sea monument, a waterside platform, the karst and a garden by Route 90. Sinkholes become part of the landscape experience instead of only a hazard.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這條路線串連恩戈地與遊客中心、山羊步道、冬季橋、時間廊道、椰棗步道、採收體驗區、死海紀念碑、水岸平台、喀斯特地景，以及 90 號公路旁的花園。天坑成為地景體驗的一部分，而不只是危險。

sections.heading: Sinkhole Shore - Boardwalks That Let Harvest and Travel Resume
sections.body: In recent years a shrinking salt lake has opened sinkholes across its shore, reshaping the karst landscape while threatening safety and unsettling daily life. Date palm orchards have become hard to reach, and as the shoreline retreats beaches close and tourism suffers. The area is intensely hot with high evaporation, and climate change keeps pushing average temperatures upward. Upstream canals pump water for plantations to the north and cut off the fresh water that a river once poured into the lake, while potash factories to the south pump lake water into evaporation ponds. Dates provide a third of local residents' income, yet sinkholes now appear among the palms where harvesting machines cannot go. Boardwalks laid across the smaller sinkholes allow the harvest to continue and help the farming economy recover. A route ties an oasis to a visitor centre, a goat trail, a winter bridge, a time corridor, the date palm boardwalk, a harvest experience, a monument, a waterside platform, the karst and a roadside garden. The sinkholes become part of how the landscape is experienced rather than only a hazard, showing visitors a land in the middle of change.

zh-Hant.heading: 鹹海天坑-以棧道讓採收與觀光重新上路
zh-Hant.body: 近年來，一座鹹水湖持續萎縮，大量天坑隨之形成，改變了喀斯特地景，也危及安全、擾亂日常生活。人們難以進入椰棗園，海岸後退又讓湖濱海灘陸續關閉，觀光業因而受創。這一帶酷熱、蒸發旺盛，氣候變遷更使平均氣溫不斷攀升。上游運河為北方農園抽水，切斷了河流注入湖中的淡水；南方的鉀鹽工廠則把湖水抽進蒸發池。椰棗占在地居民收入的三分之一，如今天坑卻出現在椰棗林中，採收機械無法進入。在小型天坑上架設棧道，讓採收得以延續，也幫助農業經濟逐步復甦。一條路線把綠洲與遊客中心、山羊步道、冬季橋、時間廊道、椰棗棧道、採收體驗區、紀念碑、水岸平台，以及公路旁的花園串連起來。天坑不再只是令人退避的危險，而成為地景體驗的一部分，讓人們看見土地正在經歷的變化。

pins.title: Norway in the Face of Climate Change
pins.description:
A Sami resilient landscape on Vanna Island, Norway, holding floodwater in cisterns and wetlands so lichen pastures can keep feeding reindeer through warmer winters.

Vanna Island, Norway | Resilient landscape design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 挪威面對氣候變遷
zh-Hant.description:
位於挪威瓦納島的薩米韌性地景，以蓄水池與濕地留住洪水，讓地衣牧場在更暖的冬季仍能餵養馴鹿。

挪威瓦納島｜韌性景觀設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Axonometric of the design layers: a stone beach, moss water trail, ecological education corridor, artificial cisterns and squares, hiking campsite and reindeer pasture, set against meadow, shrubs, sparse forest and dense forest.
設計層次的軸測圖：石灘、苔蘚水道、生態教育廊道、人工蓄水池與廣場、健行營地與馴鹿牧場，對應草甸、灌木、疏林與密林。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: With global warming, precipitation is becoming increasingly unstable, and in high-latitude regions such as Norway it shows up as frequent floods and drastic temperature swings. For the Sami people who still herd reindeer, it means the reindeer struggle to find food beneath ice layers and may starve, while the accelerating melt of glaciers makes this worse.
captions: Reindeer migration, the Sami dilemma of rain-on-snow events, the Vanna Island map, NDVI and the seasonal pastures.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 全球暖化使降水越來越不穩定，在挪威這樣的高緯度地區，表現為頻繁的洪水與劇烈的溫度變化。對仍以放牧馴鹿為生的薩米人而言，這意味著馴鹿難以在冰層下找到食物而可能餓死，冰川加速融化更讓情況惡化。
captions: 馴鹿遷徙、雨落雪事件造成的薩米困境、瓦納島地圖、NDVI 與四季牧場。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Vanna Island is a year-round pasture for the Sami people, with Sami collection areas, reindeer pastures and a diverse array of plants, including some endangered species. Its glacial valleys have steep higher elevations and overly flat lower areas that hinder water storage and drainage, and the existing river channels cannot handle the increased water volume during the flood season.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 瓦納島是薩米人的全年牧場，有薩米採集區、馴鹿牧場與豐富的植物，其中包括一些瀕危物種。島上冰川谷地高處陡峭、低處過於平坦，不利蓄水與排水，現有河道也無法承受汛期增加的水量。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Lichens, the reindeer's winter food, are most affected by water: there are nearly none in submerged areas, yet they thrive best close to water sources. The design therefore tests how stone, water and ice can keep lichen beds near water without drowning them.
captions: Lichen growth under changing temperature, water and light, and the sketch of how the design keeps lichen near water.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 地衣是馴鹿冬季的食物，最受水的影響：淹水區幾乎沒有地衣，但它們在靠近水源處長得最好。因此設計測試石頭、水與冰如何讓地衣床靠近水，卻不被淹沒。
captions: 地衣在溫度、水與光變化下的生長，以及設計如何讓地衣靠近水的草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: To address the floods the island needs more reservoirs and wetlands to manage and store floodwater. The layered landscape adds cisterns, a moss water trail and an ecological education corridor beside the reindeer pasture and hiking campsite, so that water is held and the pastures keep feeding the herd.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 為因應洪水，島上需要更多蓄水池與濕地來管理和儲存洪水。分層的地景在馴鹿牧場與健行營地旁加入蓄水池、苔蘚水道與生態教育廊道，讓水被留住，牧場也能持續餵養鹿群。

sections.heading: Lichen Ground - Keeping Winter Pasture Alive for the Reindeer
sections.body: Global warming makes precipitation ever more unstable, and in high-latitude regions it appears as frequent floods and sharp swings of temperature. For the indigenous herders who still raise reindeer, it means the animals struggle to find food beneath layers of ice and may starve. The island chosen for the project is a year-round pasture for the herders, with gathering grounds, reindeer pastures and a wide range of plants. Its glacial valleys are steep above and too flat below, so water is hard to store or drain, and the existing channels cannot carry the extra volume of the flood season. Lichens, the winter food of the reindeer, depend most on water: they are almost absent where land is submerged, yet thrive closest to water sources. The design therefore studies how stone, water and ice can keep lichen beds near water without drowning them. To meet the floods, the island needs more reservoirs and wetlands to manage and hold the water. A layered landscape adds cisterns, a moss water trail and an ecological education corridor beside the pasture, so that water is held gently and the pastures keep feeding the herd.

zh-Hant.heading: 地衣之地-為馴鹿留住冬季的牧場
zh-Hant.body: 全球暖化讓降水越發不穩定，在高緯度地區，表現為頻繁的洪水與劇烈的溫度變化。對仍以放牧馴鹿為生的原住民族而言，這意味著馴鹿難以在冰層下覓得食物而可能餓死。作品所在的島嶼是牧民的全年牧場，有採集區、馴鹿牧場與豐富的植物。島上的冰川谷地高處陡峭、低處過於平坦，不利蓄水與排水，現有河道也無法承受汛期暴增的水量。地衣是馴鹿冬季的主食，也最受水的影響：淹水之處幾乎不見地衣，靠近水源之處卻長得最好。設計因此探究石頭、水與冰如何讓地衣床親近水源，卻不致被淹沒。為了因應洪水，島上需要更多蓄水池與濕地來調節並儲存洪水。分層的地景在馴鹿牧場與健行營地旁加入蓄水池、苔蘚水道與生態教育廊道，讓水被溫柔地留住，牧場也得以年復一年地餵養鹿群。

pins.title: Xinzao Ferry Terminal Park
pins.description:
A ferry terminal in Guangzhou facing closure becomes a park on the greenway, shaped by a resonance concept and by the sanitation workers who use it most.

Guangzhou, China | Landscape design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 新造渡口公園
zh-Hant.description:
面臨關閉的廣州渡口轉型為綠道上的公園，以共振概念與最常使用它的清潔工人為設計依據。

中國廣州｜景觀設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Aerial view of the ferry terminal park on the riverbank, with the Xinzao ferry route and the Guangzhou greenway system.
河岸渡口公園鳥瞰，含新造渡輪航線與廣州綠道系統。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The Xinzao ferry terminal in Guangzhou began operating in 1991 and was once prosperous, but around 2010 a policy of building bridges and dismantling ferries brought elevated roads, subways and an under-river tunnel nearby. Other terminals on the island closed in 2019, and with the Jinguang Tunnel about to open this one also faces closure, although it holds urban memories as well as serving transport.
captions: Government planning of the greenway, with ferries still in operation and ferries closed.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州新造渡口於 1991 年啟用，曾經興盛；但約在 2010 年，「建橋撤渡」的政策讓高架道路、地鐵與過江隧道陸續在附近興建。島上其他渡口已於 2019 年關閉，隨著金光隧道即將完工，這個渡口也面臨關閉，然而它不只服務交通，也承載著城市記憶。
captions: 政府的綠道規劃，以及仍在營運與已關閉的渡口。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Visitor analysis found that 75% of passengers are sanitation workers who need a resting place, shade and quick access to the exit road. The strategy map links the site to nearby villages, universities, the Lingnan Impression Garden and abandoned green spaces, so the terminal can become a ferry terminal park.
captions: Design strategy linking the terminal to the surrounding villages, campuses and green spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 訪客分析發現 75% 的乘客是清潔工人，他們需要休息處、遮蔭，以及快速通往出口道路的路徑。策略圖把基地與周邊村落、大學、嶺南印象園與廢棄綠地串連起來，讓渡口轉型為渡口公園。
captions: 將渡口與周邊村落、校園及綠地串連的設計策略。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Resonance in physics is a system vibrating with greater amplitude at specific frequencies; here the original site, the design and the people act together so the functional zones resonate. Road planning first gives ferry passengers swift access to the port, three main zones follow (riverside, ecological nature and underground parking), they permeate each other into smaller areas, and secondary park roads finish the first draft.
captions: The resonance concept: original site, design and people.
Design procedure in four steps.
Design strategies, from waterfront platforms and a suspension bridge to a playground and a rain garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 物理中的共振指系統在特定頻率下以更大的振幅振動；在這裡，原有基地、設計與人共同作用，讓各功能區產生共振。先規劃道路，讓渡輪乘客快速抵達碼頭，再劃出三大功能區（河岸、生態自然與地下停車），三者相互滲透成更小的區域，最後以次級園路完成初步方案。
captions: 共振概念：原有基地、設計與人。
四個步驟的設計程序。
設計策略：從水岸平台、吊橋到遊戲場與雨水花園。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The park brings together the Xinzao ferry, a ferry café and front plaza, a riverside square, an artificial island, a play space, a bioretention basin and an entrance square. The physical model tests the café, the riverside promenade, the suspension bridge and the waterfront platform.
captions: Floor plan with the sustainable design diagrams and cross-sections of the riverside plaza and play space.
Architectural floor plan and elevation of the ferry terminal café.
Model: ferry terminal café and front plaza, riverside promenade, suspension bridge and waterfront platform.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 公園整合了新造渡口、渡口咖啡館與前廣場、河岸廣場、人工島、遊戲空間、生物滯留池與入口廣場。實體模型則用來檢驗咖啡館、河岸步道、吊橋與水岸平台。
captions: 總平面，含永續設計圖解，以及河岸廣場與遊戲空間的剖面。
渡口咖啡館的建築平面與立面。
模型：渡口咖啡館與前廣場、河岸步道、吊橋與水岸平台。

sections.heading: Ferry Resonance - Turning a Closing Pier Into a Park
sections.body: A ferry pier that opened over thirty years ago and once thrived has watched elevated roads, a subway and an under-river tunnel rise around it under a policy of building bridges and dismantling ferries. Other piers on the island have already closed, and with a new tunnel about to open this one faces the same end, though it carries the memory of the city as well as passengers. Visitor analysis found that three quarters of the riders are sanitation workers who need rest, shade and a quick path to the exit road. A strategy map links the site with nearby villages, universities and abandoned green spaces so that the pier can become a ferry park. In physics, resonance is a system vibrating with greater amplitude at certain frequencies; here the original site, the design and its users act together so that the zones resonate. Roads come first, giving passengers swift access to the pier, then three zones, riverside, ecological nature and underground parking, permeate one another into smaller areas. The park gathers the pier, a café and forecourt, an artificial island, play space and a bioretention basin, tested in a physical model.

zh-Hant.heading: 渡口共振-讓即將關閉的碼頭化為公園
zh-Hant.body: 一座啟用三十多年、曾經興盛的渡口，在「建橋撤渡」的政策下，周圍陸續出現高架道路、地鐵與過江隧道；島上其他渡口已相繼關閉，隨著新隧道即將通車，這裡也面臨停駛。然而渡口不只承擔交通，更承載著城市的記憶。訪客分析發現，四分之三的乘客是清潔工人，需要休息處、遮蔭，以及快速通往出口道路的路徑。策略圖把基地與周邊村落、大學與廢棄綠地串連起來，讓渡口轉型為渡口公園。物理學中的共振，是系統在特定頻率下以更大振幅振動；在這裡，原有基地、設計與人共同作用，讓各功能區彼此共鳴。設計先規劃道路，讓乘客迅速抵達碼頭，再劃出河岸、生態自然與地下停車三大區域。公園整合渡口、咖啡館與前廣場、河岸廣場、人工島、遊戲空間、生物滯留池與入口廣場，並以實體模型檢驗。

pins.title: Modern Chinese Garden, Shaoxing
pins.description:
A deserted street corner in Shaoxing becomes a new Chinese garden without walls, where grass stands in for water and the paving becomes islands linked by bridges.

Shaoxing, Zhejiang, China | Landscape design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 紹興新中式園林
zh-Hant.description:
紹興一處冷清的街角轉化為沒有圍牆的新中式園林：以草地代替水面，鋪面成為以橋相連的島。

中國浙江紹興｜景觀設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Plan of the street corner garden: grass stands in for water, and the hard ground becomes islands connected by bridges.
街角花園平面：以草地取代水面，硬質鋪面成為以橋相連的島。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Shaoxing in Zhejiang belongs to the Jiangnan region, renowned for its traditional Chinese gardens, but traditional gardens are often private, with enclosed spaces and walls that suit modern living less well. The site, once the employee dormitory of a silk weaving factory, was demolished for a road widening and is now a deserted corner park with no visitors.
captions: Site analysis of the surrounding blocks, river and roads.
Surrounding land use: traditional gardens, urban green space and residential areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 浙江紹興屬於以傳統中國園林聞名的江南地區，但傳統園林多半私密，空間封閉、圍牆高築，不太適合現代生活。基地原是絲織廠的員工宿舍，因道路拓寬而拆除，如今是一座沒有訪客的冷清街角公園。
captions: 周邊街廓、河流與道路的基地分析。
周邊土地使用：傳統園林、城市綠地與住宅區。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Traditional Chinese gardens rest on a few core elements: piled stone hills, organic water, plant matching and architecture. Comparing them with new Chinese-style gardens shows how the same elements can open up to the street.
captions: The elements of the traditional garden compared with the new Chinese-style garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 傳統中國園林建立在幾個核心元素上：疊石假山、有機的水、植物配置與建築。將其與新中式園林比較，可以看出同樣的元素如何向街道開放。
captions: 傳統園林元素與新中式園林的比較。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Since there is no water on the site, grass replaces water because the two share similar textures and sensations, and the hard ground portions become islands connected by bridges. The scenes move from an entrance plaza through a framed composition and a lawn lake to the island.
captions: Entrance plaza, frame composition, lawn lake and island, with the sectional diagram.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 由於基地沒有水，設計以草地取代水面，因為兩者有相似的質地與感受，硬質鋪面則成為以橋相連的島。場景從入口廣場、框景、草湖一路走到島上。
captions: 入口廣場、框景、草湖與島，以及剖面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model highlights the garden's active right half, surrounded by three artificial hills that create cozy spaces, with corridors, waterside pavilions, a stone door and an island inspired by the Su Causeway at West Lake. It combines traditional Chinese techniques with modern elements in an open space without walls, while the designer still adjusts the rockeries by eye because traditional rockeries have no blueprints.
captions: Model overview of the garden.
Short corridor, long corridor, waterside pavilion, waterside corridor and pavilion.
Pavilions, the stone door, the island and the changing scenery with each step.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型呈現花園熱鬧的右半部，三座人工假山圍出舒適的空間，並配置廊道、水榭、石門，以及取材自西湖蘇堤的島。它結合傳統中國技法與現代元素，形成沒有圍牆的開放空間；由於傳統假山沒有藍圖，設計者仍須憑眼睛調整假山的形態。
captions: 花園模型全景。
短廊、長廊、水榭、水廊與亭。
亭、石門、島，以及步移景異。

sections.heading: A Garden Without Walls - Grass for Water on a New-Style Street Corner
sections.body: The region around this city is famed for its traditional gardens, yet such gardens are mostly private, closed in by walls and enclosed rooms that sit uneasily with modern life. The site, once the staff dormitory of a silk weaving factory, was cleared for a road widening and is now a deserted corner park that no one visits. The research finds that traditional gardens rest on a few core elements: piled stone hills, freely shaped water, the matching of plants, and buildings. Set beside new-style gardens, they show how the same elements can open toward the street. With no water on the site, grass takes the place of water because the two share a similar texture and feeling, and the hard paved areas become islands joined by bridges. The model shows the busy right half of the garden, where three artificial hills enclose comfortable corners among corridors, waterside pavilions, a stone door and an island recalling a famous causeway. Old craft meets modern elements in an open space without walls, and because rockeries have never had blueprints, the stones are still adjusted by eye.

zh-Hant.heading: 無牆之園-以草為水的新中式街角
zh-Hant.body: 這座城市所在的地區以傳統園林聞名，但傳統園林多半私密，空間封閉、圍牆高築。基地原是一座絲織廠的員工宿舍，因道路拓寬而拆除，如今成了一座無人造訪的冷清街角公園。研究指出，傳統園林建立在幾個核心元素之上：疊石假山、自由流動的水、植物配置與建築；與新中式園林相比，可以看出同樣的元素如何向街道敞開。基地沒有水，設計便以草地取代水面，因為兩者有著相近的質地與感受；硬質鋪面則化為以橋相連的島。模型呈現花園熱鬧的右半部，三座人工假山圍出宜人的角落，並配置廊道、水榭、石門，以及取意於名湖長堤的島。傳統技法與現代元素在沒有圍牆的開放空間中相遇；由於傳統假山從無藍圖，設計者仍須憑眼睛一點點調整山石的形態，讓手與眼延續古老的造園之道。

pins.title: Earthen Elegance
pins.description:
A community education centre in Busua, Ghana, built from tested rammed earth, stone and timber, with roofs and louvers shaped for the hot, rainy tropical climate.

Busua, Ghana | Architecture design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 土之雅
zh-Hant.description:
位於迦納布蘇亞的社區教育中心，以經過測試的夯土、石與木構建造，屋頂與百葉依炎熱多雨的熱帶氣候而成形。

迦納布蘇亞｜建築設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Physical testing model of the timber roof over the rammed earth walls.
木構屋頂與夯土牆的實體測試模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project looks for local solutions for remote areas most affected by climate change, here a community education centre in Busua, a beach resort and fishing village in the Western Region of Ghana with over 5,000 people. Earth is well suited to extreme climates and has a long local history, but rammed earth limits design flexibility, its strength is uncertain with manual compaction, and it is not sufficiently waterproof.
captions: Context mapping of Busua: access way, woodland, residential settlement, tourist facilities and the commercial belt.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案為最受氣候變遷影響的偏遠地區尋找在地解方：在迦納西部省的海灘度假地與漁村布蘇亞，為五千多位居民設計一座社區教育中心。土適合極端氣候，在當地也有悠久的使用歷史，但夯土限制了設計彈性，以人工夯實時強度不確定，防水性也不足。
captions: 布蘇亞的脈絡分析：通道、林地、主要聚落、觀光設施與商業帶。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Local construction techniques are rudimentary, making houses prone to damage, and the climate brings high temperatures and heavy rainfall. Rammed earth walls store heat from sunlight during the day and release it at night, and a comparison of concrete, wood, bamboo, earth and mudbrick weighs strength, water resistance, workability, thermal insulation and recyclability.
captions: Case 3 on the thermal behaviour of rammed earth, and the comparison of building material performance.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 當地的營造技術簡陋，房屋容易損壞，氣候又高溫多雨。夯土牆白天儲存日照的熱，夜間再釋放；設計並比較混凝土、木、竹、土與泥磚在強度、防水、施工性、隔熱與可回收性上的表現。
captions: 案例三：夯土的熱性能，以及建材性能比較。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Rammed earth formula experiments mixed sand and clay with additives such as fly ash, vermiculite, gypsum, basalt granules, tile ash and glutinous rice flour and compared their strength, expansion and viscosity. Dry-stacked stone bases, a mix of rammed earth and timber, external louvers and thatched roofing on inclined planes then amplify convection and induce passive ventilation against the hot, humid and rainy tropical climate.
captions: Rammed earth formula experiment and improvement.
Environmental effects of the materials and their proportions in the project.
Design development from program volume to roof and skylights, with the spatial arrangement.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 夯土配方實驗在砂與黏土中加入飛灰、蛭石、石膏、玄武岩顆粒、瓦灰與糯米粉等添加物，比較其強度、膨脹與黏性。乾砌石基、夯土與木構的結合、外部百葉，以及斜面茅草屋頂，加強對流並引導被動通風，以因應炎熱、潮濕又多雨的熱帶氣候。
captions: 夯土配方實驗與改良。
各材料的環境影響及其在本案中的比例。
從量體到屋頂與天窗的設計推演，以及空間配置。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The centre combines a thatched roof on a timber frame, rammed earth walls on stone bases with concrete capping beams, louvers for ventilation, windows with solar shading and funnel-shaped windows with a rainwater collection basin. It shows that reinforced concrete need not be the universal answer, and that traditional local materials and forms can bridge history and modernity.
captions: Sectional view: outdoor activity space, corridor, dormitory, indoor activity space, rainwater collection and garden.
Structural strategies, from the thatched roof to the timber supporting structure.
Construction detail of the straw roof, stone base and rammed earth walls.
Axonometric section, detailed drawings and model views.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這座中心結合木構架上的茅草屋頂、立於石基並以混凝土壓頂梁收邊的夯土牆、通風百葉、遮陽窗，以及搭配雨水收集池的漏斗形窗。它說明鋼筋混凝土不必是唯一答案，傳統的在地材料與形式也能連結歷史與現代。
captions: 剖面：戶外活動空間、廊道、宿舍、室內活動空間、雨水收集與花園。
結構策略：從茅草屋頂到木構支撐。
茅草屋頂、石基與夯土牆的構造細部。
軸測剖面、細部圖與模型。

sections.heading: Earthen Elegance - Improved Rammed Earth for a Tropical Climate
sections.body: The project looks for local answers for remote places hit hardest by climate change, here a community education centre for a beach resort and fishing village of more than five thousand people. Earth suits extreme climates and has a long local history, yet rammed earth limits design freedom, its strength is uncertain when compacted by hand, and it does not keep out enough water. Local building methods are rudimentary, houses are easily damaged, and the climate brings heat and heavy rain; rammed earth walls store the warmth of the sun by day and release it at night. Formula experiments mix sand and clay with fly ash, vermiculite, gypsum, basalt granules, tile ash and glutinous rice flour, comparing strength, expansion and viscosity. Dry-stacked stone bases, earth combined with timber, external louvers and thatch on inclined roofs strengthen convection and draw passive ventilation through the building. The centre joins a thatched timber roof, earth walls capped with concrete beams, shaded windows and funnel windows above a rainwater basin, showing that reinforced concrete need not be the universal answer.

zh-Hant.heading: 土之雅-以改良夯土回應熱帶氣候
zh-Hant.body: 作品為最受氣候變遷衝擊的偏遠地區尋找在地解方：在一座擁有五千多位居民的海濱漁村，設計一座社區教育中心。土適合極端氣候，在當地也有悠久的使用歷史，但夯土限制了設計的彈性，人工夯實的強度難以掌握，防水性也不足。當地營造技術簡陋，房屋容易損壞，氣候又高溫多雨；夯土牆白天儲存日照的熱，夜間緩緩釋放。夯土配方實驗在砂與黏土中加入飛灰、石膏、瓦灰與糯米粉等添加物。乾砌石基、夯土與木構的結合、外部百葉，以及斜面茅草屋頂，共同加強對流、引導被動通風。中心由木構架上的茅草屋頂、立於石基並以混凝土壓頂梁收邊的夯土牆、遮陽窗，以及連接雨水收集池的漏斗形窗構成。它說明鋼筋混凝土不必是唯一的答案，傳統的在地材料與形式，同樣能架起歷史與現代之間的橋。

pins.title: Spine Museum
pins.description:
A museum in Macau whose twisted floors and walls are generated from the ways a spine curves, contrasting compression and softness.

Macau | Urban design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 脊椎博物館
zh-Hant.description:
位於澳門的博物館，以脊椎彎曲的方式生成扭轉的樓板與牆體，對比壓縮與柔軟。

澳門｜都市設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Design layers of the museum, from the epidermal structure and translucent skin to the air corridor, movable planes and columnar structure, with interior views.
博物館的設計層次：從表皮結構、半透明外皮到空氣廊道、可動樓板與柱狀結構，並附室內視角。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Changes in the body's form can reflect shifts in a person's state of consciousness, and prolonged stress stiffens the muscles until muscle memory leads to skeletal deformities. Attention to physical health is growing, yet orthopaedic issues are rising and spinal health worsens with age.
captions: Spinal health from young children to the elderly, and the rise of orthopaedics and traumatology among hospital departments.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 身體形態的變化可以反映一個人意識狀態的轉變；長期的壓力會讓肌肉僵硬，最終因肌肉記憶而造成骨骼變形。人們越來越關注身體健康，但骨科問題持續增加，脊椎健康也隨年齡惡化。
captions: 從幼童到長者的脊椎健康，以及骨科與創傷科在各科別中的增長。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Macau's international tourism, strategic position and diverse audience make it an accessible place for a museum that promotes understanding of the spine's role in the body. To read the spine, the Cobb angle in scoliosis is measured between lines drawn perpendicular to the most tilted vertebrae, and the curvature is sorted into twist, asymmetry, bend, tilt and unbalance.
captions: Measuring the Cobb angle.
Twist, asymmetry, bend, tilt and unbalance in spinal models.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 澳門的國際觀光、地理位置與多元的觀眾，使它成為一座推廣理解脊椎角色的博物館的合適地點。為了閱讀脊椎，以脊椎側彎的柯布角量測最傾斜椎骨間的角度，並將彎曲分為扭轉、不對稱、彎曲、傾斜與失衡。
captions: 量測柯布角。
脊椎模型中的扭轉、不對稱、彎曲、傾斜與失衡。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The power of softness balances the mind, so each curvature becomes a spatial operation: curves extruded into floors, contoured spaces with opposing curves, dividers with vertical curves and lines extruded into dividers. A parametric script then lofts the curves into a structural framework and layering.
captions: Concept development from twist to lines, and the structural generation.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 柔軟的力量能平衡心靈，因此每一種彎曲都成為一個空間操作：曲線擠出成樓板、以相對曲線形成起伏空間、以垂直曲線形成隔間，以及把線條擠出成隔牆。接著以參數化程式將曲線放樣成結構框架與層次。
captions: 從扭轉到線條的概念推演，以及結構生成。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The ground floor holds a grand lobby, exhibition areas, special exhibits, a café and a gift shop, and the second and third floors hold the main exhibition halls and screening rooms. Twisted spaces form both intimate enclosures and open corridors, contrasting compression and softness so visitors refocus on their own bodies.
captions: Exhibition and ground floor plans, and sections A–A to D–D.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一樓設有大廳、展覽區、特展、咖啡館與禮品店，二、三樓則是主展廳與放映室。扭轉的空間同時形成親密的包覆與開放的廊道，以壓縮與柔軟的對比，讓參觀者重新關注自己的身體。
captions: 展覽層與一樓平面，以及 A–A 至 D–D 剖面。

sections.heading: Spine Museum - Soft Curves That Return Visitors to Their Bodies
sections.body: Changes in the form of the body can mirror shifts in a person's state of mind, and long stress stiffens the muscles until muscle memory bends the skeleton out of shape. Attention to physical health keeps rising, yet orthopaedic problems are increasing and the spine tends to worsen with age. An international tourist city, with its strategic position and diverse audience, offers a fitting place for a museum that helps people understand the role of the spine. To read the spine, the Cobb angle of scoliosis is measured between the most tilted vertebrae, and curvature is sorted into twist, asymmetry, bend, tilt and imbalance. The power of softness can balance the mind, so each kind of curve becomes a spatial operation: curves extruded into floors, opposing curves shaping contoured rooms, vertical curves forming dividers, and lines pulled up into partitions. A parametric script lofts the curves into a structural frame and its layers. Floors hold a lobby, exhibition halls, a café and screening rooms. Twisted spaces close into intimate enclosures and open into corridors, and the play of compression and softness turns visitors back toward their own bodies.

zh-Hant.heading: 脊椎之館-以柔軟的曲線喚回身體意識
zh-Hant.body: 身體形態的變化，可以映照一個人意識狀態的轉變；長期的壓力讓肌肉僵硬，最終經由肌肉記憶造成骨骼變形。骨科問題日增，脊椎也隨年齡衰退。一座國際觀光城市的區位與多元觀眾，使它成為推廣理解脊椎角色的博物館的合適所在。為了閱讀脊椎，研究以脊椎側彎的柯布角量測最傾斜椎骨之間的角度。柔軟的力量能平衡心靈，於是每一種彎曲都轉化為一項空間操作：曲線擠出為樓板，相對的曲線形成起伏的空間，垂直曲線成為隔間，線條擠出為隔牆。參數化程式再把曲線放樣為結構框架與層次。各層容納大廳、展廳、咖啡館與放映室。扭轉的空間時而形成親密的包覆，時而展開為開放的廊道，以壓縮與柔軟的對比，讓參觀者重新凝視並感受自己的身體。

pins.title: Data Transmission
pins.description:
A data centre in Redwood City, Silicon Valley, moved from the urban margin onto a highway interchange, growing as a visible structure as data grows.

Redwood City, Silicon Valley | Urban design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 資料傳輸
zh-Hant.description:
位於矽谷紅木城的資料中心，從城市邊緣移到高速公路交流道上，隨資料增長而擴展為可見的結構。

矽谷紅木城｜都市設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Facade of the data structure: stacked frames, storage modules and a red circulation core.
資料建築的立面：堆疊的框架、儲存模組與紅色的交通核。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Data has become a pivotal global resource that both democratizes access and concentrates control, including the misuse of personal data often unknown to individuals. Data centres, the physical manifestation of data, still sit as isolated infrastructure on the urban margins, even though what we perceive as virtual globalization rests on tangible physical carriers.
captions: Physical data transmission channels around the world.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 資料已成為關鍵的全球資源，既讓取得資訊更加普及，也使控制更加集中，包括個人資料在當事人不知情下被濫用。資料中心作為資料的實體化身，仍然是位於城市邊緣的孤立基礎設施，然而我們所認為的虛擬全球化，其實建立在有形的實體載體之上。
captions: 全球的實體資料傳輸通道。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site is a flyover bridge in Redwood City, Silicon Valley, beside a highway interchange. The concept reads social interaction, conversation and records as inputs that are transmitted and returned as feedback, interface and analysis, and asks which functional buildings future cities will need in an era of information explosion.
captions: Concept: input, transmission and utilization of data.
Strategy: analysis, problem, and the relation between new construction, nature, society and network.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地是矽谷紅木城一處緊鄰高速公路交流道的高架橋。概念把社交互動、對話與紀錄視為輸入，經傳輸後回饋為反饋、介面與分析，並提問：在資訊爆炸的時代，未來城市需要什麼樣的功能建築。
captions: 概念：資料的輸入、傳輸與利用。
策略：分析、問題，以及新建築、自然、社會與網絡之間的關係。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Form exploration tests the relationship between structure and living spaces, changes in structural patterns and spatial relationships, and individual architectural forms. A program diagram arranges every function around the speed of data transmission, and structural facades, planar spaces and stacked combinations develop the form.
captions: Generation and form exploration along the interchange.
Program diagram arranged around data transmission.
Formation development and stacking of forms.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 形態探索測試結構與生活空間的關係、結構模式與空間關係的變化，以及個別建築形態。機能圖依資料傳輸的速度安排所有機能，再以結構立面、平面空間與堆疊組合發展形態。
captions: 沿交流道的生成與形態探索。
圍繞資料傳輸安排的機能圖。
形態發展與量體堆疊。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Designed alongside the interchange and integrated with the highway, the building consists of high-speed transit, a central core, the main building body and a data storage exterior. As the data grows the building expands into a complex of structures, turning the data centre from a storage facility into a visible participant in the city.
captions: Model-making: facade generation, perspectives, corridor and interior.
Scene renderings, from the overall view and central core to the overpass, facades and street scenes.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築沿交流道設計並與高速公路整合，由高速運輸、中央核心、主體建築與資料儲存外殼組成。隨著資料增長，建築擴展為一組結構群，讓資料中心從儲存設施轉變為城市中可見的參與者。
captions: 模型製作：立面生成、透視、廊道與室內。
場景渲染：從整體、中央核心到高架、立面與街景。

sections.heading: City of Data - Bringing the Data Centre in From the Urban Margin
sections.body: Data has become a pivotal global resource that both widens access and concentrates control, and personal data is often misused without the knowledge of those it describes. Data centres, the physical form of data, still sit as isolated infrastructure on the margins of cities, even though what feels like virtual globalisation rests on tangible physical carriers. The site is a flyover beside a highway interchange in a centre of the technology industry. The concept reads social interaction, conversation and records as inputs that are transmitted and returned as feedback, interface and analysis, and it asks which functional buildings future cities will need in an age of information explosion. Form studies test how structure meets living space. A programme diagram arranges every function by the speed of data transmission, and structural facades, planar spaces and stacked combinations develop the form step by step. Shaped along the interchange and joined to the highway, the building consists of high-speed transit, a central core, the main body and a data storage skin. As data grows, it expands into a cluster of structures, turning the data centre from a closed store into a visible participant in the city.

zh-Hant.heading: 資料之城-讓資料中心走出城市邊緣
zh-Hant.body: 資料已成為關鍵的全球資源，既讓取得資訊更加普及，也使控制更加集中。資料中心作為資料的實體化身，仍是孤立於城市邊緣的基礎設施，然而人們所以為的虛擬全球化，其實奠基在有形的實體載體之上。基地選在科技重鎮一處緊鄰高速公路交流道的高架橋。概念把社交互動、對話與紀錄視為輸入，經傳輸後回饋為反饋、介面與分析，並追問：在資訊爆炸的時代，未來城市需要什麼樣的功能建築？形態探索測試結構與生活空間的關係。機能圖依資料傳輸的速度安排所有機能。建築沿交流道設計並與高速公路整合，由高速運輸、中央核心、主體建築與資料儲存外殼組成。隨著資料不斷增長，建築擴展為一組結構群，讓資料中心從封閉的倉庫，蛻變為城市中清晰可見的參與者。

pins.title: Whale Harmony: Climate Guardians
pins.description:
Floating ice-floe buildings and artificial sea ice in Isfjorden, Svalbard, protecting Arctic whales as the sea ice disappears.

Isfjorden, Svalbard | Landscape design | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 鯨之和鳴：氣候守護者
zh-Hant.description:
在斯瓦巴群島伊斯峽灣以漂浮的浮冰建築與人工海冰，於海冰消失之際守護北極鯨魚。

斯瓦巴群島伊斯峽灣｜景觀設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Isfjorden master plan: whale sanctuary, channel concentration area and the Floe Fusion Eco-connectscape.
伊斯峽灣總平面：鯨魚保護區、航道集中區與浮冰融合生態連結景觀。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Arctic sea ice is declining, opening shipping routes that could cut Europe–Asia shipping time by up to 50 % and bringing more oil, gas and tourism activity into Arctic waters. Sea-ice loss drives industrialization, more shipping and fishing, ecological imbalance and a feedback loop of lower reflectivity that amplifies climate change.
captions: Arctic future overview, sea-ice decline, future shipping routes and the impact of sea-ice loss.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 北極海冰持續減少，開啟的航道可讓歐亞航運時間縮短多達 50%，也把更多石油、天然氣與觀光活動帶進北極水域。海冰流失帶來工業化、航運與捕撈增加、生態失衡，以及反照率下降並放大氣候變遷的回饋循環。
captions: 北極未來概覽、海冰減少、未來航道與海冰流失的影響。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Bowhead whales, narwhals and white whales live in the Arctic year round, and whale records cluster around Svalbard's fjords. Whales act as a carbon pump: one whale fall stores about 33 tons of CO2, and the nutrients whales release feed the phytoplankton that capture carbon.
captions: Arctic whale distribution and migration, and whale distribution in Svalbard.
Carbon cycle diagram of whale activity: the whale pump and whale fall.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 弓頭鯨、獨角鯨與白鯨終年生活在北極，而鯨魚紀錄集中在斯瓦巴群島的峽灣周邊。鯨魚扮演碳泵的角色：一次鯨落約可封存 33 噸二氧化碳，鯨魚釋放的養分則滋養捕捉碳的浮游植物。
captions: 北極鯨魚分布與遷徙，以及斯瓦巴群島的鯨魚分布。
鯨魚活動的碳循環圖：鯨魚泵與鯨落。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The strategy replaces melting sea ice with artificial sea ice in stages from 2022 to 2100, adds transparent, uneven polycarbonate ecological installations for photosynthesis, and collects whale signals through drones, sonar and machine learning. Ice-floe forms become floating buildings with ecological installations below, housing scientific research, a drone platform, plant ecology, a whale-watching centre, a dock and a sea-fishing platform.
captions: Strategy: artificial sea ice, ecological installation and whale signal acquisition.
Floe Fusion Eco-connectscape: morphogenesis from ice floe to building, float and installation, and the six functions.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 策略從 2022 到 2100 年分階段以人工海冰取代融化的海冰，加入透明而凹凸的聚碳酸酯生態裝置以利光合作用，並透過無人機、聲納與機器學習收集鯨魚訊號。浮冰形態轉化為下方掛有生態裝置的漂浮建築，容納科學研究、無人機平台、植物生態、賞鯨中心、碼頭與海釣平台。
captions: 策略：人工海冰、生態裝置與鯨魚訊號擷取。
浮冰融合生態連結景觀：從浮冰到建築、浮體與裝置的形態生成，以及六種機能。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In Isfjorden, where ships and whales passing through will increase as the ice disappears, the master plan sets a whale sanctuary, vessel speed limits and a concentrated channel to avoid collisions. Over time the floating buildings take over from the sea ice, giving habitat to phytoplankton and fish while scientific research and tourism develop alongside.
captions: Sectional view over time: the near future and 100 years later.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在伊斯峽灣，隨著海冰消失，通過的船隻與鯨魚都將增加；總平面設定鯨魚保護區、船速限制與集中航道，以避免船鯨碰撞。隨著時間推移，漂浮建築接替海冰，為浮游植物與魚類提供棲地，科學研究與觀光也同步發展。
captions: 隨時間變化的剖面：近未來與一百年後。

sections.heading: Whale Harmony - Floating Ice to Take Over From a Melting Sea
sections.body: Arctic sea ice is shrinking, opening routes that could cut intercontinental shipping time by up to half. The loss of ice drives industrialisation, more shipping and fishing, ecological imbalance, and a feedback loop of lower reflectivity that amplifies climate change. Bowhead whales, narwhals and white whales live in the Arctic all year, and sightings cluster around the fjords of an archipelago. Whales work as a carbon pump: a single whale fall stores about thirty-three tons of carbon dioxide, and the nutrients whales release feed the phytoplankton that capture carbon. The strategy replaces melting sea ice with artificial ice in stages over the coming decades, adds transparent, uneven polycarbonate installations for photosynthesis, and gathers whale signals through drones, sonar and machine learning. Ice-floe forms become floating buildings with ecological installations hanging beneath, holding research, a whale-watching centre and a dock. In a fjord where ships and whales will meet more often, the plan sets a sanctuary, speed limits and a concentrated channel to avoid collisions. The buildings gradually take over from the ice, sheltering plankton and fish while research and tourism grow alongside.

zh-Hant.heading: 鯨之和鳴-以漂浮之冰接替消融的海
zh-Hant.body: 北極海冰持續消退，新開的航道可讓洲際航運時間縮短近半。海冰流失帶來生態失衡，以及反照率下降、進一步放大氣候變遷的回饋循環。弓頭鯨、獨角鯨與白鯨終年棲居北極，鯨群紀錄集中於群島的峽灣周邊。鯨魚是海洋的碳泵：一次鯨落約可封存三十多噸二氧化碳，鯨魚釋放的養分又滋養捕捉碳的浮游植物。策略在數十年間分階段以人工海冰取代消融的海冰，加入透明而凹凸的聚碳酸酯生態裝置以利光合作用，並以聲納與機器學習聆聽鯨群。浮冰的形態轉化為漂浮建築，下方懸掛生態裝置，容納科學研究、賞鯨中心與碼頭。在船隻與鯨群日漸交會的峽灣裡，總體規劃設定保護區、船速限制與集中航道以避免碰撞。漂浮建築逐步接替海冰，為浮游植物與魚群提供棲地，讓研究、觀光與鯨歌和鳴共存。

pins.title: Rural Greenspace Exploration
pins.description:
Idle green space in Gangtou Village, Guangzhou, replanned for villagers and cultural tourism, with water restoration and a phased timeline to 2035.

Gangtou Village, Huadu, Guangzhou | Rural landscape planning | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 鄉村綠地探索
zh-Hant.description:
為村民與文化觀光重新規劃廣州岡頭村的閒置綠地，結合水體修復與至 2035 年的分期時程。

廣州花都岡頭村｜鄉村景觀規劃｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Aerial view of the Gangtou Village planning.
岡頭村規劃鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Gangtou Village in Huadu, Guangzhou, has good Lingnan ancient architecture and ecological resources an hour from the city, yet only about two elderly households still live in the old village and tourism projects are poorly managed. Farmland is broken up, ancient buildings are abandoned, and public facilities and activity spaces are few.
captions: Location from Guangdong to Gangtou Village, and SWOT analysis.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 位於廣州花都的岡頭村擁有良好的嶺南古建築與生態資源，距市區僅一小時，但舊村只剩約兩戶長者居住，觀光項目也管理不善。農田破碎、古建築荒廢，公共設施與活動空間不足。
captions: 從廣東到岡頭村的區位，以及 SWOT 分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: More than 2,100 people live in the village, about 28 % are under 15 and 11 % over 60, and over 1,000 acres of cultivated land are rented to farmers, while idle green space still accounts for the vast majority. Elevation, water-security and area-type analyses map where houses, farmland, gardens and woodland meet.
captions: Population and economy, site analysis and land use type.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 村內常住人口超過 2,100 人，其中約 28% 未滿 15 歲、11% 超過 60 歲，逾 1,000 英畝耕地租給農戶，閒置綠地仍占絕大多數。高程、水安全格局與用地類型分析，標示出住宅、農田、園地與林地交會之處。
captions: 人口與經濟、基地分析與用地類型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A landscape texture is generated from branching lines combined with the venue and layered over the construction roads and land types. Idle green space is divided into service space for cultural tourism and for villagers, with five public areas — leisure, cultural and educational, rain garden, edible garden and old-house renovation — that also show villagers how to transform their own micro gardens.
captions: Morphogenesis and the planning floor plan.
Strategy 1: planning of idle green space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 景觀紋理由分枝線條生成，結合場地後疊合於建設道路與用地類型之上。閒置綠地分為文化觀光服務空間與村民服務空間，並設置休閒、文教、雨水花園、可食花園與老屋改造五類公共區域，同時示範村民如何改造自家的微型花園。
captions: 形態生成與規劃平面。
策略一：閒置綠地規劃。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Ecological restoration treats water through pipelines, swales, linear plant treatment and drop aeration before it enters an aquaculture loop, and a tour-experience upgrade engages the five senses through gardens and farms. A timeline from 2021 to 2035 moves from villagers' residential areas to ancient buildings, ecological riverbanks and finally the woodlands and gardens of the entire village.
captions: Strategy 2: ecological restoration through water treatment.
Strategy 3: tour experience upgrade and comparison before and after transformation.
Gangtou Village floor plan and planning timeline, 2021–2035.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 生態修復以管道、草溝、線性植物處理與跌水曝氣淨化水體，再進入水產養殖循環；遊覽體驗升級則透過花園與農場調動五感。2021 至 2035 年的時程，從村民住宅區開始，接著是古建築、生態河岸，最後完成全村的林地與園地。
captions: 策略二：以水處理進行生態修復。
策略三：遊覽體驗升級與改造前後比較。
岡頭村平面與 2021–2035 規劃時程。

sections.heading: Village Green Renewed - Weaving Idle Land Into a Garden for the Five Senses
sections.body: An old village an hour from the city holds fine traditional buildings and rich ecology, yet only two elderly households still live in its old core and its tourism projects are poorly run. Farmland is broken up, old buildings stand abandoned, and public facilities and places to gather are few. More than two thousand people live in the village, close to a third of them under fifteen, and over a thousand acres of farmland are rented out, while idle green space still covers most of the land. Analyses of elevation, water security and land type mark where houses, fields, gardens and woodland meet. A landscape texture grows from branching lines. Idle green space is divided between service for cultural tourism and service for villagers, with five public areas, leisure, culture and education, rain garden, edible garden and old-house renovation, that also show villagers how to remake their own small gardens. Water is cleaned through swales and drop aeration before it feeds an aquaculture loop, and gardens and farms awaken all five senses. A phased timeline spreads from homes to old buildings, riverbanks and finally the whole village.

zh-Hant.heading: 村野再生-把閒置綠地編成五感之園
zh-Hant.body: 一座距城市約一小時車程的古村，擁有良好的傳統建築與生態資源，舊村裡卻只剩兩戶長者居住，觀光項目也經營不善；農田支離破碎，古建築荒廢，公共設施與活動空間寥寥可數。村中常住兩千多人，其中近三成未滿十五歲，逾千畝耕地租給農戶，閒置綠地仍佔絕大多數。景觀紋理由分枝線條生成。閒置綠地被分為服務文化觀光與服務村民的空間，並設置休閒、文教、雨水花園、可食花園與老屋改造五類公共區域。生態修復以草溝與跌水曝氣淨化水體，再導入水產養殖循環；遊覽體驗則透過花園與農場喚醒五感。十多年的分期時程，從村民住宅區開始，延伸至古建築、生態河岸，最終遍及全村的林地與園地，讓沉睡的土地重新有人照料。

pins.title: Whiskey Energy Farm
pins.description:
A whisky distillery on the Isle of Skye combined with wind, marine energy and a greenhouse, opened to visitors on the way to net zero.

Rubha Shlèite, Isle of Skye, Scotland | Architecture | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 威士忌能源農場
zh-Hant.description:
在天空島結合風能、海洋能與溫室的威士忌蒸餾廠，在邁向淨零的過程中向遊客開放。

蘇格蘭天空島 Rubha Shlèite｜建築設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The energy farm on the shore of Rubha Shlèite.
位於 Rubha Shlèite 海岸的能源農場。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Responding to the net-zero coalition, Scotch whisky can sit at the heart of a blueprint to protect Scotland's environment while remaining a modern, profitable industry. Scotland's wind farms mainly concentrate in the north east and do not cover the Isle of Skye, even though the UK is one of the busiest ports in the world for both import and export.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 為回應淨零聯盟，蘇格蘭威士忌可以成為保護蘇格蘭環境藍圖的核心，同時維持現代且獲利的產業。蘇格蘭的風電場主要集中在東北部，並未涵蓋天空島，儘管英國是全球進出口最繁忙的港口之一。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site reads the climate, ocean currents, sun and wind directions of the isle, and the entertainment activities around it that are closely tied to nature. Combining the distillery with the wind farm in the architectural facades would decrease the transport of electricity, while a greenhouse at the front uses water from the air and the sea and the heat generated by distilling.
captions: Parti diagram, energy systems — wind, marine energy, desalination, air-drop irrigation, hydrogen and a smart grid — and the long section.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地分析島上的氣候、洋流、日照與風向，以及周邊與自然緊密相連的休閒活動。把蒸餾廠與風電場結合進建築立面，可以減少電力輸送；前方的溫室則利用空氣與海水中的水分，以及蒸餾產生的熱。
captions: 配置概念圖與能源系統：風能、海洋能、海水淡化、空氣集水灌溉、氫能與智慧電網，以及長向剖面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The distillery is designed to be visited and completely opened to the public, from the preparation of ingredients to the distilling itself, with a separate pathway so visitors do not disrupt the workers. Wine cellar and export are served by two ports that separate the routes of visitors and sailors, and the barrels move by lift across the storage area.
captions: Site plan: export pier, passenger wharf, off-shore fishing, wine cellar, hotel, gallery, ecological beach, hydrogen fuel, greenhouse, distillery, marine and wind power.
Sections through the greenhouse, distillery and lab and cellar, and the wall detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 蒸餾廠設計為可參觀並完全對公眾開放，從原料準備到蒸餾過程皆可觀看，並另設動線，避免遊客干擾工作人員。酒窖與出口由兩座港口服務，分開遊客與船員的路線，酒桶則透過升降設備在儲藏區之間垂直運送。
captions: 配置圖：出口碼頭、客運碼頭、離岸漁業、酒窖、旅館、展廊、生態海灘、氫燃料、溫室、蒸餾廠、海洋能與風能。
溫室、蒸餾廠與實驗室及酒窖的剖面，以及牆身詳圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Energy enters the building through the facade, heat transfers back to the greenhouse, and the surplus is used by other parts of the complex. The faceted facade combines rainwater-gathering panels, low-E glass with insulation, openable glass and wind-introduction panels on a steel and wood glass frame.
captions: Water and energy cycles, facade tectonic, exploded axonometric and model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 能源經由立面進入建築，熱能回傳至溫室，剩餘的能源則供複合體其他部分使用。多面體立面在鋼與木的玻璃框架上，結合雨水收集板、具隔熱的低輻射玻璃、可開啟玻璃與導風板。
captions: 水與能源循環、立面構造、爆炸軸測與模型。

sections.heading: Spirit and Wind - A Distillery and Wind Farm Sharing One Facade
sections.body: Responding to the net-zero coalition, the project imagines whisky at the heart of a blueprint that protects the environment while remaining a modern and profitable industry. The country's wind farms are concentrated elsewhere and do not reach the island chosen for the site. Site study reads the island's climate, ocean currents, sun and wind directions. Building the distillery and the wind farm into the same facades would cut the transport of electricity, while a greenhouse in front draws water from the air and the sea and takes up the heat of distilling. The distillery is fully open to the public, from preparing ingredients to distilling, with a separate route so that visitors never disturb the workers. Two ports serve the cellar and export, separating visitors from sailors, and barrels move by lift across the storage. Energy enters through the faceted facade, of rain-gathering panels, insulated low-E glass, openable glass and wind panels on a steel and timber frame, while heat returns to the greenhouse and the surplus serves the rest of the complex.

zh-Hant.heading: 酒與風-讓蒸餾廠與風電共用一面立面
zh-Hant.body: 為回應淨零聯盟的目標，作品設想威士忌產業可以成為守護環境藍圖的核心，同時保持現代而獲利的經營。這片土地的風電場集中在其他地區，並未延伸到作品所在的島嶼。基地研究細讀島上的氣候、洋流、日照與風向。把蒸餾廠與風電場一同納入建築立面，可以減少電力的長途輸送；前方的溫室則汲取空氣與海水中的水分，以及蒸餾產生的餘熱。蒸餾廠設計為完全向公眾開放，從原料準備到蒸餾過程都可參觀，並另設動線，讓訪客不致干擾工作人員。酒窖與出口由兩座港口服務，酒桶則藉升降設備在儲藏區之間移動。能源從立面進入建築，熱能回送溫室，剩餘電力供複合體其他部分使用。多面體立面在鋼木玻璃框架上，結合集雨板、隔熱低輻射玻璃、可開啟窗與導風板，讓一杯酒也能釀出潔淨的風。

pins.title: Fast Fashion Tower
pins.description:
A movable tower that stacks entertainment above garment factories, so every visitor rides past the labour that fast fashion hides.

Flexible site | Competition project | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 快時尚之塔
zh-Hant.description:
一座可移動的高塔，把娛樂堆疊在成衣工廠之上，讓每位遊客都經過快時尚所隱藏的勞動。

基地不限｜競圖作品｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The tower: entertainment above, factories below.
高塔：上方是娛樂，下方是工廠。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project uses architecture to reveal an empire built upon the exploitation of labour. A hoodie that retails for 26.66 € is traced back through brand, sourcing agency, printer, textile and fabric factories to cotton farming, where garment workers often work 14 to 16 hours a day, seven days a week.
captions: What is the true cost of a hoodie? Costs at each step and the production chain from design to sale.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案以建築揭示一個建立在剝削勞動之上的帝國。一件零售價 26.66 歐元的連帽衫被一路追溯，經過品牌、採購代理、印刷廠、紡織與布料工廠直到棉花種植，而成衣工人往往每天工作 14 到 16 小時、每週七天。
captions: 一件連帽衫的真實成本是多少？各環節的成本，以及從設計到銷售的生產鏈。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The upper parts of the building demonstrate the modern phenomenon of amusing ourselves to death, with shopping malls, entertainment, busy streets and lights that never go out. To arrive there, visitors must pass the bottom part by elevator, where they see that the fancy empire comes at the cost of cheap and abused labour.
captions: Concept development: spheres squeezing each other as the fabric and clothing factories, the panopticon, the bacteriophage metaphor and the movable foundation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 建築上部呈現「娛樂至死」的當代現象，有購物中心、娛樂、繁忙街道與永不熄滅的燈光。要抵達那裡，遊客必須搭電梯穿過下部，親眼看到華麗帝國的代價是廉價且受虐的勞動。
captions: 概念發展：彼此擠壓的球體作為布料與成衣工廠、全景監獄、噬菌體隱喻與可移動的基礎。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The central elevator incorporates Bentham's panopticon, giving visitors a 360-degree view of the working conditions below, and the upper structure extends from this centre. Fast fashion is read as a bacteriophage that infects and replicates within its host society, and the tower stands on a movable foundation of scalable omniwheels, moving with its legs extended and resting with them folded.
captions: Plan with the factories, the view from the elevator and the ground-level entrance.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 中央電梯引入邊沁的全景監獄，讓遊客 360 度看見下方的勞動狀況，上部結構則自此中心延伸。快時尚被解讀為一種在宿主社會中感染並複製的噬菌體，高塔立在由可伸縮全向輪組成的可移動基礎上，伸腿時移動、收腿時停駐。
captions: 工廠平面、電梯視角與地面入口。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The plans place abandoned clothing as garbage, a surrounding club, an information centre and a fashion-show stage around the central core. Above, a swimming pool, a circular tram, an agency office, a supervising structure and a penthouse complete the vertical journey from labour to consumption.
captions: Floor plans with the information centre, fashion-show stage and abandoned clothing.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 平面圍繞中央核心配置作為垃圾的廢棄衣物、環繞的俱樂部、資訊中心與時裝秀舞台。上方的游泳池、環形電車、代理辦公室、監督結構與頂層公寓，完成從勞動到消費的垂直旅程。
captions: 含資訊中心、時裝秀舞台與廢棄衣物的平面。

sections.heading: Fast Fashion Tower - Rising From Sweated Labour to Amusement at the Top
sections.body: The project uses architecture to expose an empire built on the exploitation of labour. A hoodie that retails for around twenty-six euros is traced back to the cotton field, where garment workers often toil fourteen to sixteen hours a day, seven days a week. The upper part of the building shows the modern condition of amusing ourselves to death, with malls, entertainment, busy streets and lights that never go out. To reach it, visitors must ride an elevator through the lower part and see for themselves that the glittering empire is paid for with cheap and abused labour. The central elevator takes up the idea of the panopticon, giving a full view of the working conditions below, and the upper structure reaches out from this core. Fast fashion is read as a bacteriophage that infects and replicates inside its host society, and the tower stands on scalable omniwheels, walking with its legs extended and resting with them folded. Discarded clothing heaped as garbage, a club, an information centre and a runway ring the core, while a pool, a circular tram, offices and a penthouse complete the climb from labour to consumption.

zh-Hant.heading: 快時尚之塔-從血汗底層升向娛樂頂端
zh-Hant.body: 作品以建築揭露一個建立在勞動剝削之上的帝國。一件零售價二十多歐元的連帽衫被一路追溯，直到棉花田；成衣工人往往每天工作十四到十六小時，全年無休。建築上部呈現「娛樂至死」的當代景象：商場、娛樂與不滅的燈光。要抵達那裡，訪客必須搭乘電梯穿越下部，親眼看見華麗帝國的代價是廉價而受虐的勞動。中央電梯引入全景監獄的構想，讓訪客以三百六十度目睹下方的勞動狀況，上部結構則自此核心向外延伸。快時尚被解讀為一種在宿主社會中感染並複製的噬菌體，高塔立於可伸縮全向輪組成的移動基礎上，伸腿時遷徙、收腿時停駐。平面圍繞核心配置堆成垃圾的廢棄衣物、俱樂部、資訊中心與時裝秀舞台；上方的泳池、環形電車、代理辦公室、監督結構與頂層公寓，完成從勞動到消費的垂直旅程。

pins.title: City Lighthouse
pins.description:
Light towers in Oakland that turn the sound of a street into a light signal, using design to put more eyes on the street.

Oakland, California | Architecture | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 城市燈塔
zh-Hant.description:
在奧克蘭把街道聲音轉為光訊號的光塔，以設計讓更多目光留在街上。

加州奧克蘭｜建築設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Spectrum projectors light the district at night.
頻譜投射器在夜間照亮街區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Property, personal and street crime cluster in Oakland, and the project asks how the built environment can create safer neighbourhoods. Crime prevention through environmental design, defensible space and the broken-window theory all argue that unrepaired disorder breaks down social control while eyes on the street keep it.
captions: Crime hotspots in Oakland: property, personal and street crime.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 財產犯罪、人身犯罪與街頭犯罪在奧克蘭集中出現，本案提問建成環境如何創造更安全的社區。環境設計預防犯罪、防衛空間與破窗理論都指出，未修復的失序會瓦解社會控制，而街上的目光能維繫它。
captions: 奧克蘭的犯罪熱點：財產、人身與街頭犯罪。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A space-syntax diagram of street accessibility and visibility shows the hotspots at both the most easily accessed crossroads and the dead ends. Learning from billboards and from the lighthouse as the guardian of the ocean, the design becomes a light tower that indicates the popularity of the district.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 街道可達性與可視性的空間句法圖顯示，熱點同時出現在最容易抵達的路口與死巷。借鏡廣告看板，以及作為海洋守護者的燈塔，設計成為一座顯示街區人氣的光塔。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Models and sections develop a tower on a truss structure with a connection to the ground, a roof garden, a water gutter and a foldable window screen. Openable screens enhance natural surveillance of the nearby streets.
captions: Models, sections, truss structure and floor and wall detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 模型與剖面發展出一座立在桁架結構上的塔，包含與地面的連接、屋頂花園、排水溝與可折疊的窗屏。可開啟的屏幕加強了對周邊街道的自然監視。
captions: 模型、剖面、桁架結構與樓板及牆身詳圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: An Arduino experiment uses a microphone to collect surrounding audio and an audio spectrum analyser to drive a display. At night the towers project the spectrum of the street's sound into the sky, turning the activity of a district into a signal of its safety.
captions: Arduino experiment: microphone, spectrum analyser and LED display.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: Arduino 實驗以麥克風收集周遭聲音，並以音訊頻譜分析器驅動顯示。夜間，光塔把街道聲音的頻譜投射到天空，讓街區的活動成為安全的訊號。
captions: Arduino 實驗：麥克風、頻譜分析器與 LED 顯示。

sections.heading: City Lighthouse - Turning the Sound of the Street Into a Light of Safety
sections.body: Property, personal and street crime gather in certain districts of a city, and the project asks whether the built environment can make neighbourhoods safer. Crime prevention through environmental design, defensible space and the broken-window theory all hold that unrepaired disorder wears away social control, while eyes on the street sustain it. A space-syntax map of street accessibility and visibility shows the hotspots appearing both at the most easily reached crossroads and in dead ends. Learning from billboards, and from the lighthouse as guardian of the ocean, the design becomes a tower of light that signals how lively a district is. Models and sections develop a tower raised on a truss, with a roof garden and a foldable screen. Openable screens strengthen natural surveillance of the streets nearby. An Arduino experiment gathers surrounding sound with a microphone and feeds an audio spectrum analyser that drives a display. At night the towers cast the spectrum of the street's sound into the sky, so that the everyday life of a district becomes a signal of shared safety, much as a lighthouse lights a channel for ships.

zh-Hant.heading: 城市燈塔-把街道的聲響化為安全的光
zh-Hant.body: 財產犯罪、人身犯罪與街頭犯罪集中於一座城市的某些街區，作品追問：建成環境能否創造更安全的社區？環境設計預防犯罪、防衛空間與破窗理論都指出，未被修復的失序會瓦解社會控制，而街上的目光能把它維繫下來。一張以空間句法繪製的街道可達性與可視性圖顯示，犯罪熱點同時出現在最易抵達的路口與死巷之中。設計向廣告看板學習，也借鏡作為海洋守護者的燈塔，成為一座標示街區人氣的光塔。模型與剖面發展出一座立於桁架結構上的塔，附屋頂花園與可折疊窗屏；可開啟的屏幕強化了對周邊街道的自然監視。一項 Arduino 實驗以麥克風收集周遭聲音，再以音訊頻譜分析器驅動顯示。入夜之後，光塔把街道聲響的頻譜投向天空，讓一個街區的生活氣息，成為守護彼此安全的訊號。

pins.title: Post-war Rehabilitation Centre
pins.description:
A rehabilitation centre in Firdos Park, Baghdad, using nature, water, light and ramps to treat post-traumatic stress and disability.

Firdos Park, Baghdad, Iraq | Competition project | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 戰後復健中心
zh-Hant.description:
位於巴格達菲爾多斯廣場公園的復健中心，以自然、水、光與坡道治療創傷後壓力與身體障礙。

伊拉克巴格達菲爾多斯廣場公園｜競圖作品｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Design proposal: plans, structure, curved facade and renders.
設計提案：平面、結構、曲面立面與渲染。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In Iraq about one in ten of the war-affected population suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder, and disabled people say no one represents them. Traditional PTSD treatments range from narrative exposure therapy and stress inoculation training to cognitive, cognitive-processing and dialectical behaviour therapies.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在伊拉克，受戰爭影響的人口中約每十人就有一人患有創傷後壓力症候群，身障者則表示沒有人代表他們。傳統的創傷後壓力治療包括敘事暴露療法、壓力免疫訓練，以及認知、認知處理與辯證行為療法。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Research finds that nature is proving to be awesome medicine for PTSD, and that the feeling of awe helps improve patients' social behaviour. The centre therefore introduces meditation open space, ecological landscapes, water therapy, working and social re-engagement and a religious space for pilgrims, and uses changing light to affect patients' emotions.
captions: Research findings, the effects of light, the division of space and the steps of physical rehabilitation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究發現，大自然正成為治療創傷後壓力的良藥，而敬畏感有助改善患者的社交行為。因此中心引入冥想開放空間、生態景觀、水療、工作與社交重建以及朝聖的宗教空間，並以光線變化影響患者的情緒。
captions: 研究發現、光的效果、空間劃分與身體復健的步驟。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The site is Firdos Park in Baghdad, next to Al-Sha'ab International Stadium, and a bubble diagram links psychological treatment, physical treatment, the mosque and space open to the public. Concept models explore different forms, curves and circles for ramps represent the disabled, and the traditional plan of the mosque is simplified for contemporary aesthetics.
captions: Site map and bubble diagram.
Concept models, concept development and the mosque.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於巴格達的菲爾多斯廣場公園，緊鄰人民國際體育場，泡泡圖串聯心理治療、身體治療、清真寺與對公眾開放的空間。概念模型探索不同形態，坡道的曲線與圓代表身障者，清真寺的傳統平面則被簡化以符合當代美學。
captions: 基地圖與泡泡圖。
概念模型、概念發展與清真寺。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Floor plans stack a children centre, training areas, offices, lecture halls, male and female water therapy, physical and psychological therapy, a roof garden, a mosque, a library and classrooms. All spaces are separated but connected, from private to public, under a curved GRC rainscreen facade on a steel and concrete structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 各層平面堆疊兒童中心、訓練區、辦公室、演講廳、男女水療、身體與心理治療、屋頂花園、清真寺、圖書館與教室。從私密到公共，所有空間彼此分隔卻相互連通，覆蓋在鋼與混凝土結構上的曲面玻璃纖維混凝土雨幕立面之下。

sections.heading: Healing Through Awe - Nature and Light for Wounds Left by War
sections.body: In a country scarred by war, about one in ten of those affected suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder, and disabled people feel that no one speaks for them. Research suggests that nature is proving to be a powerful medicine, and that the feeling of awe improves patients' social behaviour. The centre therefore brings in open meditation space, ecological landscape, water therapy, work and social re-engagement, and a religious space for pilgrims, while changing light is used to move patients' emotions. The site lies in a park beside the national stadium of the capital, and a bubble diagram links psychological treatment, physical treatment, the mosque and space open to the public. Concept models explore form; curving and circling ramps stand for disabled people, and the traditional mosque plan is simplified for a contemporary eye. The floors stack a children centre, training areas, lecture halls, water therapy for men and women, treatment rooms, a roof garden, a mosque, a library and classrooms. Separated yet connected from private to public beneath a curved rainscreen facade, the spaces let wounded minds recover slowly in light.

zh-Hant.heading: 敬畏之療-以自然與光撫慰戰後創傷
zh-Hant.body: 在一個飽受戰火的國家，受戰爭影響的人口中約每十人就有一人患有創傷後壓力症候群，身障者更覺得無人為自己發聲。研究發現，大自然正成為療癒創傷的良藥，而敬畏之感能改善患者的社交行為。中心因此引入冥想開放空間、生態景觀、水療、工作與社交重建，以及供朝聖者使用的宗教空間。基地位於首都一座公園內，泡泡圖串聯心理治療、身體治療、清真寺與對公眾開放的空間。概念模型探索各種形態，坡道的曲線與圓象徵身障者的行進，清真寺的傳統平面則被簡化以符合當代美學。各層堆疊兒童中心、訓練區、演講廳、男女水療、治療室、屋頂花園、清真寺、圖書館與教室。從私密到公共，所有空間彼此分隔又相互連通，覆於曲面雨幕立面之下，讓受傷的身心在光影中慢慢復原。

pins.title: Kibera Slum Design
pins.description:
A sustainable material and safe house for Kibera, turning local waste into bricks that residents can make and build with.

Kibera, Nairobi, Kenya | Architecture and material research | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 基貝拉貧民窟設計
zh-Hant.description:
為基貝拉設計的永續材料與安全住宅，將在地廢料轉化為居民能自行製作與建造的磚塊。

肯亞奈洛比基貝拉｜建築與材料研究｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Vision: bagasse, rice soup and ash become bricks that residents mould, carry and build with.
願景：甘蔗渣、米漿與灰燼製成磚塊，由居民自行模製、搬運與建造。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In Kibera, Nairobi, a family of twelve can live in a ten-square-metre house, with average monthly income of about US$45 per person against US$900 in the rest of the city. Mud houses use local material that residents can build themselves but they are not waterproof, while cladding houses of reused corrugated steel damage the environment.
captions: Location, climate and the Kibera site, 4.8 km from the CBD.
Models of the mud house and the cladding house.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在奈洛比的基貝拉，一個十二口之家可能住在十平方公尺的房子裡，人均月收入約 45 美元，而城市其他地區為 900 美元。泥屋使用居民可自行建造的在地材料卻不防水，再利用浪鐵皮的包覆屋則對環境造成破壞。
captions: 區位、氣候與距中心商業區 4.8 公里的基貝拉基地。
泥屋與包覆屋的模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The proposal is a new building material that is recycled, affordable, safe and light, made from the waste of local industries such as tea, peanut shells, sugarcane bagasse and charcoal ash. Comparing Kibera and Chinese mud bricks showed that adding ash could raise strength by 2.5 MPa and make the brick fully waterproof.
captions: Problem and proposal: create a new building material.
Original and hypothesized material properties.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 提案是一種回收、平價、安全且輕量的新建材，取材自茶葉、花生殼、甘蔗渣與木炭灰等在地產業的廢料。比較基貝拉與中國的泥磚後發現，加入灰燼可讓強度提升 2.5 MPa，並使磚塊完全防水。
captions: 問題與提案：創造新的建材。
原始材料與假設材料的性質。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Ten mixes replaced red clay with peanut shell, bagasse or tea powder plus ash, cutting red clay use by 80 %. Following the rice-soup mortar of the Great Wall, a mix of 20 % rice soup, 70 % bagasse and 10 % ash saves all red clay, weighs 0.13 g/cm³ and reaches 6.5 MPa.
captions: Material testing: waste powders replacing red clay.
Rice soup, bagasse and ash: weight 0.13 g/cm³, strength 6.5 MPa.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 十組配方以花生殼、甘蔗渣或茶葉粉加灰燼取代紅土，使紅土用量減少 80%。參考長城的糯米漿砂漿，20% 米漿、70% 甘蔗渣與 10% 灰燼的配方完全不用紅土，重量 0.13 g/cm³，強度達 6.5 MPa。
captions: 材料測試：以廢料粉末取代紅土。
米漿、甘蔗渣與灰燼：重量 0.13 g/cm³，強度 6.5 MPa。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Interlocking brick prototypes were designed for walls, rooftops and a water system, with a sloping surface for roof drainage. Python and Grasshopper studies arrange the bricks into different spaces such as kitchens, bedrooms and living rooms to meet the needs of each family.
captions: Brick prototypes, physical models and brick size.
Brick arrangement studies in Python and Grasshopper.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 互鎖磚原型分別設計用於牆體、屋頂與排水系統，傾斜的表面可讓屋頂排水。Python 與 Grasshopper 的研究將磚塊排列成廚房、臥室與客廳等不同空間，以滿足每個家庭的需求。
captions: 磚塊原型、實體模型與磚塊尺寸。
以 Python 與 Grasshopper 進行的磚塊排列研究。

sections.heading: Bricks From Waste - Waterproof Homes Made From Farm Residue
sections.body: In a large informal settlement, a family of twelve may share a house of ten square metres, on an income a twentieth of that in the rest of the city. Mud houses use local material that residents can build themselves but they let in water, while houses clad in reused corrugated steel harm the environment. The proposal seeks a building material that is recycled, affordable, safe and light, made from the waste of local industries such as tea, peanut shells, sugarcane bagasse and charcoal ash. Adding ash makes the brick stronger and waterproof. Ten mixes replaced red clay with peanut shell, bagasse or tea powder plus ash, cutting red clay by eighty per cent. Drawing on the rice-soup mortar of an ancient wall, a mix of rice soup, bagasse and ash uses no red clay at all and is both light and strong. Interlocking brick prototypes were designed for walls, roofs and a water system, with sloping faces that shed rain. Python and Grasshopper studies arrange the bricks into kitchens, bedrooms and living rooms for each family. Discarded residue becomes a wall against wind and rain.

zh-Hant.heading: 廢料成磚-以農產殘餘打造防水的家
zh-Hant.body: 在一處非洲大型貧民窟裡，十二口之家可能擠在十平方公尺的屋內，人均月收入只有城市其他地區的二十分之一。泥屋使用居民能自行建造的在地材料，卻不防水；以回收浪鐵皮包覆的屋子，又對環境造成傷害。提案尋找一種回收、平價、安全而輕盈的新建材，取材自茶葉、花生殼、甘蔗渣與木炭灰等在地產業的廢料。十組配方以花生殼、甘蔗渣或茶葉粉加灰燼取代紅土，使紅土用量減少八成；再參考古代城牆的糯米漿砂漿，一組米漿、甘蔗渣與灰燼的配方完全不用紅土，既輕且堅。互鎖磚原型分別設計給牆體、屋頂與排水系統，傾斜的表面讓雨水順勢流下。演算研究，把磚塊排列成廚房、臥室與客廳，回應每個家庭的需要。被丟棄的殘渣，就此成為遮風擋雨的牆。

pins.title: Residential Renovation
pins.description:
A renovation of Liuyun Residential Area in Guangzhou CBD that lets residents, workers and visitors share a safer street.

Liuyun Residential Area, Guangzhou, China | Residential renovation | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 住宅改造
zh-Hant.description:
廣州中心商業區六運小區的改造，讓居民、上班族與訪客共享更安全的街道。

中國廣州六運小區｜住宅改造｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Section and street safety: an active facade that guards the street.
剖面與街道安全：守護街道的活躍立面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Liuyun Residential Area sits inside Guangzhou CBD, where a meal costs about $2 against $9 to $15 in nearby food courts, so office workers, delivery riders and strangers occupy the residential areas. Shops fill the first to third floors, the flow of strangers creates security problems and outsiders take over the outdoor space.
captions: Site: Liuyun Residential Area in Guangzhou CBD.
Daily chart and behaviour section of residents, workers, delivery riders and vagrants.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 六運小區位於廣州中心商業區之內，一餐約 2 美元，而附近美食廣場則要 9 至 15 美元，因此上班族、外送員與陌生人佔據了住宅區。商鋪佔滿一至三樓，陌生人的流動帶來安全問題，戶外空間也被外來者佔用。
captions: 基地：位於廣州中心商業區的六運小區。
居民、上班族、外送員與遊民的每日活動圖與行為剖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A daily chart maps when food delivery, office workers, residents and vagrants use the area, from mid-night vagrants to workers' breakfast, lunch, dinner and night bars. Models of the existing prototype test safety and public space and the different types of space that outsiders need.
captions: Problem diagrams and models of the existing prototype.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每日活動圖記錄外送、上班族、居民與遊民使用此區的時間，從深夜遊民、上班族早餐、午餐、晚餐到夜間酒吧。現有原型的模型則測試安全與公共空間，以及外來者所需的不同空間類型。
captions: 問題圖解與現有原型模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Three questions guide the design: emerging types of space, a safe street and architecture as a carrier of culture. Following the idea that street safety should be supervised and safeguarded by residents, the existing structure is maintained, designed with function and interwoven.
captions: Future possibility: types of space, a safe street and culture.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三個問題引導設計：新興的空間類型、安全的街道，以及作為文化載體的建築。依循街道安全應由居民監督與守護的理念，保留既有結構，賦予機能並加以交織。
captions: 未來可能性：空間類型、安全街道與文化。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Residential floors sit above a mixed-use level and commercial floors linked by ramps, with rooftop activity spaces and a sloping facade that lets sunlight in. Sections give tourists, office workers and residents their own rooftop, residential and commercial programmes.
captions: Plan and elevation: residential, mixed-use and commercial levels.
Rooftop, design for sunlight and ramps.
Section and function for residents.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 住宅樓層位於混合使用層與以坡道相連的商業樓層之上，屋頂設有活動空間，傾斜的立面讓陽光進入。剖面為遊客、上班族與居民分別配置屋頂、住宅與商業機能。
captions: 平面與立面：住宅、混合使用與商業樓層。
屋頂、日照設計與坡道。
為居民設計的剖面與機能。

sections.heading: Rewoven Neighbourhood - A Residential Block Watched Over by Its Residents
sections.body: A residential block sits inside the central business district, where a meal costs about two dollars against far higher prices in nearby food courts, so office workers, delivery riders and strangers pour into the housing. Shops fill the first three floors, the flow of strangers creates security problems, and outsiders take over the outdoor space. A daily chart records when delivery riders, office workers, residents and vagrants use the area. Models of the existing buildings test safety, public space and the different kinds of room that outsiders need. Three questions guide the design: emerging types of space, a safe street, and architecture as a carrier of culture. Following the idea that street safety should be supervised and safeguarded by residents, the existing structure is kept, given new functions and interwoven. Residential floors rise above a mixed-use level and commercial floors linked by ramps, with rooftop activity spaces and a sloping facade that lets in sunlight. Sections give tourists, office workers and residents their own rooftop, residential and commercial programmes, so that bustle and home can share one block in layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 街坊重織-讓居民守望被外來者佔據的小區
zh-Hant.body: 一處住宅小區坐落在中心商業區之內，一餐只需約兩美元，遠低於附近美食廣場的價格，於是上班族、外送員與陌生人湧入住宅區。商鋪佔滿一至三樓，陌生人的流動帶來安全問題，戶外空間也被外來者佔據。一張每日活動圖記錄外送、上班族、居民與遊民使用此地的時刻。以現有樓宇為原型的模型，測試安全與公共空間，以及外來者所需的各種空間類型。三個問題引導設計：新興的空間類型、安全的街道，以及作為文化載體的建築。依循街道安全應由居民監督與守護的理念，既有結構被保留下來，賦予新的機能並相互交織。住宅樓層位於混合使用層與以坡道相連的商業樓層之上，屋頂設有活動空間，傾斜的立面迎入陽光。剖面為遊客、上班族與居民各自安排屋頂、住宅與商業機能，讓喧鬧與安居得以分層共處。

pins.title: Unfathomable Desire
pins.description:
The "Arcade" in the 21st century: a shopping mall in Guangzhou designed as a spiral ramp into desire.

Guangzhou, China | Architecture | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 深不可測的慾望
zh-Hant.description:
二十一世紀的「拱廊街」：位於廣州、以通往慾望的螺旋坡道構成的購物中心。

中國廣州｜建築設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Concept model: a spiral ramp to desire around a Mobius ring.
概念模型：環繞莫比烏斯環、通往慾望的螺旋坡道。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The arcades of the 18th and 19th centuries were designed to attract the genteel middle classes and offered shoppers an enclosed space away from noisy, dirty streets. In the 21st century the cell phone has become a store window, and profiles, purchases and short videos create new desires that lead people into an abyss.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 十八、十九世紀的拱廊街是為吸引上流中產階級而設計，讓購物者遠離嘈雜骯髒的街道，置身封閉的空間。到了二十一世紀，手機成了新的櫥窗，個人檔案、購物與短影音不斷製造新的慾望，把人引入深淵。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Benjamin's Arcades Project records the behaviour of the flaneur in 19th-century Paris, drawn to fashion until it becomes fetishism and desire for money and power. The design language borrows Samsāra, the cycle of realms of desire that ends only when a person reaches liberation.
captions: History of the arcade: luxury stores, salons, retail and cafes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 班雅明的《拱廊街計畫》記錄了十九世紀巴黎漫遊者的行為，他們受時尚吸引，直至演變為戀物以及對金錢與權力的慾望。設計語言借用輪迴的概念，即慾望諸界的循環，唯有解脫才能終結。
captions: 拱廊街的歷史：精品店、沙龍、零售與咖啡館。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The renovation turns this cycle into space, where visitors fall into desire along spiralling floors and a stair offers an escape. Concept models test the stair in the atrium and a Mobius ring at the bottom, from which it is hard to escape.
captions: Renovation: falling into desire and the stair for escape.
Concept models: the stair to escape desire and the Mobius ring.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 改造將這個循環轉化為空間，訪客沿著螺旋樓層墜入慾望，而一道樓梯提供逃離的出口。概念模型測試中庭的樓梯，以及位於底部、難以逃脫的莫比烏斯環。
captions: 改造：墜入慾望與逃離的樓梯。
概念模型：逃離慾望的樓梯與莫比烏斯環。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The result is a shopping mall in Guangzhou built as a spiral ramp to desire, with advertisement boards on its facade drawing people into consumption. It presents the mall as an abyss of desire in which people escape from reality through shopping.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 成果是一座位於廣州、以通往慾望的螺旋坡道構成的購物中心，立面上的廣告看板吸引人們陷入消費。它把購物中心呈現為慾望的深淵，人們在購物中逃離現實。

sections.heading: Unfathomable Desire - A Shopping Mall That Spirals Downward
sections.body: The arcades of the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries were built to draw the genteel middle classes. In the twenty-first century the phone has become the shop window, and profiles, purchases and short videos keep producing new desires that lead people toward an abyss. The research returns to a classic study of the arcades, following the stroller who is drawn to fashion until it hardens into fetishism and a hunger for money and power. The design language borrows Samsāra, the cycle of realms of desire that ends only in liberation. The renovation turns this cycle into space: visitors sink into desire along spiralling floors, and a single stair offers a way out. Concept models test that stair in the atrium and a Mobius ring at the bottom from which escape is hard. The result is a shopping mall shaped as a spiral ramp toward desire, its facade covered in advertising boards that beckon people into consumption. The mall becomes an abyss in which shopping is an escape from reality, and every turn of the ramp holds up a mirror to the one descending it.

zh-Hant.heading: 慾望深淵-一座螺旋墜落的購物中心
zh-Hant.body: 十八、十九世紀的拱廊街，為吸引上流中產階級而生，讓購物者遠離嘈雜骯髒的街道，置身封閉的空間；到了二十一世紀，手機成了新的櫥窗，個人檔案、購物紀錄與短影音不斷製造新的慾望，把人引入深淵。研究回到一部關於拱廊街的經典著作，追索漫遊者如何由時尚沉溺為戀物與權欲。設計語言借用輪迴的觀念：慾望諸界周而復始，唯有解脫方能終結。改造把這個循環轉化為空間，訪客沿著螺旋樓層一層層墜入慾望，只有一道樓梯提供逃離的出口。概念模型測試中庭裡的樓梯，以及沉在底部、難以掙脫的莫比烏斯環。成果是一座以螺旋坡道通往慾望的購物中心，立面上的廣告看板招引人們步入消費。它把商場呈現為一座慾望的深淵，人們在購物中逃離現實，卻也在每一次轉身時，被迫看見自己的處境。

pins.title: Koala Rehabilitation — Silver Lining Behind Darkness
pins.description:
A koala rescue and rehabilitation centre after the Australian bushfires, where staff and visitors care for koalas together.

New South Wales, Australia | Architecture | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 無尾熊復育中心——黑暗背後的一線光
zh-Hant.description:
澳洲叢林大火後的無尾熊救援與復育中心，讓工作人員與訪客一同照顧無尾熊。

澳洲新南威爾斯｜建築設計｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Koala and human: architecture as a medium between species.
無尾熊與人：建築作為不同物種之間的溝通媒介。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: From September 2019 to March 2020, bushfires burned 18.6 million hectares of Australia for more than eight months, with New South Wales and Victoria hit hardest. Global warming, hotter and drier conditions, topography and wind spread the fires, and the board records 62,000 koalas killed.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 2019 年 9 月至 2020 年 3 月，澳洲的叢林大火延燒超過八個月，焚毀 1,860 萬公頃土地，新南威爾斯與維多利亞受創最重。全球暖化、更炎熱乾燥的氣候、地形與風勢使火勢擴大，圖板記錄有 62,000 隻無尾熊喪生。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The strategy serves koalas through rehabilitation and humans through raising awareness of nature conservation, with tourist support funding the staff who rescue koalas. Site analysis maps the topography of a site in New South Wales, about an hour's drive from Newcastle and an hour and a half from Sydney.
captions: Site analysis and parti diagram: function, wind, connection, koala need and facade.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 策略一方面透過復育照顧無尾熊，一方面提升人們的自然保育意識，並以遊客的支持資助救援無尾熊的工作人員。基地分析描繪新南威爾斯一處基地的地形，距紐卡索約一小時車程，距雪梨約一個半小時。
captions: 基地分析與配置概念圖：機能、風、連結、無尾熊需求與立面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Parti diagrams set function, wind, connection, koala need and facade design, and four concepts guide the plan: sustainability, efficiency, interaction and education. A ramp connects the functional areas vertically and gives access to disabled people and stretchers, following the rescue process from emergency room to koala resting.
captions: Concept: sustainability, efficiency, interaction and education.
Efficiency: functions, rescue process and exploded axonometric.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 配置概念圖確立機能、風、連結、無尾熊需求與立面設計，四個概念引導平面：永續、效率、互動與教育。坡道在垂直方向串聯各機能區，方便身障者與擔架通行，並依循從急診室到無尾熊休養的救援流程。
captions: 概念：永續、效率、互動與教育。
效率：機能、救援流程與爆炸軸測圖。
