The first floor is a space for prayer and nature, the second holds activity and learning, and the third is for living and shared life. The plans arrange planting and play spaces, classrooms, a handicraft room and dormitories for girls and for boys. The elevation brings together a golden dome, traditional windows, a vegetation wall and fragrant cloth. A detailed section explains how walls and floors are built, finished with a white mortar of lime mixed with milk, saffron and honey. Within a familiar faith and landscape, the children find a roof under which childhood can rest.

zh-Hant.heading: 留守兒童之家-在信仰與自然之間學習與生活
zh-Hant.body: 在這片高原地區，許多孩子在父母遠赴外地工作的日子裡長大。設計者為這些留守兒童尋找一個家，讓孩子能在貼近自身文化與自然的地方，一起學習、遊戲與生活。形態從在地的營造方式出發：抬高框架樑以適應季節變化，增加樓層，擴大平台，並劃分機能；隨河水轉動的水轉經筒，以及刻有經文的瑪尼堆等在地習俗，也被引入基地。一樓是祈禱與親近自然的空間，二樓容納活動與學習，三樓則供居住與公共生活。平面中安排了種植與遊戲空間、教室、手工藝室，以及女孩與男孩的宿舍。立面採用金色穹頂、傳統窗飾、植生牆與香布；細部剖面說明牆與樓板的構造，白色的牆面灰漿以石灰混合牛奶、番紅花與蜂蜜調製而成。孩子們在熟悉的信仰與風景之中，找到一處可以安放童年的屋簷。

pins.title: Co-Living Community
pins.description:
A housing community where four personality types combine their favourite spaces and streets become passageways inside.

Co-living housing | 2019 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 共居社區
zh-Hant.description:
一個共居社區，四種性格類型組合各自喜愛的空間，街道化為建築內部的通道。

共居住宅｜2019｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: General axonometric view with the first, second and third floors.
整體軸測圖與一至三樓配置。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the city, our spaces are mostly connected only by roads, and everyday life moves from one closed room to the next. The project looks for a new state of living by turning external street connections into internal connections between homes.
captions: Design strategy: from streets connecting spaces to spaces connecting streets.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在城市中，我們的空間大多只靠道路相連，日常生活在一個個封閉房間之間移動。這個專題把外部的街道連結轉為住宅之間的內部連結，探索一種新的居住狀態。
captions: 設計策略：從街道串連空間，到空間串連街道。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Residents are grouped into four personality types, the protectors, artists, idealists and rationals, each with its own favourite place at home. For each type a set of shapes is generated from the rooms they value most, such as a large living room or a quiet study.
captions: Shape generation for each personality type.
Space division method: a square is cut, staggered and divided into three spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 住戶被歸納為四種性格類型：守護者、藝術家、理想主義者與理性者，各自在家中有最喜歡的地方。設計者依每種類型最重視的空間，例如大客廳或安靜的書房，生成一組形體。
captions: 各性格類型的形體生成。
空間劃分方法：將方塊切開、錯位，再分成三個空間。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The spaces of each type are combined into clusters, and different personalities combine with each other to form the building. The first floor consists of passageways, the public space grows from the second to the third floor, and every third floor is rotated by 90 degrees.
captions: Combined spaces of the four types.
Plans for each type of people.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 各類型的空間組合成群組，不同性格彼此結合，構成整棟建築。一樓由通道組成，公共空間從二樓到三樓逐漸增加，每三層樓便旋轉 90 度。
captions: 四種類型的組合空間。
各類型住戶的平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Combining the different house types naturally squeezes out a changing flow line, which the designer tested with a physical model. The axonometric shows homes, balconies and passageways stacked into one community.
captions: Model views: outer side, corridor, balconies and inside.
Axonometric of the stacked homes and passageways.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 不同住宅類型的組合自然擠壓出變化的動線，設計者以實體模型加以驗證。軸測圖呈現住宅、陽台與通道層層堆疊，形成一個社區。
captions: 模型視角：外側、走廊、陽台與內部。
住宅與通道堆疊的軸測圖。

sections.heading: Co-Living Community - Four Personalities Squeezing Out a Shifting Flow
sections.body: In the city, spaces are mostly linked only by roads, and everyday life moves from one closed room to the next. The project searches for a new state of living by turning the external connections of the street into internal connections between homes. Residents are grouped into four personality types, the protectors, the artists, the idealists and the rationals, each with a favourite place at home. For each type a set of shapes is generated from the rooms they value most, such as a large living room or a quiet study. The spaces of each type gather into clusters, and the different personalities then combine with one another to form the building. The first floor is made of passageways, public space grows from the second floor to the third, and every third floor is rotated by ninety degrees. Combining the different house types naturally squeezes out a changing flow line, which the designer tested with a physical model. The axonometric drawing shows homes, balconies and passageways stacked into a single community. Differences of character no longer keep neighbours apart; they become the very paths along which neighbours meet.

zh-Hant.heading: 共居社區-以四種性格擠出流動的動線
zh-Hant.body: 在城市裡，空間大多只靠道路相連，日常生活從一個封閉的房間移動到下一個房間。作品尋找一種新的居住狀態，把外部街道的連接，轉化為住宅之間的內部連接。居民被分為守護者、藝術家、理想主義者與理性者四種性格類型，各自在家中都有最喜愛的地方；依據每種類型最看重的房間，例如寬敞的客廳或安靜的書房，生成一組相應的形體。每種類型的空間組合成群簇，不同性格再彼此結合，形成整棟建築。一樓由通道構成，公共空間從二樓生長到三樓，每三層樓便旋轉九十度。不同戶型的組合，自然擠壓出一條不斷變化的動線，設計者以實體模型加以檢驗；軸測圖則呈現住宅、陽台與通道如何層層堆疊為一個社區。性格的差異不再是隔閡，反而成為鄰里相遇的路徑。

pins.title: Sky Loop
pins.description:
A ring building grafted onto office towers in Guangzhou so that people can walk, swim and read between them.

Guangzhou | Office ring bridge | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 空中環廊
zh-Hant.description:
一座嫁接在廣州辦公高樓上的環形建築，讓人們能在大樓之間行走、游泳與閱讀。

廣州｜辦公環廊｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The ring in the context of the office towers.
環形連廊與周邊辦公大樓。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is in Zhujiang New Town, the centre of Guangzhou, where there are many office buildings standing apart from each other. The design goal is to make the buildings come to life by grafting a ring building onto the towers so that people can walk between them.
captions: A comic-style collage on the pressure of office life.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於廣州市中心的珠江新城，那裡有許多彼此分離的辦公大樓。設計目標是讓建築活起來，把一座環形建築嫁接到高樓上，讓人們能在大樓之間行走。
captions: 以漫畫拼貼呈現辦公生活的壓力。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The designer tried rubber bands, bamboo strips, cotton, plastic pipe, iron wire and glue to connect model buildings, since each material has different properties. Wooden sticks were finally selected because they are feasible on a plane and in height.
captions: Conceptual model materials, from rubber bands to wooden sticks.
Design strategy: space grafting connection methods.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 設計者嘗試以橡皮筋、竹條、棉線、塑膠管、鐵絲與膠來連接模型建築，因為每種材料的特性都不同。最後選用木棒，因為它在平面與高度上都可行。
captions: 概念模型材料：從橡皮筋到木棒。
設計策略：空間嫁接的連結方法。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sketches and a structure idea turn the connection into a loop that climbs around the towers. The building plan places the ring among the office floors, and views from the top and the bottom show how it wraps the towers.
captions: Sketch and structure idea.
Building plan.
Views from top to bottom and from bottom to top.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 草圖與結構構想把連結轉化為一條環繞高樓攀升的環廊。建築平面把環廊安排在辦公樓層之間，由上往下與由下往上的視角呈現它如何包覆高樓。
captions: 草圖與結構構想。
建築平面圖。
由上往下與由下往上的視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the cropped office model, the gallery bridge crosses the office and interacts with the public space underneath, so people work and see others passing at the same time. On the loop, office workers can swim, read, meditate or visit an exhibition after busy hours.
captions: People using the cropped office model.
Cropped office model.
Swimming and reading spaces on the loop.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在辦公室剖切模型中，廊橋穿越辦公空間並與下方的公共空間互動，人們工作時也能看見往來的人。在環廊上，上班族忙碌之後可以游泳、閱讀、冥想或參觀展覽。
captions: 人們使用剖切辦公室模型的情景。
辦公室剖切模型。
環廊上的游泳與閱讀空間。

sections.heading: Sky Loop - A Ring That Lets Isolated Office Towers Meet
sections.body: The site lies at the heart of the city, where many office buildings stand apart from one another. The design aims to bring these buildings to life by grafting a ring-shaped building onto the towers so that people can walk between them. Because every material behaves differently, the designer tried rubber bands, bamboo strips, cotton, plastic pipe, iron wire and glue to join the model buildings. Wooden sticks were finally chosen, since they proved workable both on the plane and in height. Sketches and a structural idea turn the connection into a loop that climbs around the towers. The building plan places the ring among the office floors, and views from above and below show how it wraps the towers. In the cut-away office model, a gallery bridge crosses the office and engages the public space underneath, so that people work while watching others pass. On the loop, office workers can swim, read, meditate or visit an exhibition once their busy hours are over. Towers that once merely stood side by side gain, through a single ring, a reason to meet, and the skyline becomes a place where daily life can circulate.

zh-Hant.heading: 空中環廊-讓孤立的辦公塔樓彼此相連
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於城市的核心地帶，眾多辦公大樓各自矗立，彼此疏離。設計的目標是讓這些建築活起來：在塔樓之上嫁接一座環形建築，讓人們可以在大樓之間行走。由於每種材料的性質各不相同，設計者嘗試以橡皮筋、竹條、棉線、塑膠管、鐵絲與膠水連接模型建築，最後選定木棒，因為它在平面與高度上都具可行性。草圖與結構構想把連接轉化為一道環繞塔樓攀升的迴圈；建築平面將環廊安置在辦公樓層之間，從頂部與底部的視角，則呈現它如何纏繞塔樓。在剖切的辦公模型中，藝廊橋穿過辦公室，並與下方的公共空間互動；人們一邊工作，一邊看見他人經過。在環廊上，上班族結束忙碌的工作後，可以游泳、閱讀、冥想或參觀展覽。原本只是並立的塔樓，因一道環而有了交會的理由。

pins.title: Co-Living Community: Self, Ego and Superego
pins.description:
A tower in a Guangzhou roundabout whose levels stand for the self, the ego and the superego.

Guangzhou | Spiritual tower | 2018 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 共居社區：本我、自我與超我
zh-Hant.description:
一座位於廣州圓環中的高塔，各層分別代表本我、自我與超我。

廣州｜精神性高塔｜2018｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Program generation: the tower rises out of the roundabout among the roads.
機能生成：高塔從道路之間的圓環中升起。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is a roundabout in Hai Zhu District, Guangzhou, between a business district and residential areas. The program is spiritual in nature, a critique of today's society and the designer's own reflections on how people live.
captions: Location in Hai Zhu District and the roundabout site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是廣州海珠區的一座圓環，位於商業區與住宅區之間。這個機能帶有精神性，是對當今社會的批判，也是設計者對人們生活方式的自我反思。
captions: 海珠區的區位與圓環基地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Elements of daily life, responsibility, desire, fantasy and emotions are extracted as forms and fused into the self, the ego and the superego. These parts are then assembled into a conceptual model, with a manual model to nudge the form.
captions: Reference thinkers and images on the city, the self and society.
Extraction of elements and element fusion.
Assembly into the conceptual model.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 日常生活、責任、慾望、幻想與情緒等元素被提煉為形體，再融合成本我、自我與超我。這些部分接著組裝成概念模型，並以手作模型微調形體。
captions: 關於城市、自我與社會的參考人物與圖像。
元素提煉與元素融合。
組裝成概念模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The uppermost space represents the superego, where people stand high and watch the traffic, the middle represents the ego, where people pass by busy with work, and the space beneath represents the self with its most basic desires. The lanes around the roundabout let cars turn, cross and pass through the building.
captions: Extracting space: superego, ego and self.
Lane driving: make turns, go cross, pass through.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 最上方的空間代表超我，人們站在高處看著車流往來；中間代表自我，人們忙於工作而從此經過；底下的空間則代表擁有最基本慾望的本我。圓環周圍的車道讓車輛得以轉彎、穿越並通過建築。
captions: 空間提取：超我、自我與本我。
車道行駛：轉彎、穿越、通過。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: People see the building from the outside and enter its interior from the entrance, where they can watch the weaving traffic. The plan and section show the tower set into the roundabout, with the middle passage letting people go up.
captions: People see the building from the outside.
Entrance, internal access and interior space.
Plan view and section view.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 人們從外部看見建築，再由入口進入內部，在那裡可以觀看交織的車流。平面與剖面呈現嵌入圓環的高塔，中間的通道讓人們得以向上。
captions: 人們從外部看見建築。
入口、內部通道與室內空間。
平面圖與剖面圖。

sections.heading: Co-Living Community - Self, Ego and Superego Rising Above a Roundabout
sections.body: The site is a roundabout caught between a business district and residential neighbourhoods. The programme is spiritual in nature, both a critique of present-day society and the designer's own reflection on how people live. Elements of daily life, such as responsibility, desire, fantasy and emotion, are extracted as forms and fused into three parts: the self, the ego and the superego. These parts are assembled into a conceptual model, while a model made by hand is used to nudge the form step by step. The uppermost space stands for the superego, where people rise high and watch the traffic below. The middle stands for the ego, where people pass by, busy with work. The space beneath stands for the self, holding the most basic desires. The lanes around the roundabout let cars turn, cross and pass straight through the building. People first see the tower from outside, then enter from the entrance, where they can watch the weaving streams of traffic. The plan and section show the tower set into the roundabout, with a central passage that carries people upward. A single tower becomes a layered section through the human mind.

zh-Hant.heading: 共居社區-立於環島之上的本我自我與超我
zh-Hant.body: 基地是一座環島，夾在商業區與住宅區之間。這個計畫在本質上是精神性的，既是對當代社會的批判，也是設計者對人們如何生活的自我反思。日常生活、責任、欲望、幻想與情緒等元素被萃取為形體，再融合為本我、自我與超我三個部分；這些部分組裝成概念模型，並以手作模型一點一點推敲形態。最上層的空間代表超我，人們站在高處俯看車流；中段代表自我，人們為工作忙碌地穿行而過；底層的空間則代表本我，承載最基本的欲望。環島周圍的車道讓汽車得以轉彎、交會，並從建築之中穿越。人們先從外部看見這座建築，再由入口進入內部，在那裡觀看交織的車流。平面與剖面呈現塔樓嵌入環島的方式，中央的通道則引領人們一路向上。一座塔，便是一幅人心的分層剖面。

pins.title: Revitalization Design of Yuxiu Ancient Village
pins.description:
Rice fields, rice bricks and a rice tavern give a fading village in Zhuhai a new lease of life.

Zhuhai | Village revitalization | 2020–2021 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: Yuxiu 古村活化設計
zh-Hant.description:
以稻田、稻米磚與米酒館，讓珠海一座逐漸被遺忘的村落重獲新生。

珠海｜村落活化｜2020–2021｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Material analysis from paddy to rice bricks, and the village from above.
從稻穀到稻米磚的材料分析，以及村落鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Yuxiu Village in Zhuhai, Guangdong, is a historic agricultural village with only one main road, low houses and dilapidated buildings. The accelerated urbanization has made people gradually forget its existence, so the project asks how it can be given a new lease of life.
captions: The village location and its history.
Site explosion map: village outline, texture, roads, rice fields and intersections.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣東珠海的Yuxiu 村是一座歷史悠久的農村，只有一條主要道路，房屋低矮且老舊破敗。快速的都市化讓人們逐漸遺忘它的存在，因此這個專題探問如何讓它重獲新生。
captions: 村落的位置與歷史。
基地分層分析：村落輪廓、肌理、道路、稻田與路口。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Villages take up 40 % of the area, rice fields 35 % with three harvests per year, and roads only 5 %, with just four intersections from the main road to the village. Rice is studied as an industry and as a material, and three houses are selected for their continuity and innovation.
captions: A collage of village life and the elderly left behind.
Industry analysis of rice.
Finalize the house: site selection, features, continuity and innovation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 村落占基地面積的 40 %，稻田占 35 % 且一年三熟，道路只占 5 %，從主要道路進入村落只有四個路口。設計者把稻米同時當作產業與材料來研究，並依延續與創新選定三棟房屋。
captions: 村落生活與留守長者的拼貼。
稻米的產業分析。
選定房屋：基地選擇、特徵、延續與創新。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Three house sections and building detail nodes are shown in exploded views, and rice from the paddy is ground and pressed into rice bricks for the walls. Renderings show people watching light spill through the screens, a living room facing the landscape and a bridge to the rice gallery.
captions: House sections, exploded views and the house model.
Renderings of the spaces.
Detail nodes and the long section.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三棟房屋的剖面與構造節點以爆炸圖呈現，田裡的稻米被研磨、壓製成牆面使用的稻米磚。渲染圖呈現人們觀看光線穿過格柵灑落、面向景觀的起居空間，以及通往稻米展廊的橋。
captions: 房屋剖面、爆炸圖與房屋模型。
空間渲染圖。
構造節點與長剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The rice tavern model shows a tourist and a farmer in the same space, where people can watch how rice wine is made. Visitors can also walk up to the roof to enjoy the view of the fields.
captions: Rice tavern model and interior spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 米酒館模型呈現遊客與農民同處一個空間，人們可以在這裡觀看米酒的釀造過程。訪客也能走上屋頂，欣賞田野景色。
captions: 米酒館模型與室內空間。

sections.heading: Revitalization of an Ancient Village - A Rice Tavern Built From Its Own Paddies
sections.body: This is a historic farming village with a single main road, low houses and dilapidated buildings. Accelerating urbanisation has made people slowly forget it exists, so the project asks how the village might be given a new lease of life. Houses take up forty percent of the area and rice fields thirty-five percent, harvested three times a year, while roads cover only five percent, with just four junctions leading from the main road into the village. Rice is studied both as an industry and as a material, and three houses are chosen for their continuity and their potential for innovation. Their sections and building details are drawn in exploded views, and rice from the paddies is ground and pressed into bricks for the walls. Renderings show people watching light spill through the screens, a living room that faces the fields and a bridge leading to a rice gallery. The model of the rice tavern places a tourist and a farmer in the same room, where visitors can watch rice wine being made. They can also climb to the roof to take in the fields, as rice travels from the paddy into the wall and finally into the cup.

zh-Hant.heading: 古村活化-以稻米為磚的米酒館
zh-Hant.body: 這是一座歷史悠久的農業村落，只有一條主要道路，房屋低矮，建築殘破；加速的城市化讓人們逐漸遺忘它的存在，作品因此追問，如何為它注入新的生命。村落佔基地面積四成，稻田佔三成五，一年三熟，道路僅佔百分之五，從主幹道進入村子也只有四個路口。稻米同時被當作一種產業與一種材料來研究，三棟房屋則因其延續性與創新性而被選出。三棟房屋的剖面與建築節點以爆炸圖呈現，稻田裡的稻米被研磨、壓製成米磚，砌成牆體。透視圖描繪人們看著光線從屏風間灑落，客廳面向田野，一座橋通往稻米藝廊。米酒館的模型中，遊客與農人共處同一空間，人們可以觀看米酒如何釀成；來訪者也能走上屋頂，眺望整片稻田。稻米從田裡走進牆裡，再化為杯中的酒，讓被遺忘的村落重新被看見。

pins.title: Oil Tank Eco Park
pins.description:
A disused oil tank factory in Foshan is cleansed, flooded into a wetland and reopened as a post-industrial park.

Foshan | Landscape regeneration | 2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 油罐生態公園
zh-Hant.description:
佛山一座廢棄油罐廠經過淨化、引水成為濕地，再以後工業公園的樣貌重新開放。

佛山｜景觀再生｜2022｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Phase III: the final masterplan on the river bank.
第三階段：河岸上的最終總平面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Since the 1980s the Nanhai district of Foshan has grown as an industrial area, with oil tank, printing and furniture factories built along the river. The site is a disused oil tank factory with 15 tanks of various sizes on the river bank, where petroleum has poisoned the soil and effluent and chemicals reach the river.
captions: Pollution condition: factory gas, dust, effluent and toxic chemicals.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 自 1980 年代起，佛山南海區發展為工業區，油罐廠、印刷廠與家具廠沿河興建。基地是一座廢棄的油罐廠，河岸上立著 15 座大小不一的油罐，石油污染了土壤，廢水與化學物質流入河中。
captions: 污染現況：工廠廢氣、粉塵、廢水與有毒化學物質。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project sets out to purify the land before opening it to nature and people. It works in three phases: decontaminate the land by artificial and natural means, open up the watershed into an ecological wetland, and retrofit the oil tanks with recreational functions.
captions: Phase 1 land decontamination, phase 2 open water area, phase 3 placement of functions.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 專題先淨化土地，再把它開放給自然與人。整個過程分為三個階段：以人工與自然方式整治土地、打開水域形成生態濕地，最後改造油罐、置入休閒機能。
captions: 第一階段土地除污、第二階段開放水域、第三階段置入機能。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Highly contaminated soil is excavated and reused as the base for the topography, while low-risk soil is treated by phytoremediation and strip forests keep out dust from the high-speed trains and factories. A created wetland improves water quality and gives fish and wildlife a habitat, and the final topography follows the decontamination steps.
captions: Phase I land restoration: dig and fill, phytoremediation, protection from dust.
Phase II water treatment and the wetland food chain.
Morphology: from the original terrain to the final form.
Functional concepts, road network and the programme legend.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 高污染土壤被挖除，並再利用為地形的基礎；低風險土壤以植物修復處理，帶狀林地阻擋高鐵與工廠的粉塵。新設的濕地改善水質，也為魚類與野生動物提供棲地，最終地形則依循除污的步驟成形。
captions: 第一階段土地修復：挖填、植物修復、防塵。
第二階段水處理與濕地食物鏈。
地形推演：從原始地形到最終形態。
機能概念、道路系統與機能圖例。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A new post-industrial park: some tanks hold cafes, showrooms and lounges, some are hollowed out into gardens or opened with skylights, and others are raised for viewing platforms. Viewing bridges connect the tanks, and a sunken plaza is half shallow water square and half amphitheatre.
captions: Oil tank renewal: feel structure, space, garden, light and height.
Long section of the park from the wetland to the tanks.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一座新的後工業公園：部分油罐容納咖啡館、展示廳與休息室，部分被掏空成花園或開設天窗，另一些則被抬高作為瞭望平台。觀景橋串連各個油罐，下沉廣場一半是淺水廣場、一半是圓形劇場。
captions: 油罐更新：感受結構、空間、花園、光線與高度。
從濕地到油罐的公園長剖面。

sections.heading: Oil Tank Eco Park - Cleansing the Ground Before Opening It to Nature
sections.body: Since the 1980s this riverside district has grown as an industrial area, with oil tank, printing and furniture factories lining the water. The site is a disused oil tank factory with fifteen tanks of various sizes on the bank, where petroleum has poisoned the soil and effluent and chemicals reach the river. The project sets out to purify the land before opening it to nature and people, working in three phases: decontaminate the ground by artificial and natural means, open the watershed into an ecological wetland, and retrofit the tanks with recreational functions. Highly contaminated soil is excavated and reused as the base of the new topography, while low-risk soil is treated by phytoremediation, and strip forests keep out dust from high-speed trains and factories. A created wetland improves water quality and offers fish and wildlife a habitat, and the final landform follows the steps of decontamination. In the new post-industrial park some tanks hold cafes, showrooms and lounges, some are hollowed into gardens or opened with skylights, and others are raised as viewing platforms. Viewing bridges link the tanks, and a sunken plaza is half shallow water square and half amphitheatre.

zh-Hant.heading: 油罐生態公園-先淨化土地再向自然開放
zh-Hant.body: 自上世紀八十年代起，這一帶沿河發展為工業區，工廠林立。基地是一座廢棄的油罐廠，河岸上散落著十五座大小不一的油罐，石油毒害了土壤，廢水與化學物質也流入河中。作品主張先淨化土地，再向自然與人開放，並分三個階段進行：以人工與自然的方式為土地除污，把集水區打開為生態濕地，最後為油罐改造出休閒機能。高度污染的土壤被挖出，再利用為地形的基底；低風險的土壤以植物修復處理，帶狀林則阻擋高鐵與工廠揚起的塵土。人工濕地改善水質，為魚類與野生動物提供棲地，最終的地形也依循除污的步驟而生。在新的後工業公園裡，有些油罐容納咖啡館、展廳與休憩室，有些被掏空為花園或開設天窗，有些則被抬升為觀景平台；觀景橋串連油罐，下沉廣場一半是淺水廣場，一半是露天劇場。

pins.title: Conflict to Harmony
pins.description:
Restored greenland, a sunken corridor and a border of beehives let elephants and villagers in Botswana share the land.

Chobe Enclave, Botswana | Landscape and coexistence | 2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 從衝突到和諧
zh-Hant.description:
以復育的綠地、下沉廊道與蜂箱邊界，讓波札那的大象與村民共享土地。

波札那 Chobe 飛地｜景觀與共存｜2022｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Handmade model of the elephant corridor and the elephant hospital.
大象廊道與大象醫院的手作模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the Chobe Enclave in Botswana, habitat loss and fragmentation are the leading causes of human-elephant conflict, as wild lands are converted into settlements and farms. Elephants and villagers now compete for resources in the same space, so the project asks how both can live together safely.
captions: Strategy 1: restoring forest after wildfire, dry land after drought and grassland after invasion.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在波札那的 Chobe 飛地，棲地流失與破碎化是人象衝突的主因，荒野不斷被轉作聚落與農地。大象與村民如今在同一片空間爭奪資源，因此專題探問兩者如何安全地共存。
captions: 策略一：火災後的森林、乾旱後的旱地與入侵後的草地復育。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The first strategy restores three types of greenland through artificial seeding, rainwater harvesting structures and the removal of invasive plants, creating new habitat for the elephants. When elephants have no choice but to enter the village, a sunken corridor guides them through safely without damaging the residents' property.
captions: Corridor sections A-A and B-B: water collecting and the elephant SOS station.
Corridor sections C-C and D-D: camping area and slope plantation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 第一個策略以人工播種、就地集雨構造與清除入侵植物，復育三種綠地，為大象創造新棲地。當大象不得不進入村落時，一條下沉的廊道引導牠們安全通過，不損及居民的財產。
captions: 廊道剖面 A-A 與 B-B：集水與大象救援站。
廊道剖面 C-C 與 D-D：露營區與坡地種植。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: In the rainy season the corridor becomes a natural reservoir that collects and purifies rainwater for agriculture, and its slopes grow crops that elephants do not like. A natural border of beehives, which elephants dislike for their noise, replaces costly thorny plants and gives the villagers honey as extra income.
captions: Strategy 3: plantation patterns and how to build the border with beehives.
Strategy plan of village routes, bee box areas and elephant directions.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 雨季時，廊道成為收集並淨化雨水、供農業使用的天然蓄水池，坡面則種植大象不喜歡的作物。以大象厭惡其聲響的蜂箱構成天然邊界，取代成本高的帶刺植物，也讓村民以蜂蜜增加收入。
captions: 策略三：種植配置，以及如何用蜂箱建立邊界。
村落路線、蜂箱區與大象動線的策略配置圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: An elephant rescue station in the middle of the corridor helps injured elephants heal, and landscape bridges and a camping area bring tourism to the village. The handmade model shows how villagers and elephants keep their own flows without interfering with each other.
captions: Model views: under the bridge, from the village towards the elephant hospital, and towards its exit.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 廊道中央的大象救援站協助受傷的大象療傷，景觀橋與露營區則為村落帶來觀光。手作模型呈現村民與大象各有動線、互不干擾的樣貌。
captions: 模型視角：橋下、從村落望向大象醫院，以及望向醫院出口。

sections.heading: Conflict to Harmony - A Sunken Corridor Where Elephants and Villagers Keep Their Own Paths
sections.body: As wild lands are turned into settlements and farms, the loss and fragmentation of habitat become the leading causes of conflict between people and elephants. Elephants and villagers now compete for resources in the same space, so the project asks how both might live together safely. The first strategy restores three types of greenland through artificial seeding, rainwater harvesting structures and the removal of invasive plants, creating new habitat for the herds. When elephants have no choice but to enter the village, a sunken corridor guides them through without damaging the property of residents. In the rainy season the corridor becomes a natural reservoir that gathers and purifies rainwater for farming, while its slopes grow crops that elephants do not like. A natural border of beehives, whose noise elephants dislike, replaces costly thorny plants and gives villagers honey as extra income. A rescue station in the middle of the corridor helps injured elephants heal, and landscape bridges and a camping area bring visitors to the village. The handmade model shows how villagers and elephants keep their own flows without interfering with each other, so that conflict settles into a quiet coexistence.

zh-Hant.heading: 從衝突到和諧-讓象群與村落各行其道的下沉廊道
zh-Hant.body: 荒野被改建為聚落與農田，棲地的流失與破碎成為人象衝突的首要原因；象群與村民在同一片土地上爭奪資源，作品於是追問，兩者如何能安全地共同生活。第一項策略透過人工播種、集雨構造與移除入侵植物，修復三種綠地，為象群創造新的棲地。當大象別無選擇必須進入村莊時，一條下沉廊道引導牠們安全通過，不損及居民的財產；雨季時，廊道化身天然水庫，收集並淨化雨水供農業使用，坡面則種植大象不喜歡的作物。大象厭惡蜂群的聲響，一道蜂箱構成的自然邊界取代昂貴的荊棘植物，也讓村民多了蜂蜜的收入。廊道中央的救援站照料受傷的大象，地景橋與露營區為村莊帶來旅遊。手作模型呈現村民與象群如何保有各自的流動，彼此互不干擾，衝突就此轉為一種安靜的共存。

pins.title: The Power of Plants
pins.description:
A vertical tree tower in Mannheim generates electricity from living plants and shares it with the neighbourhood.

Mannheim, Germany | Energy landscape | 2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 植物的力量
zh-Hant.description:
曼海姆的一座垂直樹塔，以活體植物發電，並與鄰里共享電力。

德國曼海姆｜能源景觀｜2022｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The tree tower by day and by night, lit by electricity from its own plants.
白天與夜晚的樹塔，由自身植物產生的電力點亮。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In 2022 Europe fell into an energy crisis: many households could not afford their electricity bills, and many places lacked heating in winter. As a landscape architecture student, the designer asked whether living plants, which can also generate electricity, could help light the city's future.
captions: The site: a planned green area of 53 hectares next to two residential areas in Mannheim.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 2022 年歐洲陷入能源危機，許多家庭負擔不起電費，不少地方冬季暖氣不足。身為景觀建築學生，設計者探問：同樣能夠發電的活體植物，能否幫忙點亮城市的未來。
captions: 基地：曼海姆兩個住宅區旁、占地 53 公頃的規劃綠地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The residents here are densely concentrated and their demand for electricity is high, at about 45 cents per kWh. Instead of a large city garden, the project stacks the green space into one vertical tree tower, saving about 99% of the area while adding lighting, co-planting, communication, public space and shared charging.
captions: Strategy: from a large city garden to a vertical garden with different functions, creating a new tree.
Tower section: steel structure, planting platforms, water purifying layers, storage battery and shared charging station.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 這裡的居民高度集中、用電需求大，電價約每度 45 歐分。專題不做大面積的城市花園，而是把綠地疊成一座垂直的樹塔，省下約 99% 的面積，同時加入燈光、共同種植、交流、公共空間與共享充電等功能。
captions: 策略：從大面積城市花園，到具多重功能的垂直花園，創造一棵新的樹。
樹塔剖面：型鋼結構、種植平台、淨水層、蓄電池與共享充電站。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Visitors start from the square on the ground floor, with a shared charging station and a water plaza, then climb to plant platforms where they choose their favourite plants to cultivate. The planted tower also cools the area, and DIY kits from the kiosk let people assemble wires and plants to make plant electricity at home.
captions: Simulations show the tower keeping the space cool even when many people gather.
Construction manual of the plant power kit: prepare the plant, install the wire, measure the electricity.
Storyboard of residents choosing plants, buying a kit and assembling it.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 遊客從一樓廣場出發，那裡有共享充電站與水廣場，再沿樓梯走上種植平台，挑選喜歡的植物栽種。種滿植物的樹塔也為周邊降溫；售亭的 DIY 套件，讓人們在家組裝電線與植物，自己產生植物電力。
captions: 模擬顯示即使人群聚集，樹塔仍能讓空間保持涼爽。
植物電力套件的組裝說明：準備植物、安裝電線、量測電力。
居民挑選植物、購買套件並動手組裝的分鏡。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A travel tour leads visitors through the plaza, the plantation platform and the water purifying layers, and at night the tower glows with light from its plants. The future vision imagines the tower being replicated across Europe, supplying electricity to the surrounding communities.
captions: Travel tour storyboard of visitors exploring the tower.
Stratified plan: ground floor plaza, plantation platform and water purifying layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 遊覽路線帶領遊客走過廣場、種植平台與淨水層；入夜後，樹塔以植物產生的光發亮。未來願景設想這座樹塔在歐洲各地複製，為周邊社區供電。
captions: 遊客探索樹塔的遊覽分鏡。
分層平面：一樓廣場、種植平台與淨水層。

sections.heading: Power of Plants - A Tree Tower That Lights the City With Plant Electricity
sections.body: An energy crisis swept in, many households could not pay their electricity bills, and many places lacked heating through the winter. As a student of landscape architecture, the designer asked whether living plants, which can also generate electricity, might help to light the future of the city. Residents here are densely packed, their demand for power is high, and electricity is costly. Instead of a large city garden, the project stacks green space into a single vertical tree tower, saving about ninety-nine percent of the land while adding lighting, shared planting, communication, public space and shared charging. Visitors begin at a ground-floor square with a charging station and a water plaza, then climb to planting platforms where they choose favourite plants to grow by hand. The planted tower also cools its surroundings, and kits from the kiosk let people assemble wires and plants to make plant electricity at home. A tour leads through the plaza, the planting platforms and the water-cleaning layers, and at night the tower glows with light drawn from its plants. The vision imagines the tower repeated elsewhere, powering the communities around it.

zh-Hant.heading: 植物的力量-一座以植物發電照亮城市的樹塔
zh-Hant.body: 一場能源危機席捲而來，許多家庭付不起電費，不少地方在冬天缺乏暖氣。身為地景建築的學生，設計者追問：同樣能夠發電的活植物，能否協助照亮城市的未來？這裡的居民高度密集，用電需求龐大，電價也居高不下。作品沒有規劃一座大型的城市花園，而是把綠地堆疊為一座垂直的樹塔，節省約九成九的面積，同時增添照明、共同種植、交流、公共空間與共享充電的機能。來訪者從一樓設有共享充電站與水廣場的廣場出發，攀上種植平台，挑選自己喜愛的植物親手栽培；種滿植物的塔樓也為周遭降溫，售貨亭提供的自組套件，讓人們能在家中組裝電線與植物，自製植物電力。一條參觀路線帶領人們走過廣場、種植平台與淨水層，入夜後，樹塔便以植物所發出的光芒點亮夜空。未來的願景，是讓這座樹塔在各地複製，為周邊社區供應電力。

pins.title: New Fishery Town
pins.description:
Waste oyster shells become soil additives and the core of a new water-town fishery complex in Nansha, Guangzhou.

Nansha, Guangzhou, China | Fishery and recycling | 2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 新漁鎮
zh-Hant.description:
廢棄蠔殼化為土壤添加劑，成為廣州南沙新水鄉漁業綜合體的核心。

中國廣州南沙｜漁業與回收｜2022｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Aerial view of the new fishery town on the water's edge.
水岸新漁鎮的鳥瞰圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Nansha is a well-known water town in Guangzhou, but with urbanisation, densely packed high-rise buildings have appeared in many places and the character of the water town is being lost. The site lies between undeveloped farmland and the modernised area, and about 48% of the residents nearby still work in fishing, mainly catching shellfish such as oysters.
captions: Research and problems: soft soil, fishery distress and over-construction.
Process of thinking: the oyster shell as the core of a fishery system, shell processing and environment improvement.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 南沙是廣州著名的水鄉，但隨著都市化，密集的高樓在許多地方出現，水鄉的特色逐漸流失。基地位於未開發農地與現代化城區之間，周邊約 48% 的居民仍從事漁業，主要捕撈蠔等貝類。
captions: 研究與問題：軟土、漁業困境與過度開發。
思考過程：以蠔殼為核心，串起漁業系統、殼料處理與環境改善。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project builds a new fishery system around the oyster shell. Waste shells from seafood restaurants and the aquatic market are transported, cleaned, sifted, dried, smashed and processed into additives that improve the soft clay soil of the area, and the whole production line becomes part of the landscape.
captions: Experiments testing compression and permeability of oyster-shell soil blocks.
The fishery system, the shell processing steps and the spaces that improve the environment.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 專題以蠔殼為核心建立新的漁業系統。海鮮餐廳與水產市場的廢棄蠔殼經過運送、清洗、篩砂、乾燥、粉碎與加工，成為改良當地軟土的添加劑，整條生產線也成為景觀的一部分。
captions: 測試蚵殼土塊抗壓與透水性的實驗。
漁業系統、殼料處理步驟，以及改善環境的各個空間。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The complex follows the fishermen's boating routes and the convenience of the residential area. The original fish pond is connected to the waterside, and the abandoned factory is taken apart, divided into three parts around a new canal, then rotated and lifted to open views and connect the blocks.
captions: Design process: from the original site to divided, rotated and lifted blocks.
Master plan of the fishery town and its waterfront.
Second floor plan, 1:1000.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 綜合體依循漁民的行船路線與住宅區的便利性配置。原有魚塘接上水岸，廢棄工廠則被拆解，沿一條新運河分成三個部分，再經旋轉與抬升，打開視野並串連各個量體。
captions: 設計過程：從原始基地到分割、旋轉與抬升的量體。
漁鎮與水岸的總平面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Fishermen find a place to sell their catch, residents come to experience the culture of the water town and eat fresh seafood, and tourists learn how oyster shells are recycled. The section follows the shell from tasting seafood to recycling, the shell elevator, processing, the shell lab and the delivery of products.
captions: Site activities: shells collected from restaurants and markets, and the aquatic market interior.
Section through the restaurant, the aquatic market and the shell processing spaces (17 m, 20 m and 66 m).

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 漁民有了販售漁獲的地方，居民來此體驗水鄉文化、品嚐新鮮海鮮，遊客則認識蠔殼如何被回收。剖面沿著蠔殼的旅程展開：品嚐海鮮、回收殼料、殼料電梯、加工、殼料實驗室，到產品出貨。
captions: 場地活動：從餐廳與市場回收蚵殼，以及水上市場室內。
貫穿餐廳、水產市場與殼料處理空間的剖面（17 m、20 m 與 66 m）。

sections.heading: New Fishery Town - Letting Discarded Oyster Shells Nourish a Water Town Again
sections.body: This is a well-known water town, yet as urbanisation spreads, dense high-rise towers have appeared in many places and the character of the town is fading. The site lies between undeveloped farmland and the modernised area, and about forty-eight percent of nearby residents still make their living from fishing, mainly gathering shellfish such as oysters. The project builds a new fishery system around the oyster shell. Waste shells from seafood restaurants and the aquatic market are carried, cleaned, sifted, dried and crushed into an additive that improves the soft clay soil of the area, and the whole production line becomes part of the landscape. The complex follows the boating routes of fishermen and the convenience of the housing area. The old fish pond is joined to the waterside, and an abandoned factory is taken apart, split into three parts around a new canal, then rotated and lifted to open views and connect the blocks. Fishermen gain a place to sell their catch, residents come to taste fresh seafood, and visitors learn how shells are reborn. The section follows one shell from the table to the finished product.

zh-Hant.heading: 蠔殼新漁鎮-讓廢棄的蠔殼重新滋養水鄉
zh-Hant.body: 這是一座著名的水鄉，然而隨著都市化，密集的高樓在各處出現，水鄉的特色正逐漸流失。基地位於尚未開發的農田與現代化地區之間，附近約有四成八的居民仍以漁業為生，主要捕撈蠔等貝類。作品圍繞蠔殼建立一套新的漁業系統：海鮮餐廳與水產市場的廢棄蠔殼，經過運輸、清洗、篩選、乾燥、粉碎，被加工成改良當地軟黏土壤的添加劑，整條生產線也成為地景的一部分。綜合體依循漁民的行船路線與住宅區的便利性配置；原有的魚塘與水岸相連，廢棄的工廠被拆解，圍繞一條新運河分為三部分，再經旋轉與抬升，打開視野並連接各個街廓。漁民在此有了販售漁獲的地方，居民前來體驗水鄉文化、品嚐鮮美的海鮮，遊客則認識蠔殼如何被回收再生。剖面追隨一枚蠔殼的旅程，從品嚐海鮮到回收、蠔殼電梯、加工、蠔殼實驗室，直至產品出貨。

pins.title: E-commerce City Complex
pins.description:
A three-layer rural complex stacks homes, a live-streaming economy and a Hanfu factory to bring talent back to the countryside.

China | Rural urban complex | 2021 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 電商城市綜合體
zh-Hant.description:
一座三層的鄉村綜合體，疊合居住、直播經濟與漢服工廠，吸引人才回到鄉村。

中國｜鄉村城市綜合體｜2021｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The urban complex stacked in three layers above the countryside.
在鄉村之上疊成三層的城市綜合體。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: E-commerce villages have multiplied across rural China, from 3 in 2009 to 5,425 in 2020, driven by residents, government support and online platforms. This design hopes to attract talent back to the countryside through an attractive urban complex, and to promote Hanfu culture through live-streaming with goods as a key function.
captions: Development of Taobao Villages in China: the number in each province and the clothes-sales link to the site.
Axonometric drawing: the original rural texture as the top living layer.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 中國鄉村的電商村快速增加，從 2009 年的 3 個成長到 2020 年的 5,425 個，背後是居民自發、政府支持與電商平台的發展。這個設計希望透過一座有吸引力的城市綜合體，吸引人才回到鄉村，並以直播帶貨為核心機能推廣漢服文化。
captions: 中國淘寶村的發展：各省數量，以及與基地相連的服裝銷售。
軸測圖：以原有的鄉村肌理作為頂層的居住空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site problems include poor living conditions, a loss of talent to big cities, traffic jams caused by the factories, a single industrial chain and a saturated market. A crowd identity transformation mechanism maps how villagers, workers and newcomers can change roles, and a framework links living, production and display.
captions: Mapping the village: factories, clothing companies and the site.
Site problems: poor living conditions, lack of talent, traffic jams, a single industrial chain and market saturation.
Crowd identity transformation mechanism and the design framework.
Strategy diagrams linking the functions of the complex with its surroundings.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地的問題包括居住條件不佳、人才外流到大城市、工廠造成交通壅塞、產業鏈單一與市場飽和。人群身分轉換機制描繪村民、工人與新來者如何轉換角色，再以架構圖串連居住、生產與展示。
captions: 村落調查圖：工廠、服裝公司與基地。
基地問題：居住條件差、人才外流、交通壅塞、產業鏈單一與市場飽和。
人群身分轉換機制與設計架構。
串連綜合體機能與周邊環境的策略圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The complex takes the original rural texture as the top living area, with live broadcast sales, traffic supervision, opinion collection and influencer training in the middle layer, and the factory producing Hanfu in the bottom layer. Residents move up and down through the elevators and stairs of the traffic centre, while a corridor on the second floor leads out to the surrounding countryside.
captions: Design process: from the original village to the layered complex.
1st, 2nd and 3rd floor plans.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 綜合體以原有的鄉村肌理作為頂層居住空間，中層容納直播銷售、交通管理、意見收集與網紅培訓，底層則是生產漢服的工廠。居民經由交通核的電梯與樓梯上下移動，二樓的廊道則通往周邊的鄉村。
captions: 設計過程：從原有村落到分層的綜合體。
一樓、二樓與三樓平面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The physical model and the final rendering show the three layers working together: homes on top, a live-streaming economy in the middle and production at the base. In this teamwork project, the student's contribution covered site analysis, the model and the renderings.
captions: Physical model photos of the layered complex.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 實體模型與最終渲染呈現三層如何協同運作：上層居住、中層直播經濟、底層生產。這是一個團隊作業，學生負責基地分析、模型與渲染。
captions: 分層綜合體的實體模型照片。

sections.heading: E-Commerce City Complex - Drawing Talent Back to the Countryside Through Live Streaming
sections.body: E-commerce villages have multiplied across the countryside, growing from a handful to more than five thousand in just over a decade, driven by residents, government support and online platforms. The design hopes to draw talent back to rural areas through an appealing urban complex, and to promote a traditional clothing culture with live-streamed selling as a key function. The problems of the site include poor living conditions, the loss of talent to big cities, traffic jams caused by factories, a single industrial chain and a saturated market. A mechanism of shifting identities maps how villagers, workers and newcomers can change roles, and a framework links living, production and display. The complex keeps the original rural texture as the living area on top. The middle layer holds live-stream sales, traffic supervision, opinion gathering and influencer training, and the factory producing the garments sits at the base. Residents move up and down through the lifts and stairs of a transport core, while a second-floor corridor leads out to the fields. In this teamwork project the student covered site analysis, the model and the renderings.

zh-Hant.heading: 電商城市綜合體-以直播把人才帶回鄉村
zh-Hant.body: 電商村在鄉村地區迅速增加，十餘年間從個位數成長到五千多個，背後是居民、政府支持與網路平台的共同推動。這份設計希望透過一座具吸引力的城市綜合體，吸引人才回流鄉村，並以帶貨直播作為核心機能，推廣傳統服飾文化。基地面臨居住條件不佳、人才外流、交通壅塞、產業單一與市場飽和等問題；一套人群身分轉換機制，描繪村民、工人與新來者如何轉換角色，一個框架則把生活、生產與展示連結起來。綜合體以原有的鄉村肌理作為頂層的居住區，中間層容納直播銷售、交通管理、意見蒐集與網紅培訓，底層則是生產服飾的工廠；居民透過交通核的電梯與樓梯上下移動，二樓的廊道則通往周圍的田野。實體模型與最終渲染呈現三個層次的協作：居住在上，直播經濟居中，生產在下。這是一份團隊作品，學生負責基地分析、模型與渲染。

pins.title: Anchor Point Community
pins.description:
Anchor points and a slow walking path turn an old factory site in Changsha into a walkable community for elderly residents.

Changsha, China | Community renewal for the elderly | 2021 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 錨點社區
zh-Hant.description:
以錨點與慢行步道，將長沙的老工廠基地轉化為適合高齡居民步行生活的社區。

中國長沙｜高齡社區更新｜2021｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The slow walking path linking anchor points through the community.
串連社區各錨點的慢行步道。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The elderly population in China is growing year by year, and ageing is becoming increasingly serious. In an old factory site on the Liuyang River in Changsha, the survey found that elderly people make up a large proportion of the residents, while the site offers unsuitable space for them, old factories and dormitories, and low public vitality.
captions: Age structure of the country and of the region.
Site analysis and mapping: buildings to be demolished, the area to be developed and the river edge.
Existing space analysis: poor accessibility, lack of rest space and monotonous activity.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 中國的高齡人口逐年增加，老化問題日益嚴重。在長沙瀏陽河畔的一處老工廠基地，調查發現高齡者占居民的很大比例，但基地缺乏適合他們的空間，充斥老舊工廠與宿舍，公共活力也偏低。
captions: 全國與地區的人口年齡結構。
基地分析與調查圖：待拆除建築、待開發區域與河岸。
既有空間分析：可及性不佳、缺乏休憩空間、活動單調。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A site survey and questionnaire in November 2021 compared the needs of elderly people who live alone with those who live with their children, from re-employment and cultural activity to healthcare, restaurants and shopping. The strategy groups these needs around anchor points that offer accessibility and attraction.
captions: How elders feel in the area: lonely, empty, confused, tired, haggard, inconvenienced and in danger.
Social research: activity needs of the two groups and the space demand.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 2021 年 11 月的現地調查與問卷，比較獨居高齡者與和子女同住者的需求，從再就業、文化活動到醫療、餐飲與購物。策略將這些需求組織在提供可及性與吸引力的錨點周圍。
captions: 長者在此地的感受：孤單、空虛、困惑、疲憊、憔悴、不便與危險。
社會調查：兩類高齡者的活動需求與空間需求。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The elderly who live alone want to socialise and take 250 metres as their five-minute life circle; those who live with family have a smaller range and take 200 metres. Anchor points are placed so that each serves both kinds of community, a slow walking path connects them all, and functions for higher-level needs sit inside the life circle, while old factories are converted into a teahouse, library, canteen, theatre, museum and gardening space.
captions: Design process: functional partition, traffic design, anchor points and other points.
Master plan of the renewed community along the river.
Space renovation for residential and public space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 獨居高齡者希望社交，以 250 公尺作為五分鐘生活圈；與家人同住者活動範圍較小，以 200 公尺為生活圈。錨點的配置讓每一處都能服務兩類社區，並以慢行步道串連，高層次需求的機能則安排在生活圈內，老工廠則改造為茶館、圖書館、食堂、劇場、博物館與園藝空間。
captions: 設計過程：機能分區、交通設計、錨點與其他節點。
沿河更新社區的總平面圖。
居住空間與公共空間的改造。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Anchor points at the hospital and the kindergarten, and active points for gardening, an elderly barber, a park and a riverside path, turn the old factory site into a walkable community. Elderly residents can rest, exercise and meet there.
captions: Anchor point vignettes and the axonometric drawing of the community.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 醫院與幼兒園的錨點，加上園藝、長者理髮、公園與河岸步道等活動點，讓老工廠基地成為一個可步行的社區。高齡居民能在這裡休憩、運動與相聚。
captions: 錨點場景與社區軸測圖。

sections.heading: Anchor Point Community - A Five-Minute Life Circle for Elders in an Old Factory Site
sections.body: The older population grows year by year, and ageing is becoming an ever more pressing concern. In an old factory district beside a river, a survey finds that older people make up a large share of residents, while the site offers only ill-suited spaces, worn factories and dormitories, and little public life. A site survey and questionnaire compare the needs of older people living alone with those living with their children, from re-employment and culture to healthcare, dining and shopping. The strategy gathers these needs around anchor points chosen for accessibility and appeal. Those living alone wish to socialise and take two hundred and fifty metres as their five-minute life circle, while those living with family range less widely, at two hundred metres. Anchor points are placed to serve both kinds of community, and a slow walking path connects them all. Functions for higher needs sit within the life circle, and old factories become a teahouse, a library, a canteen and a theatre. Anchors at the hospital and kindergarten, with points for gardening, a barber, a park and a riverside path, make the district walkable.

zh-Hant.heading: 錨點社區-在老工廠裡為長者劃出五分鐘生活圈
zh-Hant.body: 高齡人口逐年增加，老化問題日益嚴峻。在河畔的一片老工廠區，調查發現長者占居民的很大比例，基地卻只有不合用的空間、老舊的廠房與宿舍，公共活力也相當低落。實地調查與問卷比較了獨居長者與和子女同住長者的需求，從再就業、文化活動，到醫療、餐飲與購物；策略將這些需求圍繞著具有可達性與吸引力的錨點加以組織。獨居長者渴望社交，以兩百五十公尺作為五分鐘的生活圈；與家人同住者活動範圍較小，以兩百公尺為限。錨點被安排在能同時服務兩種社群的位置，一條慢行步道把它們全部串連；較高層次需求的機能座落於生活圈之內，老廠房則被改造為茶館、圖書館、食堂與劇場等場所。醫院與幼兒園旁的錨點，以及園藝、長者理髮、公園與河濱步道等活力點，讓老工廠區轉化為一個可以步行的社區。長者在此休息、運動，也與彼此相遇。

pins.title: Low Carbon Urban New Area
pins.description:
A central wetland park and two ventilation corridors shape a carbon-neutral new urban area in Changsha.

Changsha, China | Low-carbon urban planning | 2020 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 低碳城市新區
zh-Hant.description:
以中央濕地公園與兩條通風廊道，塑造長沙一座碳中和的城市新區。

中國長沙｜低碳城市規劃｜2020｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The new area gathered around a central wetland park on the river.
圍繞河畔中央濕地公園展開的新區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project is located in the Changsha New Development Zone and is designed on the theory of carbon neutrality. The question is how a new urban area can grow while its own landscape helps to offset its carbon emissions.
captions: Satellite view of the site along the river.
Site analysis: elevation, slope, landscape and traffic scores combined into a land suitability evaluation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於長沙新開發區，設計以碳中和理論為基礎。核心問題是：一個新城區如何在發展的同時，讓自身的地景協助抵消碳排放。
captions: 沿河基地的衛星影像。
基地分析：高程、坡度、景觀與交通評分疊合為土地適宜性評估。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Physical geography, landscape and traffic radiation scores were overlaid to evaluate land suitability, and block density studies tested small blocks and small streets. The results guided a land use plan that balances residential, business, educational and green land.
captions: Land use planning with the share of each land type.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 團隊疊合自然地理、景觀與交通輻射評分來評估土地適宜性，並以街廓密度研究測試小街廓、密路網的配置。研究結果導出一份平衡居住、商業、教育與綠地的土地使用計畫。
captions: 土地使用規劃與各類用地比例。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A central wetland park connects the whole area, and the wetlands help to neutralise its carbon emissions. Two green ventilation corridors reduce the urban heat island effect, one passing through the wetland park and one through a new energy research university, supported by distributed energy and passive energy conservation.
captions: Planting analysis: tree and shrub ratios for each greenbelt, with trees that absorb carbon well.
Master plan with the wetland park, campuses, industrial parks and riverside facilities.
Design analysis: road network, planning structure and industry structure.
Sustainable strategy: ventilation gallery, energy distribution and passive energy conservation.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 中央濕地公園串連整個區域，濕地也協助中和區域的碳排放。兩條綠色通風廊道降低都市熱島效應，一條穿過濕地公園，一條穿過新能源研究大學，並搭配分散式能源與被動式節能設計。
captions: 植栽分析：各類綠帶的喬灌木比例，以及固碳效果佳的樹種。
總平面圖：濕地公園、校園、產業園區與河岸設施。
設計分析：路網、規劃結構與產業結構。
永續策略：通風廊道、能源分布與被動式節能。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The renderings show the central wetland park as a waterfront public landscape and the research universities set among green roofs and open fields. This was a teamwork project, and the student's contribution covered site analysis, land use planning, the master plan, design analysis drawings and renderings.
captions: Rendering of the central wetland park.
Rendering of the scientific research universities.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 渲染圖呈現中央濕地公園作為水岸公共地景，研究大學則坐落在綠屋頂與開放草地之間。這是一個團隊作業，學生負責基地分析、土地使用規劃、總平面圖、設計分析圖與渲染。
captions: 中央濕地公園渲染圖。
科學研究大學渲染圖。

sections.heading: Low Carbon Urban New Area - A Landscape That Offsets the Carbon of Its City
sections.body: The project lies in a new development zone and is designed on the theory of carbon neutrality. It asks how a new urban area might grow while its own landscape helps to offset its carbon emissions. Scores for physical geography, landscape and traffic reach are overlaid to judge the suitability of the land, and studies of block density test a pattern of small blocks and fine streets. The results guide a land use plan that balances housing, business, education and green land. A central wetland park runs through the whole area, and its wetlands help to neutralise the carbon the district produces. Two green ventilation corridors ease the urban heat island effect, one passing through the wetland park and one through a new energy research university, supported by distributed energy and passive conservation. Renderings show the wetland park as a public waterfront landscape and the research universities set among green roofs and open fields. In this teamwork project the student covered site analysis, land use planning, the master plan, analysis drawings and renderings. The growth of a city and the breathing of nature are treated as one.

zh-Hant.heading: 低碳新城-讓地景為城市抵銷碳排
zh-Hant.body: 作品位於一處新開發區，以碳中和的理論為設計依據；它追問，一片新城在成長的同時，能否讓自身的地景協助抵銷碳排放？自然地理、地景與交通輻射的評分相互疊合，用以評估土地的適宜性；街廓密度的研究則測試小街廓、密路網的模式。這些結果引導出一份土地使用計畫，在居住、商業、教育與綠地之間取得平衡。一座中央濕地公園貫穿整個區域，濕地協助中和區內的碳排放；兩條綠色通風廊道減緩都市熱島效應，一條穿過濕地公園，一條穿過一所新能源研究大學，並以分散式能源與被動式節能作為支撐。渲染圖呈現中央濕地公園作為濱水的公共地景，研究型大學則座落於綠屋頂與開闊的田野之間。這是一份團隊作品，學生負責基地分析、土地使用規劃、總平面、設計分析圖與渲染圖。城市的成長與自然的呼吸，在此被視為同一件事。

pins.title: Phuket Turtle Rescue Operation
pins.description:
A sea turtle rescue centre on Mai Khao Beach links emergency care, recovery and public education along one route.

Phuket, Thailand | Wildlife rescue centre | 2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 普吉島海龜救援行動
zh-Hant.description:
位於麥考海灘的海龜救援中心，以一條路線串連急救、復健與公眾教育。

泰國普吉島｜野生動物救援中心｜2022｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The turtle centre drawn as a single route from the sea to the shore.
海龜中心被畫成一條從海面到岸上的連續路徑。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project is set on Mai Khao Beach in Phuket, Thailand, where sea turtles come ashore in large numbers. Injured turtles need a fast route from the sea to treatment, while plastic garbage keeps threatening their life cycle.
captions: Mapping: from Thailand to Phuket and Mai Khao Beach, the turtle village, landing routes and the site.
Sea turtle analysis: the life cycle and the threats of global warming, bycatch, marine garbage and habitat destruction.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於泰國普吉島的麥考海灘，是海龜大量上岸的地方。受傷的海龜需要一條從海上快速送往治療的路線，而塑膠垃圾也持續威脅牠們的生命週期。
captions: 區位分析：從泰國到普吉島與麥考海灘，海龜村、海龜登陸路線與基地。
海龜分析：生命週期，以及全球暖化、誤捕、海洋垃圾與棲地破壞等威脅。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Studying the turtle's life and two existing conservation centres showed that design can protect hatching and reduce the swallowing of plastic garbage. The cases suggested keeping an undisturbed spawning beach, adding shading and creating more interaction between visitors and turtles.
captions: News on plastic waste, endangered turtle species and a humanistic analysis of the turtle village, release festival and beach exploitation.
Case analysis: advantages, disadvantages, learning points and improvement points.
Strategy: tourists support the rescue centre through visits, a coffee shop, recycled goods and a youth education base.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 透過研究海龜的生命歷程與兩個既有保育中心，發現設計可以保護孵化並減少海龜誤食塑膠垃圾。案例建議保留不受干擾的產卵海灘、增加遮蔭，並創造更多遊客與海龜之間的互動。
captions: 塑膠垃圾新聞、瀕危海龜種類，以及海龜村、放生節與海灘開發的人文分析。
案例分析：優點、缺點、可學習之處與改進方向。
策略：遊客透過參觀、咖啡店、回收商品與青少年教育基地支持救援中心。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The strategy works in four steps: rescue, protection, recycling and popularisation. Injured turtles are first treated at the marine emergency station, the serious cases travel along a corridor to the onshore operating room, and the plan, shaped by the hexagon of a turtle shell, connects the turtle village with an enclosed spawning beach.
captions: Strategy sketches: rescue, protection, recycling and popularisation.
Design process: connecting the turtle village, functional partition and the turtle-shell hexagon.
Master plan from the rescue wharf to the recovery pools and science exhibition.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 策略分為四個步驟：救援、保護、回收與科普。受傷的海龜先在海上急救站接受治療，重傷者沿著廊道送往岸上的手術室，而以龜殼六角形為設計元素的配置，則串連海龜村與封閉的產卵海灘。
captions: 策略草圖：救援、保護、回收與科普。
設計過程：串連海龜村、機能分區與龜殼六角形。
總平面圖：從救援碼頭到復健池與科普展覽。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The section runs from the water rescue centre through turtle surgery and recovery to a youth science base and a popular science museum. After surgery, the turtles recover in the pool before they are released back to the sea.
captions: Section through the rescue centre, surgery and recovery, science base and museum.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 剖面從海上救援中心，經過海龜手術與復健，延伸到青少年科普基地與科普博物館。手術後的海龜在水池中復原，之後再放回大海。
captions: 穿過救援中心、手術與復健區、科普基地與博物館的剖面。

sections.heading: Phuket Turtle Rescue Operation - A Journey From Sea Rescue Back to the Ocean
sections.body: The project is set on a beach where sea turtles come ashore in great numbers. Injured turtles need a quick route from the sea to treatment, while plastic waste keeps threatening their life cycle. A study of the life of the turtle and of two existing conservation centres shows that design can protect hatching and reduce the swallowing of plastic. The cases suggest keeping an undisturbed nesting beach, adding shade and creating more contact between visitors and turtles. The strategy follows four steps: rescue, protection, recycling and public education. Injured turtles are first treated at a marine emergency station, and serious cases travel along a corridor to an operating room on shore. A plan shaped by the hexagons of a turtle shell links the turtle village with an enclosed nesting beach. The section runs from the water rescue centre through surgery and recovery to a youth science base and a museum of popular science. After surgery the turtles recover in a pool before being released back into the sea. The building becomes a halfway home for turtles returning to the ocean, and it teaches people to guard a shared sea.

zh-Hant.heading: 海龜救援行動-從海上急救到重返大海的旅程
zh-Hant.body: 作品坐落於一片海龜大量上岸的海灘。受傷的海龜需要一條從海上通往治療的快速路徑，塑膠垃圾則不斷威脅牠們的生命週期。研究海龜的一生與兩座既有的保育中心後發現，設計能夠守護孵化的過程，也能減少海龜誤食塑膠垃圾；案例也指出，應保留不受打擾的產卵海灘、增加遮蔭，並創造更多訪客與海龜互動的機會。策略分為四個步驟：救援、保護、回收與科普。受傷的海龜先在海上急救站接受治療，重症者沿著廊道送往岸上的手術室；以龜殼六邊形為形的平面，把海龜村與一片封閉的產卵海灘連結起來。剖面從水上救援中心出發，經過海龜手術與康復，延伸至青少年科學基地與科普博物館。手術之後，海龜在池中休養復原，再被放回大海。一座建築，就這樣成為海龜重返海洋的中途之家，也讓人們學會守護這片共有的海。

pins.title: Riverside Urban Renewal
pins.description:
Three small public spaces on Riverside Road in Guangzhou are renewed for young people, children and the elderly.

Guangzhou, China | Urban renewal | 2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 沿江路都市更新
zh-Hant.description:
廣州沿江路上的三處小型公共空間，分別為年輕人、兒童與長者進行更新。

中國廣州｜都市更新｜2022｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The hydrophilic platform opens the riverside to children and families.
親水平台讓河岸向孩子與家庭開放。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Along Riverside Road on the Pearl River in Guangzhou, buildings are uneven, there is a gap between new and old housing, and the public space between buildings is losing its appeal. The design aims to restore the vitality of the whole block while keeping its cultural memory.
captions: Site analysis of the three riverside sites and what young people, children and the elderly wish for.
Mapping of the site between the Yuexiu and Haizhu districts, with the three chosen sites.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在廣州珠江沿岸的沿江路一帶，建築高低不一，新舊住宅之間存在落差，建築之間的公共空間也逐漸失去吸引力。設計希望在保留文化記憶的同時，恢復整個街區的活力。
captions: 三處河岸基地的分析，以及年輕人、兒童與長者的期望。
越秀區與海珠區之間的基地調查圖，標示三處選定的基地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site analysis picked three public spaces that serve three groups: a square outside the community market for young people, an underused cruise terminal for children, and a simple corner park for the elderly. Each one is given a theme: novel experience, hydrophilic space and street eye.
captions: Theory framework: Jane Jacobs, Jaime Lerner's urban acupuncture, the urban system, street eyes and pocket parks.
Strategy for the youth entertainment zone, the hydrophilic platform and the Cantonese opera stage.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地分析挑選了三處服務不同族群的公共空間：社區市場外的廣場服務年輕人，使用率低的遊船碼頭服務兒童，簡單的街角公園則服務長者。每一處各有主題：新奇體驗、親水空間與街道之眼。
captions: 理論框架：珍．雅各、賈伊梅．勒納的城市針灸、城市系統、街道之眼與口袋公園。
青年娛樂區、親水平台與粵劇舞台的策略圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: In the youth entertainment zone, the canopy of the site is extracted as a design element and deformed, arranged and combined, and the shape of the fishing boat forms a three-tier market complex with a coffee shop, staircase cinema, board games and an escape room. The wharf becomes a platform for rainwater collection and tidal play, and the corner park gains an opera stage beside the road.
captions: Master plan of the youth entertainment zone.
Rendering of the market extension under the new canopy.
Section perspective of the three-tier market complex.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在青年娛樂區，基地的雨棚被提取為設計元素，經過變形、排列與組合，再參考漁船的造型形成三層的市場綜合體，容納咖啡店、樓梯電影院、桌遊與密室逃脫。碼頭轉變為雨水收集與潮汐遊戲的平台，街角公園則在路旁增設一座戲台。
captions: 青年娛樂區總平面圖。
新雨棚下延伸市場的渲染圖。
三層市場綜合體的剖透視圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The stage beside the road draws people to stop and serves as a cultural performance space for the nearby post station, while elderly people in the teahouse can enjoy Cantonese opera as they drink tea. Together the three spaces renew Riverside Road for young people, children and the elderly.
captions: Renderings of the opera stage beside the road and the raised stage in the park.
Plan of the Cantonese opera stage and the teahouse.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 路旁的戲台吸引行人駐足，也作為鄰近文化驛站的表演空間，茶館裡的長者則能一邊喝茶一邊欣賞粵劇。三處空間共同為年輕人、兒童與長者更新沿江路。
captions: 路旁戲台與公園中抬高舞台的渲染圖。
粵劇舞台與茶館平面圖。

sections.heading: Riverside Urban Renewal - A Public Corner for Each of Three Generations
sections.body: Along this riverside road, buildings rise unevenly, a gap divides new housing from old, and the public space between blocks is losing its appeal. The design aims to restore vitality to the whole block while holding on to its cultural memory. The site analysis picks three public spaces for three groups: a square outside the community market for young people, an idle cruise pier for children and a simple corner park for older residents. Each receives a theme: novel experience, waterside play and eyes on the street. In the youth zone, the canopy of the site is drawn out as a design element, deformed, arranged and combined, while the shape of a fishing boat forms a three-tier market complex with a café, a staircase cinema, board games and an escape room. The pier becomes a platform for gathering rainwater and playing with the tide, and the corner park gains an opera stage beside the road. The stage draws passers-by to pause and serves a nearby post station, while older people in the teahouse enjoy local opera over tea. The road is renewed for every generation.

zh-Hant.heading: 濱江城市更新-為三代人各留一處公共角落
zh-Hant.body: 沿著江邊的這條道路，建築高低參差，新舊住宅之間存在落差，樓宇之間的公共空間也逐漸失去吸引力。設計希望在保留文化記憶的同時，恢復整個街區的活力。基地分析選出三處服務不同族群的公共空間：社區市場外的廣場屬於年輕人，閒置的遊船碼頭屬於孩子，簡樸的街角公園則屬於長者；每一處各被賦予一個主題：新奇體驗、親水空間與街道之眼。在青年娛樂區，基地上的遮篷被萃取為設計元素，經過變形、排列與組合，再以漁船的形態構成一座三層的市集綜合體，容納咖啡館、階梯電影院、桌遊與密室逃脫；碼頭化為收集雨水、隨潮汐嬉戲的平台，街角公園則在路旁增設一座戲台。路旁的戲台吸引行人駐足，也成為附近驛站的文化表演空間，茶館裡的長者能一邊品茶，一邊欣賞地方戲曲。三處空間一同，為青年、孩子與長者更新了這條濱江道路。

pins.title: Folding Nanshan
pins.description:
A speculative model of how Shenzhen's Nanshan District could fold apart along class lines.

Shenzhen, China | Speculative urban design | 2021–2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 摺疊南山
zh-Hant.description:
以假想模型推演深圳南山區如何沿著階層界線摺疊分離。

中國深圳｜思辨性城市設計｜2021–2022｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The dynamic physical model: servo-driven units fold the city between gated and open communities.
動態實體模型：以伺服馬達驅動的單元，讓城市在封閉社區與開放社區之間摺疊。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Shenzhen draws tens of thousands of newcomers every day, yet an invisible barrier between classes has been hardening since the city opened up and is becoming visible in urban space. Inspired by a novel about residential segregation in Beijing, the project takes Nanshan District as a hypothetical test of what the city would look like if the gap between rich and poor kept growing.
captions: The city that inspired the project, seen from above.
Demographic and activity area analysis of social classes in Nanshan.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳每天吸引數以萬計的新移民，但自城市開放以來，階層之間一道無形的屏障逐漸固化，並開始在城市空間中顯現。受一部描寫北京居住隔離的小說啟發，本案以南山區作為假想實驗，探問若貧富差距持續擴大，城市將呈現什麼樣貌。
captions: 啟發本案的城市俯瞰。
南山各社會階層的人口與活動範圍分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Land use, house prices, school admission policy for non-registered children and entrepreneurship grants were mapped across the district. The analysis shows that high-priced housing comes with the best educational resources and that talents with higher education receive more policy support, which leads to class solidification and residential segregation.
captions: Aerial photos of the site and the city.
Land-use analysis on a grid of the district.
House prices, admission policy and grant policy maps.
Conclusion: map of population density.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究將土地使用、房價、非戶籍子女入學政策與創業補助逐一對應到整個行政區。分析顯示高房價住宅伴隨最好的教育資源，高學歷人才也更容易獲得政策支持，最終導致階層固化與居住隔離。
captions: 基地與城市的航拍照片。
以網格呈現的行政區土地使用分析。
房價、入學政策與補助政策地圖。
結論：人口密度地圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The master plan is reorganised into residential, commercial, civic and public space layers, and a program analysis assigns them to the grid. A design language of folding forms is developed for each area, from civic facilities to commercial and residential zones.
captions: Master plan reorganisation by residential, public, industrial and civic land.
Program analysis of the reorganised district.
Design language for civic, commercial and residential areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 總體規劃被重組為居住、商業、公共設施與公共空間等圖層，並透過機能分析配置到網格之上。針對每一區發展出摺疊形態的設計語彙，涵蓋公共設施、商業區與住宅區。
captions: 依住宅、公共、工業與公共設施用地進行的總體規劃重組。
重組後行政區的機能分析。
公共設施、商業與住宅區的設計語彙。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A dynamic physical model links economic growth, school enrolment and start-up subsidies to servo angles, so each unit opens or closes as conditions change and is also stretched by the units around it. When the economic difference between areas is large, public space closes into gated communities, and when it is small, it opens to everyone.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 動態實體模型將經濟成長、名校入學率與創業補助連結到伺服馬達角度，讓每個單元隨條件改變而開啟或關閉，同時也受到周圍單元的拉伸與擠壓。當區域之間的經濟差距很大時，公共空間便收合為封閉社區；差距縮小時，則向所有人開放。

sections.heading: Folding Nanshan - A Dynamic Model That Reveals the Opening and Closing of Inequality
sections.body: The city draws tens of thousands of newcomers every day, yet since it opened up an invisible barrier between classes has kept hardening and is now becoming visible in urban space. Inspired by a novel about residential segregation, the project takes one district as a hypothetical test of what the city might look like if the gap between rich and poor kept widening. Land use, house prices, school admission rules for children without local registration and grants for entrepreneurs are mapped across the district. The analysis shows that costly housing comes with the best schools and that highly educated talent receives more policy support, leading to fixed classes and segregated neighbourhoods. The master plan is reorganised into residential, commercial, civic and public layers, and a programme analysis assigns them to the grid. A design language of folding forms is developed for each area. A dynamic physical model links economic growth, school enrolment and start-up subsidies to servo angles, so each unit opens or closes as conditions change. When the gap between areas is large, public space folds into gated enclaves, and when it is small, it opens to everyone.

zh-Hant.heading: 摺疊城市-以動態模型揭示貧富的開合
zh-Hant.body: 這座城市每天吸引成千上萬的新來者，然而自城市開放以來，階層之間一道看不見的屏障不斷固化，並逐漸在都市空間中顯形。作品受一部描寫居住隔離的小說啟發，以一個城區作為假設性的實驗，想像貧富差距若持續擴大，城市將變成什麼模樣。分析土地使用、房價、入學政策與創業補助後發現，高價住宅伴隨著最好的教育資源，高學歷人才也獲得更多政策支持，導致階層固化與居住隔離。總體規劃被重組為居住、商業、公民與公共空間四個圖層，再經由機能分析分配到格網之中；每一區都發展出摺疊形態的設計語彙。一個動態實體模型把經濟成長、入學人數與創業補貼連結到伺服馬達的角度，讓每個單元隨條件改變而開合，也被周圍的單元牽動。區域間的經濟差異大時，公共空間便收攏為封閉社區；差異小時，它則向所有人敞開。

pins.title: Arcades Project in the 21st Century
pins.description:
Spaces of consumption in the Liuyun community are turned back into shared public space.

Liuyun community | Consumer space and public space | 2021 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 21 世紀的拱廊街計畫
zh-Hant.description:
將 Liuyun 社區的消費空間重新轉化為共享的公共空間。

Liuyun 社區｜消費空間與公共空間｜2021｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Four outcomes: a playground, a city hall, a marketplace and outdoor stairs.
四種成果：遊戲場、市民廳、市集與戶外樓梯。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the 19th century consumer space was built to host commercial activity, but in the 21st century space itself has become a product to be consumed. In the Liuyun community the confrontation between consumer space and public space has always existed, so the project asks what the community's space should become in the future.
captions: The project's opening collage, after Benjamin's Arcades Project.
The phantasmagoria of the site and the alienation it produces: switch, fake, expansion, coverage and combine.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 19 世紀的消費空間是為了容納商業活動而建，到了 21 世紀，空間本身卻成為被消費的商品。在 Liuyun 社區，消費空間與公共空間的對立始終存在，因此本案探問社區的空間未來應發展成什麼樣子。
captions: 本案的開篇拼貼，取自班雅明的《拱廊街計畫》。
基地的幻象及其造成的異化：切換、偽裝、擴張、覆蓋與組合。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Building on the Arcades Project, the project describes the phantasmagoria of the site through words such as attractive, enforced and tease, and turns them into five operations of alienation. Shopfronts and streets in the community were then characterised through sketches of enclosure, hiding, decoration, fuzzy boundaries and no intersection.
captions: Location analysis with arcade and consumer-space references.
Street photos of the site sorted by spatial character, each with a sketch.
Site characterisation sketches of the community's streets and shopfronts.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案延續《拱廊街計畫》的思考，以吸引、強制、挑逗等字詞描述基地的幻象，並將其轉化為五種異化操作。接著以手繪草圖歸納社區店面與街道的特徵，包括圍合、隱藏、裝飾、模糊邊界與不相交。
captions: 區位分析，附拱廊街與消費空間參考。
依空間特性分類的基地街景照片，各附草圖。
社區街道與店面的基地特徵草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each operation of alienation is combined with a site characteristic to produce spaces of consumption that have been removed from consumer behaviour, such as an observation tower, a city chamber, a maze and outdoor stairs. These spaces are placed on sites around the school and along the street.
captions: Spaces of consumption removed from consumer behaviour, each a pair of operations.
Site plan of the playground near the school.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每一種異化操作都與一項基地特徵結合，產生脫離消費行為的消費空間，例如瞭望塔、市民廳、迷宮與戶外樓梯。這些空間被配置在學校周邊與街道沿線的基地上。
captions: 脫離消費行為的消費空間，每一個都由兩種操作組成。
學校旁遊戲場的基地配置圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The playground is a place of consumption or free respite at different times of the day, and the city hall hosts community events and can be hired out. The marketplace serves daily shopping and creative fairs with neighbouring businesses, while outdoor stairs let commercial tenants maintain the vertical circulation they share with residents.
captions: Site plan of the marketplace.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 遊戲場在一天不同時段可以是消費場所，也可以是免費的休憩空間；市民廳則舉辦社區活動，也可以出租使用。市集服務日常採買，並與鄰近商家合辦創意市集，戶外樓梯則讓商業租戶負責維護與居民共用的垂直動線。
captions: 市集的基地配置圖。

sections.heading: Arcades Project of the 21st Century - Drawing Consumer Space Away From Consumption
sections.body: In the nineteenth century consumer space was built to host commerce, but in the twenty-first century space itself has become a product to be consumed. In this community the standoff between consumer space and public space has always been present, so the project asks what the space of the community should become. Building on the Arcades Project, it describes the phantasmagoria of the site through words such as attractive, enforced and tease, and turns them into five operations of alienation. Shopfronts and streets are then characterised through sketches of enclosure, hiding, decoration, blurred edges and non-intersection. Each operation is paired with a quality of the site to produce spaces of consumption removed from the act of consuming, such as an observation tower, a city chamber, a maze and outdoor stairs. These are placed around the school and along the street. The playground serves at different hours as a place of consumption or of free rest, and the city hall hosts community events and can be hired. Outdoor stairs let shopkeepers and residents keep sharing their vertical routes, and space returns from commodity to everyday commons.

zh-Hant.heading: 二十一世紀拱廊計畫-讓消費空間從消費中抽離
zh-Hant.body: 十九世紀，消費空間被建造來容納商業活動；到了二十一世紀，空間本身卻成了被消費的商品。在這個社區裡，消費空間與公共空間之間的對峙始終存在，作品因此追問：社區的空間，未來應該成為什麼？作品以拱廊計畫為基礎，用誘人、強迫與挑逗等詞語描述基地的幻象，並轉化為五種異化的操作；每一種異化操作，都與一項基地特質結合，生成脫離消費行為的消費空間，例如瞭望塔、城市廳堂、迷宮與戶外樓梯，安置在學校周圍與沿街的基地上。遊樂場在一天的不同時段，時而是消費之所，時而是自由的歇息之處；城市廳堂舉辦社區活動，也可供租用；市集服務日常採買，也與鄰近商家合辦創意市集；戶外樓梯則讓商戶與居民持續共享垂直動線。空間由此從被消費的商品，回歸為共享的日常。

pins.title: Experience in Pingshan
pins.description:
A wetland park reconnects the banks of the polluted Pingshan River in Shenzhen.

Shenzhen, China | Wetland park | 2021 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 坪山體驗
zh-Hant.description:
以濕地公園重新串連深圳受污染的坪山河兩岸。

中國深圳｜濕地公園｜2021｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Aerial view of the waterfront promenade along the Pingshan River.
坪山河濱水步道鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site on the Pingshan River is cut by an urban road, its water is severely polluted by the industrial area upstream, and the dense plants along the banks make the river inaccessible for people. As Shenzhen develops, the river is expected to change from a suburban factory-side river into a major recreational green space for the surrounding city.
captions: Location, site and regional analysis with a SWOT study of the river.
Design strategy: meeting in the space, in the memories and in the Pingshan River.
Design analysis: slow traffic, theme areas, riparian zone, roads, activities and green space.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 坪山河畔的基地被一條城市道路切開，河水受到上游工業區的嚴重污染，沿岸茂密的植物也讓人無法親近河流。隨著深圳的發展，這條河預期將從郊區工廠旁的河流，轉變為服務周邊城市的重要休憩綠地。
captions: 區位、基地與區域分析，以及河道的SWOT分析。
設計策略：相遇於空間、相遇於記憶、相遇於坪山河。
設計分析：慢行系統、主題區、河岸帶、道路、活動與綠地類型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Analysis of the location, site structure and regional history traced the area's change from agriculture to industry and its links to the city's urban, ecological and coastal axes. The strategy creates a wetland park with regional characteristics, with diverse outdoor spaces, distinctive urban spots that recall the industrial context, and water purification by plants.
captions: Master plan: places to meet in space, in memory, at events and in nature.
Bank analysis: wetlands, waterfront walkway, wooden platform, green space and trestle.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究分析了區位、基地結構與區域歷史，追溯此地從農業轉向工業的過程，以及它與城市軸線、生態軸線與濱海軸線的關係。策略是打造具有地域特色的濕地公園，提供多樣的戶外空間、呼應工業脈絡的城市特色節點，並以植物淨化水質。
captions: 總平面圖：相遇於空間、記憶、活動與自然的場所。
河岸分析：濕地、濱水步道、木平台、綠地與木棧道。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The Swirl, a red gateway to the park, reconnects the three banks divided by the river and the road and gives the site a strong new urban memory. In the water purification section, different wetland plants reduce nitrogen and phosphorus in the water from the factory outflow before it reaches the river.
captions: The Swirl: entrance, installation and activities.
Water purification process from factory to rain garden, wetland island and river.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 紅色的「漩渦」是公園的門戶，重新串連被河流與道路分隔的三處河岸，也為基地留下強烈的新城市記憶。在水質淨化區，不同的濕地植物在工廠排水流入河流之前，降低水中的氮與磷。
captions: 漩渦：入口、裝置與活動。
從工廠、雨水花園、濕地島到河流的水質淨化過程。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A former mine inspires the mining park, whose red structures can be climbed, played on and rested in. Together with the Swirl and the wetlands, it turns the polluted river edge into a recreational park for the city.
captions: Mining park: about time, climbing, leisure and playground.
Aerial view of the mining park.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 以舊礦場為靈感的礦場公園，其紅色構造物可以攀爬、遊戲與休憩。它與漩渦和濕地一起，讓受污染的河岸成為城市的休憩公園。
captions: 礦場公園：時間、攀爬、休閒與遊戲場。
礦場公園鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Experience in Pingshan - Turning a Polluted Factory River Into a City Oasis
sections.body: The river on this site is cut by an urban road, its water is badly polluted by the industrial zone upstream, and dense planting along its banks keeps people away. As the city develops, the river is expected to change from a suburban stream beside factories into a major green space for recreation. Analysis of location, site structure and regional history traces the shift of the area from farming to industry and its ties to the urban, ecological and coastal axes of the city. The strategy creates a wetland park with regional character, offering varied outdoor spaces, distinctive landmarks that recall the industrial past and water cleaned by plants. The Swirl, a red gateway to the park, reconnects three banks split by the river and the road and gives the site a vivid new urban memory. In the purification area, different wetland plants reduce nitrogen and phosphorus in factory outflow before it reaches the river. A former mine inspires a mining park whose red structures invite climbing, play and rest. Together with the Swirl and the wetlands, it turns a polluted riverbank into a park for the whole city.

zh-Hant.heading: 河畔體驗-讓工廠旁的污染河岸成為城市綠洲
zh-Hant.body: 基地所在的河流被一條城市道路切斷，上游工業區的排放嚴重污染了河水，岸邊茂密的植物也讓人無法親近。隨著城市發展，這條河被期待從郊區工廠旁的河流，轉變為周邊城市重要的休閒綠地。對區位、基地結構與地區歷史的分析，追溯了這一帶從農業走向工業的轉變，以及它與城市都會、生態與濱海軸線的關聯。策略是打造一座具地域特色的濕地公園，擁有多樣的戶外空間、喚起工業脈絡的獨特城市地標，並以植物淨化水質。名為漩渦的紅色門戶，重新連接被河流與道路分隔的三處河岸，也為基地留下一段鮮明的新城市記憶；在水質淨化區，不同的濕地植物在工廠排水流入河道之前，降低水中的氮與磷。以昔日礦場為靈感的礦場公園，紅色構造可供攀爬、遊戲與休憩。漩渦與濕地一同，把受污染的河岸轉化為屬於城市的休閒公園。

pins.title: Campus Boundary
pins.description:
A closed school boundary in Shenzhen is expanded from a wall into a surface shared with the city.

Shenzhen, China | Graduation project | 2022 | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 校園邊界
zh-Hant.description:
將深圳一所封閉學校的邊界，從一道牆擴展為與城市共享的面。

中國深圳｜畢業設計｜2022｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Exploded view: the slender campus boundary expanded into a surface of inside and outside.
爆炸圖：細長的校園邊界被擴展為一個由內與外構成的面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Not only at the worst period of the epidemic but even two years after the outbreak, the school in Nanshan District is still closed, which has caused discontent among students, nearby businesses and residents. A wall separates the school from the outside, and a road that used to connect to the industrial park has been closed.
captions: Sketch map of the current boundaries around the campus.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 不只在疫情最嚴重的時期，甚至在疫情爆發兩年後的今天，南山區的這所學校仍然封閉，引起學生、周邊商家與居民的不滿。一道圍牆將學校與外界隔開，原本通往產業園區的道路也已封閉。
captions: 校園周邊現有邊界的手繪分析圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A literature review traced how architecture moved from modernism's mechanical dualism, in which one is either one or the other, towards metabolism and symbiosis, in which the added part is connected to the existing facilities. A study of space patterns turns a fixed grid into loose, overlapping units.
captions: Overlap and programme-as-edge strategies with site photos and a reference project.
Space pattern: from a fixed grid to overlapping units.
Extension: the crowded entrances and exits on the border are expanded from points into lines to reduce congestion.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 文獻回顧追溯建築如何從現代主義非此即彼的機械二元論，走向代謝與共生的思考，讓新增部分與既有設施相連。對空間模式的研究，則把固定的網格轉化為鬆散而重疊的單元。
captions: 重疊與以機能為邊界的策略，附基地照片與參考案例。
空間模式：從固定網格到重疊的單元。
延伸：把邊界上擁擠的出入口從點擴展為線，以減少壅塞。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each part of the boundary is redesigned as a type of edge that sets a new relationship between inside and outside. Extension, gym, courtyard, corridors, sight, interaction, route, transport hub and park each become an edge, compared before and after.
captions: Extension, gym and courtyard as edge.
Corridors, sight and interaction as edge.
Route, transport hub and park as edge.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 邊界的每一段都被重新設計為一種邊緣，建立內與外之間的新關係。延伸、體育館、庭院、廊道、視線、互動、路徑、交通樞紐與公園各自成為一種邊緣，並比較設計前後的差異。
captions: 以延伸、體育館與庭院作為邊緣。
以廊道、視線與互動作為邊緣。
以路徑、交通樞紐與公園作為邊緣。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The design allows the original slender boundary to be expanded into a surface, making it convenient for the students and teachers within the school. At the same time it brings vitality to the surrounding area.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 設計讓原本細長的邊界擴展為一個面，為校內師生帶來便利。同時，它也為周邊地區注入活力。

sections.heading: Campus Boundary - Unfolding a Thin Wall Into a Shared Interface
sections.body: Even two years after the worst of the epidemic, this school remains closed, stirring discontent among students, nearby businesses and residents. A wall cuts the school off from the outside, and a road that once led to an industrial park has been shut.
