sections.body: A months-long field study logs the tides and records where each bird group feeds as the water rises and falls. It also finds abandoned bamboo floats and small islands that appear at low tide, which become the raw material of the design.
captions: Bird sightings across the bay.
Tide levels over one week.
Where birds feed at each stage of the tide.
Shoreline section by bird group.
Bamboo floats and low-tide islands found on site.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 為期數月的田野調查記錄潮汐，並觀察各類鳥群在漲退潮之間於何處覓食。調查也發現了廢棄的竹筏與低潮時才浮現的小島，成為設計的素材。
captions: 灣區內的鳥類觀察紀錄。
一週的潮位變化。
各潮汐階段鳥類的覓食位置。
依鳥類族群整理的海岸剖面。
在基地發現的竹筏與低潮小島。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The bamboo rafts are reinforced, anchored to the seabed and fitted with planting boxes for reeds and other aquatic plants. Oysters living inside the bamboo help filter the water and add habitat for fish.
captions: Habitat, research and submerged islands.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 竹筏經過補強並錨定於海床，再加上栽種蘆葦等水生植物的種植箱。棲息在竹管內的牡蠣協助淨化水質，也為魚類增加棲地。
captions: 棲地島、研究島與淹沒島的配置。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The rafts extend the low-tide islands and become new islands when the water covers them, moving food and shelter away from the shore. A tide model tests how many rafts are needed to keep the habitat area steady between high and low water.
captions: The model seen from above.
High and low tide in the model.
Details of the planted rafts.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 竹筏延伸了低潮小島，並在海水淹沒時自成島嶼，將食物與庇護所移離岸邊。潮汐模型則測試需要多少竹筏，才能讓棲地面積在漲退潮之間維持穩定。
captions: 從上方俯瞰模型。
模型中的高潮與低潮。
種植竹筏的細部。

sections.heading: Floating Eco-Islands - Moving Feeding Grounds Away from a Busy Shore
sections.body: In a tidal estuary, resident and migratory waterbirds feed close to busy promenades and seawalls, and human disturbance near the shore is pushing them away from the places they rely on. A months-long field study logged the tides and recorded where each bird group feeds as the water rises and falls, and it also found abandoned bamboo floats and small islands that surface at low tide, which became the raw material of the design. The bamboo rafts were reinforced, anchored to the seabed and fitted with planting boxes for reeds and other aquatic plants. Oysters living inside the bamboo help filter the water and add habitat for fish. In the final scheme, the rafts extend the low-tide islands and become islands themselves when the water covers them, carrying food and shelter away from the shore, while a tide model tests how many rafts keep the habitat area steady. What was discarded becomes a new shore for the birds.

zh-Hant.heading: 漂浮生態島-把覓食地移離喧囂岸邊
zh-Hant.body: 一處潮汐河口，留鳥與候鳥在熱鬧的步道與海堤旁覓食，岸邊的人為干擾正把鳥類推離牠們依賴的棲地。為期數月的田野調查記錄潮汐，觀察各類鳥群在漲退潮之間於何處覓食，並發現廢棄的竹筏與低潮時才浮現的小島，成為設計的素材。竹筏經過補強並錨定於海床，再加上栽種蘆葦等水生植物的種植箱，棲息於竹管內的牡蠣則協助淨化水質，也為魚類增加棲地。最終，竹筏延伸了低潮小島，並在海水淹沒時自成島嶼，將食物與庇護所移離岸邊；潮汐模型測試需要多少竹筏，才能讓棲地面積在漲退潮之間保持穩定。被遺棄之物就此成為鳥群的新岸。

pins.title: Bio-based Material
pins.description:
Interlocking hempcrete blocks for a dry-stacked ceiling built without mortar.

New York | Material research | Hempcrete ceiling | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 生物基材料
zh-Hant.description:
以互鎖式麻石灰磚打造、無需砂漿的乾式堆疊天花板。

紐約｜材料研究｜麻石灰天花板｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Interlocking hempcrete blocks held by timber members.
以木構件固定的互鎖式麻石灰磚。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Ceilings are usually built with mortar, adhesives and energy-heavy materials that are hard to take apart. The project asks whether a bio-based block could form a ceiling by stacking alone.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 天花板通常以砂漿、黏著劑與高耗能材料建造，難以拆解。這個專案提問：生物基材料製成的磚塊，能否僅靠堆疊就構成天花板。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Hemp hurds are mixed with a lime binder, pressed into moulds and tamped by hand. Workshops compare several binders and mould versions to learn how timing, moisture and compaction change the result.
captions: Photos of casting the hempcrete blocks.
Mixing and casting steps.
Single mould and stacked moulds for the mock-up.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 將大麻稈芯與石灰黏結劑混合，壓入模具並以手工夯實。工作坊比較多種黏結劑與模具版本，了解時間、濕度與壓實程度如何影響成果。
captions: 澆鑄大麻混凝土磚的過程照片。
混合與澆鑄步驟。
單一模具與用於實體模型的組合模具。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Stepped and notched blocks lock into each other, so the ceiling can be dry-stacked without mortar. Timber supports run through the blocks to carry lateral forces and tie the system to the facade.
captions: Section of the stacked ceiling.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 階梯狀並帶有凹槽的磚塊彼此咬合，讓天花板無需砂漿即可乾式堆疊。木支撐穿過磚塊承受側向力，並將系統與立面相連。
captions: 堆疊式天花板的剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A full mock-up tests how the blocks interlock, hold their shape and work with the timber frame. The study points toward low-carbon ceilings that can be assembled, taken apart and reused.
captions: Ceiling mock-up with timber supports.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完整的實體模型測試磚塊的咬合、形狀穩定度，以及與木構架的配合。這項研究指向可組裝、可拆解並能再利用的低碳天花板。
captions: 附木支撐的天花板實體模型。

sections.heading: Bio-based Material - A Low-Carbon Ceiling Built by Stacking Alone
sections.body: Ceilings are usually built with mortar, adhesives and energy-heavy materials that are hard to take apart, and the project asks whether a bio-based block could form a ceiling by stacking alone. Hemp hurds were mixed with a lime binder, pressed into moulds and tamped by hand, while workshops compared several binders and mould versions to learn how timing, moisture and compaction change the result. Stepped and notched blocks lock into one another, so the ceiling can be dry-stacked without mortar. Timber supports run through the blocks to carry lateral forces and tie the system to the facade. A full mock-up finally tested how the blocks interlock, hold their shape and work with the timber frame. The study points toward low-carbon ceilings that can be assembled, taken apart and reused, and the humility of a plant-based material becomes, in the end, a quiet intelligence of construction.

zh-Hant.heading: 生物基材料-只靠堆疊的低碳天花板
zh-Hant.body: 天花板通常以砂漿、黏著劑與高耗能材料建造，難以拆解；作品追問，生物基材料製成的磚塊，能否僅靠堆疊就構成天花板。大麻稈芯與石灰黏結劑混合後，被壓入模具並以手工夯實，工作坊比較多種黏結劑與模具版本，了解時間、濕度與壓實程度如何影響成果。階梯狀並帶有凹槽的磚塊彼此咬合，讓天花板無需砂漿即可乾式堆疊，木支撐穿過磚塊承受側向力，並將系統與立面相連。最終，一座完整的實體模型測試磚塊的咬合、形狀穩定度，以及與木構架的配合。研究指向可組裝、可拆解並能再利用的天花板，材料的謙遜由此成為建造的智慧。

pins.title: Sediment, Tide, and Habitat
pins.description:
A coastal landscape that uses sediment and tide to restore wetland habitat on a delta edge.

Guangzhou | Coastal landscape | Habitat restoration | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 沉積、潮汐與棲地
zh-Hant.description:
以沉積與潮汐修復三角洲邊緣濕地棲地的海岸地景。

廣州｜海岸地景｜棲地修復｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: A coastal park where people and wetland habitat share the edge.
人與濕地棲地共享水岸的海岸公園。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The low-lying delta coast faces rising seas, storm surges and shrinking habitat for birds and fish. Hard embankments hold back water but cut the land off from the tide.
captions: Flood risk and bird distribution across the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 低窪的三角洲海岸面臨海平面上升、風暴潮，以及鳥類與魚類棲地縮減。堅硬的堤岸雖能擋水，卻讓土地與潮汐斷開。
captions: 基地的淹水風險與鳥類分布。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The study maps flooding, bird species and how the coast reacts when surges overtop the embankment. These scenarios show where wetland can absorb water instead of resisting it.
captions: Storm surge scenarios along the river embankment.
Section through freshwater and brackish wetland.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究繪製淹水、鳥類物種，以及風暴潮越過堤岸時海岸的反應。這些情境指出濕地可以吸納而非抵擋海水的位置。
captions: 沿河堤岸的風暴潮情境。
淡水與半鹹水濕地剖面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sediment, tide and planting are treated as tools that slowly reshape the coastline. Woodland, shrub, wetland and creek habitats are arranged as a pattern that keeps evolving.
captions: Changing coastal landscape and habitat tendencies.
A constantly evolving pattern of habitats.
Plant and animal species for each habitat.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 沉積、潮汐與植栽被視為慢慢重塑海岸線的工具。林地、灌叢、濕地與潮溝棲地被編排成一套持續演化的格局。
captions: 變動中的海岸地景與棲地趨勢。
持續演化的棲地格局。
各棲地對應的動植物物種。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The landscape is drawn across several future stages as land and water trade places. Paths and platforms let visitors walk through the wetland without disturbing the birds.
captions: The landscape across future stages.
Renderings of the restored habitats.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 地景在多個未來階段中被描繪，呈現陸地與水域的消長。步道與平台讓訪客穿越濕地，又不打擾鳥類。
captions: 地景在未來各階段的樣貌。
修復後棲地的透視圖。

sections.heading: Sediment, Tide and Habitat - A Coast That Absorbs Rather Than Resists
sections.body: A low-lying delta coast faces rising seas, storm surges and shrinking habitat for birds and fish, and its hard embankments, though they hold back water, cut the land off from the tide. The study mapped flooding, bird species and the coast's response when surges overtop the embankment, and these scenarios revealed where wetland could absorb water instead of resisting it. Sediment, tide and planting were then treated as tools that slowly reshape the coastline. Woodland, shrub, wetland and creek habitats are arranged as a pattern that keeps evolving. Drawn across several future stages, the landscape shows land and water trading places, while paths and platforms let visitors walk through the wetland without disturbing the birds. Letting go of the urge to control, the design writes the coast together with the rhythms of nature, accepting change as the very material from which a resilient shore is made.

zh-Hant.heading: 沉積潮汐與棲地-讓海岸吸納而非抵擋
zh-Hant.body: 低窪的三角洲海岸，面臨海平面上升、風暴潮，以及鳥類與魚類棲地的縮減；堅硬的堤岸雖能擋水，卻讓土地與潮汐斷開。研究繪製淹水、鳥類物種，以及風暴潮越過堤岸時海岸的反應，這些情境指出濕地可以吸納而非抵擋海水的位置。沉積、潮汐與植栽接著被視為慢慢重塑海岸線的工具，林地、灌叢、濕地與潮溝棲地被編排成一套持續演化的格局。最終，地景在多個未來階段中被描繪，呈現陸地與水域的消長，步道與平台讓訪客穿越濕地，又不打擾鳥類。設計放下控制的執念，與自然的節律一同書寫海岸。

pins.title: Sawtooth Horizons
pins.description:
A cultural centre under a folded sawtooth roof that filters daylight into four programs.

Tartu | Cultural centre | Folded roof | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 鋸齒地平線
zh-Hant.description:
在折板鋸齒屋頂下過濾日光、容納四種機能的文化中心。

塔爾圖｜文化中心｜折板屋頂｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Model of the folded sawtooth roof.
折板鋸齒屋頂模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A library, art museum, restaurant and theatre must share one building without losing their own character. The project looks for a single roof that can hold these programs together.
captions: Generating the folded roof.
The building taken apart into roof, auditorium, structure, ramp and base.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 圖書館、美術館、餐廳與劇場必須共用一棟建築，又不失各自的性格。這個專案尋找一片能把這些機能整合起來的屋頂。
captions: 折板屋頂的生成。
拆解為屋頂、觀眾席、結構、坡道與基座的建築系統。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Concept models test a looping ramp threaded under a folded surface. The ground below breaks into fragments that become separate rooms and courtyards.
captions: Concept collage and study models.
Fragmented ground and plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 概念模型測試一條穿行於折板之下的迴圈坡道。下方的地面被打散成片段，形成各自獨立的房間與庭院。
captions: 概念拼貼與研究模型。
破碎化的地面與平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The sawtooth folds turn away from direct sun and let soft light fall into the halls below. Roof, supports and base are detailed as three layers that work together.
captions: Sections showing the roof as a daylight filter.
Details of roof, support and base structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 鋸齒折板避開直射陽光，讓柔和的光線灑入下方空間。屋頂、支撐與基座被細化為三個彼此配合的層次。
captions: 呈現屋頂作為採光濾網的剖面。
屋頂、支撐與基座結構細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The roof steps down toward the river and links the building with the landscape. Ramps lead visitors from the ground up across the folds.
captions: Interior view under the folded roof.
Aerial view toward the river.
Views of the final model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 屋頂朝河岸逐級下降，將建築與地景相連。坡道引導訪客從地面一路走上折板。
captions: 摺板屋頂下的室內透視。
朝向河岸的鳥瞰。
最終模型視角。

sections.heading: Sawtooth Horizons - One Roof Gathering Four Programmes
sections.body: A library, an art museum, a restaurant and a theatre must share one building without losing their own character, so the project searches for a single roof able to hold these programmes together. Concept models tested a looping ramp threaded beneath a folded surface, while the ground below broke into fragments that became separate rooms and courtyards. The sawtooth folds turn away from direct sun, letting soft light fall into the halls below. Roof, supports and base were detailed as three layers working in concert. In the final design, the roof steps down toward the river and binds the building to the landscape, and ramps lead visitors from the ground up across the folds. Unity and difference find their balance here, as one undulating horizon lets many cultural activities share the same sky, each room keeping its own voice beneath a common, rhythmic canopy of light.

zh-Hant.heading: 鋸齒地平線-一片屋頂收攏四種機能
zh-Hant.body: 圖書館、美術館、餐廳與劇場必須共用一棟建築，又不失各自的性格；作品因此尋找一片能把這些機能整合起來的屋頂。概念模型測試一條穿行於折板之下的迴圈坡道，下方地面被打散成片段，形成各自獨立的房間與庭院。鋸齒折板避開直射陽光，讓柔和的光線灑入下方空間，屋頂、支撐與基座則被細化為三個彼此配合的層次。最終，屋頂朝河岸逐級下降，將建築與地景相連，坡道引導訪客從地面一路走上折板。統一與差異在此取得平衡，一道起伏的地平線，讓不同的文化活動共享同一片天空。

pins.title: Under the Hood
pins.description:
A plug-in city that grows over a coastal gas station inside a leaning truss frame.

Los Angeles | Plug-in city | Mixed use | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 引擎蓋之下
zh-Hant.description:
在傾斜桁架中、於海岸加油站上方生長的插入式城市。

洛杉磯｜插入式城市｜混合使用｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: The plug-in structure seen up close.
近看插入式結構。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A gas station at a busy coastal crossroads sits between the highway, the hills and the beach. The project asks how a small site could grow into a mixed housing and commercial city.
captions: A material study that makes time visible.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座加油站位於繁忙的海岸路口，夾在公路、山丘與海灘之間。這個專案提問：一塊小基地如何長成混合住宅與商業的城市。
captions: 讓時間變得可見的材料研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A material study records how a soft block changes shape over time. This idea of slow change becomes the rule for how the building is added to and rearranged.
captions: Time slices inserted into a fixed truss frame.
Exploded section of the stacked programs.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究

sections.heading: Under the Hood - A Coastal Tower Forever Being Rewritten
sections.body: A gas station at a busy coastal crossroads sits wedged between highway, hills and beach, and the project asks how such a small site might grow into a mixed city of housing and commerce. A material study recorded how a soft block changes shape over time, and this idea of slow change became the rule for how the building is added to and rearranged. A fixed truss frame receives new volumes in successive slices that are lifted, rotated and shifted. Its structure stays continuous even as the uses inside keep changing. In the final proposal, the tower leans toward the ocean and drops a network of floors over the old station, reading less like a finished object than like an architecture always in the middle of being rewritten. Urban growth is thus understood as an ongoing process rather than an endpoint, a structure that welcomes revision as naturally as the tide returns.

A continuous linear volume was tested in many versions that sink, lift, attach or tilt, each move releasing the ground below for movement and gathering. sections.heading: Carmen, Rewritten - A Stage Machine That Performs Fate
sections.body: A classic opera usually plays out in front of a fixed painted backdrop, and the project asks how the stage itself might act out the story of love, freedom and fate. The narrative is reset in a warehouse-like factory where every person is assigned a role, and each act is tied to a card of fate and a matching costume for the main characters. A rotating machine of trusses, glass vessels and gears becomes the set for the third act. As it turns and locks, it reveals a system slowly closing around the heroine. In the last act, the machine breaks apart into large flowing curtains that drift across the stage, and the fabric turns the closing scene into a moment of release rather than control. The contrast of rigid and soft carries the narrative here, so that space is no longer mere background but an actor standing beside the voice, breathing with the music.

zh-Hant.heading: 重寫卡門-會演出命運的舞台機械
zh-Hant.body: 經典歌劇通常在固定的彩繪布景前演出，作品則追問，舞台本身能否演出愛、自由與命運的故事。故事被移到一座如倉庫般的工廠，每個人都被分派一個角色，每一幕對應一張命運之牌，以及主要角色相應的服裝。由桁架、玻璃容器與齒輪組成的旋轉機械，成為第三幕的布景；它轉動並鎖定時，呈現一個逐漸包圍女主角的體系。到了最後一幕，機械化為大片流動的布幔飄過舞台，布料讓終場成為釋放的一刻，而非控制。剛硬與柔軟的對比在此承擔敘事，空間不再只是背景，而是與歌聲並肩的演員。

sections.body: A former tin mine on a rugged coast has lost its industry and much of its local work, and the project asks how a new lithium lab could bring production back while respecting the mining heritage. Underground tunnels and hot brine make the site suitable for geothermal lithium extraction, and the study mapped how energy, water and material can move from the ground into the plant. sections.heading: Bloom Street Power Station Renewal - A Chimney Visitors Can Climb
sections.body: A disused brick power station stands empty in a dense city block, and the project asks how its chimney and walls might carry a new public life without losing their industrial character. The study recorded the roof, columns, facade walls and basement worth keeping, and mapped the routes and open spaces that could draw people into the block. An auditorium is hung inside the old shell, while a stair climbs the chimney to a viewing point. A light steel frame supports the new floors without loading the historic walls. Reopening as a cultural venue, the station gathers a public hall, a bar and an auditorium beneath a new sawtooth roof, and the chimney becomes a landmark that visitors can now ascend. A building that once generated electricity now generates a different kind of current, the public energy of a city meeting itself inside walls that remember their working past.

zh-Hant.heading: 布魯姆街發電站更新-可以攀登的煙囪

sections.heading: Research

captions: Design iteration along the curve of the river.
Elevations of the long greenhouse.

zh-Hant.body: 研究追溯河流與城鎮如何隨時間一起成長。同時測試一套長期植栽計畫，讓河岸逐步回復為綠色緩衝帶。

sections.body: The roof collects rain, lets in winter sun and guides air through the greenhouse. Visitors walk a promenade beside the labs while the planting gradually restores the riverbank.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 屋頂收集雨水、引入冬季陽光，並引導空氣穿過溫室。訪客沿著實驗室旁的步道行走，植栽則逐步修復河岸。

呈現斜屋頂與氣候流動的剖面。

sections.heading: Riverside Greenhouse - A Laboratory That Heals a Wounded Bank
sections.body: A polluted stretch of riverside beside an old mill site has lost its green edge, and the project asks how a small laboratory might help restore nature while opening the bank to the public. The study traced how river and town grew together over time, and tested a long-term planting plan that would slowly turn the bank back into a green buffer. Timber frames and long beams carry a sloped roof over a curved plan that follows the water. A surviving brick wall from the old factory is kept as part of the new structure. In the finished design, the roof collects rain, admits winter sun and guides air through the greenhouse, while visitors walk a promenade beside the labs as the planting gradually heals the riverbank. Traces of the past and the green of the future coexist here, and restoration becomes a slow, tender form of companionship between people, water and soil.

zh-Hant.heading: 河岸溫室-讓實驗室修復受傷的水岸
zh-Hant.body: 一段緊鄰舊磨坊遺址的河岸受到污染，失去了綠色的邊緣；作品追問，一座小型實驗室能否協助恢復自然，同時把河岸開放給公眾。研究追溯河流與城鎮如何隨時間一起成長，並測試一套長期植栽計畫，讓河岸逐步回復為綠色緩衝帶。木構架與長樑支撐斜屋頂，覆蓋一個順著水岸彎曲的平面，舊工廠留下的磚牆也被保留，成為新結構的一部分。最終，屋頂收集雨水、引入冬季陽光，並引導空氣穿過溫室；訪客沿實驗室旁的步道行走，植栽則逐步修復河岸。過去的痕跡與未來的綠意在此並存，修復成為一種緩慢而溫柔的陪伴。

zh-Hant.body: 這座文化中心位於一座公共空間分散的河岸城市。專案追問一棟建築如何把這些空間串聯成一片連續的地景。

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 地圖分析呈現人們如何在河岸、公園與舊城之間移動。接著以形態研究測試多種摺疊形體，再從中選出一個方案。

zh-Hant.body: 量體被拆解為軟性地景、彈性空間與彼此交織的路徑。實體模型用來檢驗銳利的摺面如何落到地面。

sections.heading: Folded Cultural Centre in Tartu - Gathering Scattered Spaces into One Landscape
sections.body: A cultural centre is proposed for a riverside city with many scattered public spaces, and the project asks how a single building might gather them into one connected landscape. Mapping showed how people move between the river, the parks and the old centre, after which a morphological study tested many folded forms before one was chosen. The massing was split into soft landscape, flexible spaces and routes that weave through one another. Physical models checked how the sharp folds meet the ground. In the final plan and section, halls sit within a continuous folded shell, and light falling through its gaps gives the interiors a calm, cave-like feeling. The fragments of a city are gathered here beneath a roof that behaves like folded paper, and public life is reconnected within the gentle play of light and shadow, as though the ground itself had been lifted to make room.

zh-Hant.heading: 塔爾圖摺疊文化中心-把分散的公共空間摺成一片地景
zh-Hant.body: 這座文化中心位於一座公共空間分散的河岸城市，作品追問，一棟建築能否把這些空間串聯成一片連續的地景。地圖分析呈現人們如何在河岸、公園與舊城之間移動，形態研究接著測試多種摺疊形體，再從中選出一個方案。量體被拆解為軟性地景、彈性空間與彼此交織的路徑，實體模型則用來檢驗銳利的摺面如何落到地面。最終，平面與剖面呈現大廳被包覆於連續的摺疊外殼之中，光線從縫隙灑入，讓室內帶著安靜如洞穴般的氛圍。城市的碎片由此被一張摺紙般的屋頂收攏，公共生活在光與影之間重新相連。

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 平面保留舊廠房的環狀配置，並在中央置入工坊、工作室與倉儲。模組化的倉儲塔用來存放材料，並能依不同用途重新組合。

sections.heading: Levanella Post-Factory - Opening a Closed Factory to Repair and Reuse
sections.body: An existing distribution factory is transformed into a post-production landscape for upcycling clothes, and the project asks how a closed industrial box might open up so that making, repair and reuse can be seen. Layered site studies mapped the routes, the green edges and the long factory blocks, before a form sequence cut, lifted and folded the roof to create new open spaces. The plan keeps the old factory ring while inserting workshops, studios and storage at its centre. Modular storage towers hold materials and can be reconfigured for different uses. In the final design, timber truss frames carry the new roofs and can themselves be taken apart and rebuilt, while a long section shows making, display and storage linked along one continuous route. The building thus practises the very ethic it houses, repaired and recombined alongside the garments it helps to renew.

zh-Hant.heading: 萊瓦內拉後工廠-讓封閉廠房展示修補與再生
zh-Hant.body: 一座既有的物流工廠，被轉化為回收再造衣物的後生產地景；作品追問，一個封閉的工業盒子如何打開，讓製作、修補與再利用被看見。分層的基地研究標示出路徑、綠色邊界與長條形的廠房量體，形體推演接著把屋頂切開、抬升與摺疊，創造新的開放空間。平面保留舊廠房的環狀配置，並在中央置入工坊、工作室與倉儲，模組化的倉儲塔存放材料，可依不同用途重新組合。最終，木桁架支撐新的屋頂，並可拆解後再重新組裝；長剖面呈現製作、展示與倉儲沿一條連續路徑串連。建築本身也實踐著再生的理念，與衣物一同被修補、重組。

zh-Hant.title: 紅線棲居：火星前哨
zh-Hant.description:
為火星構想的模組化棲居地與觀測前哨。

火星｜推想設計｜行星前哨｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

sections.body: This speculative proposal imagines an observation outpost and habitat on Mars. It asks how people could build and live in a place with thin air, dust and extreme cold.
captions: Line drawing of the habitat structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個推想式提案想像一座位於火星的觀測前哨與棲居地。專案追問在空氣稀薄、沙塵與極寒的環境中，人類如何建造並生活。

Modules for the orbital platform.

zh-Hant.body: 模擬畫面呈現纜索機器人一步步組裝平台。三張畫面比較平台在組裝過程中不同時刻的狀態。
captions: 機器人組裝的模擬畫面。

sections.heading: Red Line Habitat - An Outpost Assembled Step by Step on Mars
sections.body: This speculative proposal imagines an observation outpost and habitat on Mars, asking how people might build and live in a place of thin air, dust and extreme cold. The habitat is broken into modules, some in orbit and some on the ground, each with a clear task such as docking, farming, storage or living. A flow diagram then links the modules into one assembly sequence running from orbit to the surface. Arrows mark how each module connects to the next. Simulation stills in the final work show cable robots putting the platform together step by step, and three frames compare the platform at different moments of the build. A distant planet is drawn closer here, turned into a sequence of operations that can be reasoned through, so that imagination and rigorous logic advance side by side across a landscape no one has yet set foot upon.

zh-Hant.heading: 紅線棲居-在火星上一步步組裝的前哨
zh-Hant.body: 這個推想式提案，想像一座位於火星的觀測前哨與棲居地，追問人類如何在空氣稀薄、沙塵瀰漫與極寒的環境中建造並生活。棲居地被拆解為多個模組，部分在軌道上，部分在地表，每個模組都擔負明確的任務，例如對接、種植、倉儲或居住。一張流程圖隨後把各模組串成一條從軌道到地表的組裝順序，箭頭標示每個模組如何接續下一個。最終，模擬畫面呈現纜索機器人一步步組裝平台，三張畫面比較平台在組裝過程中不同時刻的狀態。遙遠的星球由此被拉近為可以推演的工序，想像力與嚴謹的邏輯並肩前行。

pins.title: Post-Arctic Waterfront

zh-Hant.title: 後北極水岸
zh-Hant.description:
在北極海岸過濾水質、營造棲地的分期公共濕地。

captions: Map of the coastal waterfront with tide and flow charts.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: An Arctic harbour town faces melting ground, rising water and growing tourism along its shore. The project turns the waterfront into a phased public wetland that filters water and makes new habitat.
captions: Drawing of the Arctic context.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座北極港灣小鎮正面對凍土融化、水位上升與沿岸觀光增加的壓力。專案把水岸轉化為分期發展的公共濕地，用來過濾水質並營造新的棲地。
captions: 北極區域脈絡圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sediment tests study how mud and gravel settle in water over time. Three sea-level scenarios show how the shore could change in the coming decades.
captions: Sediment settling tests.
Sea-level scenarios for the shore.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 沉積實驗研究泥沙與碎石如何隨時間在水中沉降。三個海平面情境呈現海岸在未來數十年可能出現的變化。
captions: 泥沙沉降實驗。
海岸的海平面變化情境。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Landscape blocks test outflow, sedimentation, filtration and water storage in several stages. Each stage lets the planting grow a little further into the bay.
captions: Landscape process phases.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 地景模塊分階段測試出流、沉積、過濾與儲水。每一個階段都讓植栽再往海灣多延伸一些。
captions: 地景過程的分期。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A system diagram links filtering, habitat and visitor routes into one public landscape. Birds, plants and people share a soft shoreline instead of a hard edge.
captions: The boardwalk across the wetland.
Perspectives from the boardwalk in summer and winter.
Perspectives from the visitor zone on the former coal storage area.
System diagram of the wetland.
Species and the shoreline profile.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 系統圖把過濾、棲地與遊客路線串連成一片公共地景。鳥類、植物與人共享一條柔性的海岸線，而不是堅硬的邊界。
captions: 穿越濕地的木棧道。
夏季與冬季的木棧道透視。
位於原煤炭堆置區的遊客區透視。
濕地的系統圖。
物種與海岸線剖面。

sections.heading: Post-Arctic Waterfront - Softening the Shore with a Phased Wetland
sections.body: An Arctic harbour town faces melting ground, rising water and growing tourism along its shore, and the project turns the waterfront into a phased public wetland that filters water and creates new habitat. Sediment tests studied how mud and gravel settle in water over time, while three sea-level scenarios showed how the shore might change in the coming decades. Landscape blocks then tested outflow, sedimentation, filtration and water storage in several stages. With each stage, the planting reaches a little further into the bay. A system diagram in the final work links filtering, habitat and visitor routes into one public landscape, where birds, plants and people share a soft shoreline instead of a hard edge. Faced with a changing climate, the design chooses patience as its response, letting time and sediment build the shore together, layer by quiet layer, rather than resisting the water with walls.

zh-Hant.heading: 後北極水岸-以分期濕地柔化海岸
zh-Hant.body: 一座北極港灣小鎮，正面對凍土融化、水位上升與沿岸觀光增加的壓力；作品把水岸轉化為分期發展的公共濕地，用以過濾水質並營造新的棲地。沉積實驗研究泥沙與碎石如何隨時間在水中沉降，三個海平面情境則呈現海岸在未來數十年可能出現的變化。地景模塊接著分階段測試出流、沉積、過濾與儲水，每一個階段都讓植栽再往海灣延伸一些。最終，一張系統圖把過濾、棲地與遊客路線串連為一片公共地景，鳥類、植物與人共享一條柔性的海岸線，而不是堅硬的邊界。面對氣候變遷，設計選擇以耐心回應，讓時間與泥沙一同築岸。

pins.title: Urban Vertical Farm
pins.description:
A disused dockside flour mill reborn as a vertical farm open to the public.

London, UK | Architecture | Vertical farm | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 都市垂直農場
zh-Hant.description:
把碼頭旁的廢棄麵粉廠改造為向大眾開放的垂直農場。

英國倫敦｜建築｜垂直農場｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Exploded axonometric of the farm, leisure and market spaces.
農場、休閒與市集空間的爆炸軸測圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A large disused flour mill stands empty beside the old docks of east London. The project turns it into an urban vertical farm that grows fresh food and opens the building to the public.
captions: Axonometric of the existing mill.
Location map of the docks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座廢棄的大型麵粉廠閒置在倫敦東區的舊碼頭旁。專案把它轉化為都市垂直農場，既生產新鮮食物，也讓建築重新向大眾開放。
captions: 既有磨坊的軸測圖。
碼頭區位圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A strategy map links cultivation, education, business and environment into one loop. Rainwater and river water are filtered and stored to feed the planting.
captions: Strategy map of the farm.
Water circulation system.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 策略圖把種植、教育、商業與環境串成一個循環。雨水與河水經過過濾與儲存後，用來灌溉植栽。
captions: 垂直農場的策略圖。
水循環系統。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Staff routes, visitor routes and water pipes are layered through every floor. Each crop gets its own planting method, light level and growing equipment.
captions: Functional system of routes and water.
Planting types and equipment.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 員工動線、訪客動線與水管系統逐層穿過每一個樓層。每一種作物都有各自的種植方式、光照條件與栽培設備。
captions: 動線與水系統的功能分析。
植栽類型與設備。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Two long sections show the farm floors, gardens and water tanks working together inside the old frame. A physical model tests the new structure set into the existing mill.
captions: Long section one.
Long section two.
Physical model of the mill.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 兩張長剖面呈現農場樓層、花園與水箱如何在舊結構中協同運作。實體模型則檢驗新結構嵌入既有磨坊的方式。
captions: 長剖面一。
長剖面二。
磨坊的實體模型。

sections.heading: Urban Vertical Farm - A Disused Flour Mill Growing Again
sections.body: A large disused flour mill stands empty beside old docks on the east side of a city, and the project turns it into an urban vertical farm that grows fresh food while opening the building to the public. A strategy map links cultivation, education, business and environment into one loop, with rainwater and river water filtered and stored to feed the planting. Staff routes, visitor routes and water pipes are layered through every floor. Each crop, in turn, receives its own planting method, light level and growing equipment. Two long sections in the final work show farm floors, gardens and water tanks working together inside the old frame, and a physical model tests how the new structure sits within the existing mill. A building that once ground grain now cultivates it again, and the industrial shell recovers its breath, its floors filled with green rather than flour dust.

zh-Hant.heading: 都市垂直農場-讓廢棄麵粉廠重新生長
zh-Hant.body: 一座廢棄的大型麵粉廠，閒置在城市東區的舊碼頭旁；作品把它轉化為都市垂直農場，既生產新鮮食物，也讓建築重新向大眾開放。一張策略圖把種植、教育、商業與環境串成一個循環，雨水與河水經過濾與儲存後，用來灌溉植栽。員工動線、訪客動線與水管系統逐層穿過每一個樓層，每一種作物也都擁有各自的種植方式、光照條件與栽培設備。最終，兩張長剖面呈現農場樓層、花園與水箱如何在舊結構中協同運作，實體模型則檢驗新結構嵌入既有磨坊的方式。昔日研磨穀物的建築，如今重新培育糧食，工業的軀殼也因此恢復了呼吸。

pins.title: From Shelter to Community
pins.description:
A former airport refugee camp rethought as a lasting community.

Berlin, Germany | Architecture | Community housing | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 從庇護所到社區
zh-Hant.description:
把前機場的難民營重新思考為長久的社區。

德國柏林｜建築｜社區住宅｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Axonometric of the self-sustaining community around the terminal ring.
環繞航廈環形建築的自給社區軸測圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A closed city airport holds large empty halls and open land at the edge of Berlin. The project rethinks a temporary refugee camp there as a lasting community with homes, work and shared life.
captions: A timeline of migration waves that shaped Germany's multicultural society.
Current conditions in refugee camps: crowding, poor facilities and safety risks.
Site map and terrain studies.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座已關閉的城市機場在柏林邊緣留下大片空置的航廈與空地。專案把那裡的臨時難民營重新思考為一個長久的社區，結合住所、工作與共同生活。
captions: 塑造德國多元文化社會的移民潮年表。
難民營現況：擁擠、設施不足與安全風險。
基地地圖與地形分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Prefabricated modular homes are studied as a base unit that families can assemble quickly. Several plan types grow from single rooms to larger households over time.
captions: Modular house plan types.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究以預製模組住宅作為家庭可以快速組裝的基本單元。多種平面類型可以隨時間從單人房間擴展為較大的家庭住宅。
captions: 模組住宅的平面類型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The plans place a market, study areas, a public park, a church and a mosque inside and around the ring. Shared buildings use arches and domes to give each gathering place its own character.
captions: First and second floor plans.
Render of a domed prayer hall.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 平面在環形建築內外配置市集、學習區、公園、教堂與清真寺。公共建築以拱圈與圓頂，讓每一個聚集場所都有自己的性格。
captions: 一樓與二樓平面圖。
圓頂禮拜堂的渲染圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Two long sections show the craft workshops, homes and market stalls set under the old terminal roof. Physical models test the timber market frame and the stacked modular houses.
captions: Interior views of the handicraft area, the modular houses and the market.
Long section one.
Model of the market frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 兩張長剖面呈現手作工坊、住宅與市集攤位如何安置在舊航廈屋頂下。實體模型則檢驗木構市集框架與堆疊的模組住宅。
captions: 手工藝區、模組住宅與市集的室內透視。
長剖面一。
市集框架模型。

sections.heading: From Shelter to Community - A Lasting Home Beneath an Old Terminal Roof
sections.body: A closed city airport leaves vast empty halls and open land at the edge of a city, and the project rethinks the temporary refugee camp there as a lasting community of homes, work and shared life. Prefabricated modular homes were studied as a base unit that families can assemble quickly, with several plan types able to grow over time from single rooms to larger households. Inside and around the ring, the plans place a market, study areas, a public park, a church and a mosque. Arches and domes give each shared building and gathering place its own character. Two long sections in the final work show craft workshops, homes and market stalls set beneath the old terminal roof, while physical models test the timber market frame and the stacked modular houses. Temporary refuge is turned into rootedness here, and after displacement, everyday life is given a shape that can slowly accumulate, room by room and year by year.

zh-Hant.heading: 從庇護所到社區-舊航廈下長出的長久家園
zh-Hant.body: 一座已關閉的城市機場，在城市邊緣留下大片空置的航廈與空地；作品把那裡的臨時難民營，重新思考為結合住所、工作與共同生活的長久社區。研究以預製模組住宅作為家庭能快速組裝的基本單元，多種平面類型可隨時間從單人房間擴展為較大的家庭住宅。平面在環形建築內外配置市集、學習區、公園、教堂與清真寺，公共建築則以拱圈與圓頂，讓每一處聚集場所擁有自己的性格。最終，兩張長剖面呈現手作工坊、住宅與市集攤位如何安置於舊航廈屋頂之下，實體模型檢驗木構市集框架與堆疊的模組住宅。暫居由此轉化為扎根，流離之後，生活重新有了可以累積的形狀。

pins.title: Tangjia Bay Reborn
pins.description:
A mangrove reserve and shoreline museum that help an endangered seagrass recover.

Zhuhai, China | Landscape | Coastal restoration | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 唐家灣重生
zh-Hant.description:
以紅樹林保護區與海岸博物館協助瀕危海草復育。

中國珠海｜地景｜海岸復育｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Cutaway section of the shoreline museum among the mangroves.
紅樹林間海岸博物館的剖透視圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: An endangered seagrass along the shore of Tangjia Bay is fading under intensive human activity. The project restores the living shoreline with a mangrove reserve and a small public museum.
captions: Location map of the bay.
Analysis of the surrounding coast.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 唐家灣沿岸一種瀕危海草在密集的人為活動下逐漸消失。專案以紅樹林保護區與一座小型公共博物館，修復這條有生命的海岸線。
captions: 海灣區位圖。
周邊海岸分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: An ecological drawing maps how birds, fish, crabs and plants depend on the mangrove. Planting mangroves first is used to calm the water and hold sediment for the seagrass.
captions: Ecological relationship drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 生態關係圖描繪鳥類、魚類、螃蟹與植物如何依賴紅樹林。先種植紅樹林，可以讓水流趨緩並留住泥沙，為海草創造生長條件。
captions: 生態關係圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Curving paths and boardwalks thread through planted islands across the reserve. The museum sits at the edge with exhibition rooms, a café and open decks facing the water.
captions: Master plan axonometric.
Landscape plan of the reserve.
Museum floor plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 彎曲的步道與棧道穿梭在保護區的植栽島之間。博物館位於邊緣，配置展覽室、咖啡廳與面向水面的開放平台。
captions: 總體配置軸測圖。
保護區地景平面圖。
博物館平面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Sections compare the young saplings in the first year with a denser mangrove five years later. A physical model shows the timber roofs and boardwalks floating over the restored water.
captions: Sections in the first year and later.
Long section through the mangrove.
Physical model of the museum.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 剖面比較第一年剛種下的幼苗與五年後更茂密的紅樹林。實體模型呈現木構屋頂與棧道漂浮在修復後的水面上。
captions: 第一年與數年後的剖面。
穿越紅樹林的長剖面。
博物館的實體模型。

sections.heading: Bay Reborn - Restoring a Living Shoreline with Mangroves
sections.body: An endangered seagrass along the shore of a bay is fading under intensive human activity, and the project restores this living shoreline through a mangrove reserve and a small public museum. An ecological drawing maps how birds, fish, crabs and plants depend on the mangrove, and planting mangroves first is used to calm the water and hold sediment so the seagrass can recover. Curving paths and boardwalks thread through planted islands across the reserve. At its edge, the museum offers exhibition rooms, a café and open decks facing the water. Sections compare young saplings in the first year with a denser mangrove five years later, while a physical model shows timber roofs and boardwalks floating above the restored water. Time itself is written into the design, and restoration becomes a slow but steadfast act of growth, measured not in completion but in the patient thickening of roots.

zh-Hant.heading: 海灣重生-以紅樹林修復有生命的海岸
zh-Hant.body: 海灣沿岸一種瀕危的海草，在密集的人為活動下逐漸消失；作品以紅樹林保護區與一座小型公共博物館，修復這條有生命的海岸線。一張生態關係圖描繪鳥類、魚類、螃蟹與植物如何依賴紅樹林，而先種植紅樹林，可以讓水流趨緩並留住泥沙，為海草創造生長的條件。彎曲的步道與棧道穿梭於保護區的植栽島之間，博物館位於邊緣，配置展覽室、咖啡廳與面向水面的開放平台。最終的剖面比較第一年剛種下的幼苗與五年後更茂密的紅樹林，實體模型則呈現木構屋頂與棧道漂浮於修復後的水面。時間被納入設計之中，修復成為一場緩慢而堅定的生長。

pins.title: Urban Living Room
pins.description:
A district art museum extended and renovated as a living room for the city.

Shenzhen, China | Architecture | Museum renovation | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 城市客廳
zh-Hant.description:
把區級美術館擴建改造為城市的客廳。

中國深圳｜建築｜美術館改造｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Cutaway of the old and new galleries.
新舊展廳的剖透視圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A district art museum in dense Shenzhen mostly draws parents with young children and feels closed to the street. The project extends and renovates it as an urban living room for everyday public life.
captions: Cantonese opera venues and groups around the museum.
Axonometric of the existing building.
Site and context maps.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳高密度城區中的一座區級美術館，觀眾多為家長與幼童，對街道也顯得封閉。專案透過擴建與改造，把它變成服務日常公共生活的城市客廳。
captions: 博物館周邊的粵劇場館與團體。
既有建築的軸測圖。
基地與周邊脈絡圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Local opera groups, office workers, young people and older residents are studied as new audiences. The strategy links immersion, flexibility and activation through markets, a park and an outdoor theatre.
captions: Four user groups: families, youth, office workers and the elderly.
Museum activation strategy.
Early concept sketch.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究把在地戲曲團體、上班族、年輕人與年長居民視為新的觀眾。策略以市集、公園與戶外劇場，串連沉浸、彈性與活化三個目標。
captions: 四類使用者：家庭、青年、上班族與長者。
美術館活化策略。
早期概念草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The form grows from the existing block through an extension, a viewing platform and a sunken plaza. A green roof and a sloping garden route lift the public realm above the street.
captions: Form evolution diagrams.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 量體從既有建築出發，依序加入擴建、觀景平台與下沉廣場。綠色屋頂與坡道花園路徑，把公共空間抬升到街道之上。
captions: 量體演變圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Five gallery types range from the preserved old hall to a sculpture garden and an exploratory gallery. Calm classic rooms sit beside open and changing spaces so the museum serves many kinds of visits.
captions: The open plaza with an outdoor opera performance.
Render of a classic gallery.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 五種展廳類型，從保留的舊展廳到雕塑花園與探索式展廳。安靜的經典展室與開放多變的空間並置，讓美術館能容納各種參觀方式。
captions: 舉辦戶外粵劇演出的開放廣場。
經典展廳的渲染圖。

sections.heading: Urban Living Room - Opening a Closed Museum to Everyday Life
sections.body: A district art museum in a dense city draws mostly parents with young children and feels closed to the street, so the project extends and renovates it as an urban living room for everyday public life. Local opera groups, office workers, young people and older residents were studied as new audiences, and the strategy links immersion, flexibility and activation through markets, a park and an outdoor theatre. The form grows from the existing block through an extension, a viewing platform and a sunken plaza. A green roof and a sloping garden route lift the public realm above the street. Five gallery types then range from the preserved old hall to a sculpture garden and an exploratory gallery, setting calm classic rooms beside open, changing spaces so the museum can serve many kinds of visits. Art steps down from its pedestal here, becoming a living room the city can wander into at any hour.

zh-Hant.heading: 城市客廳-把封閉的美術館向日常敞開
zh-Hant.body: 高密度城區中的一座區級美術館，觀眾多為家長與幼童，對街道也顯得封閉；作品透過擴建與改造，把它變成服務日常公共生活的城市客廳。在地戲曲團體、上班族、年輕人與年長居民被視為新的觀眾，策略以市集、公園與戶外劇場，串連沉浸、彈性與活化三個目標。量體從既有建築出發，依序加入擴建、觀景平台與下沉廣場，綠色屋頂與坡道花園路徑把公共空間抬升到街道之上。最終，五種展廳從保留的舊展廳延伸到雕塑花園與探索式展廳，安靜的經典展室與開放多變的空間並置。藝術由此走出殿堂，成為城市生活裡可以隨意走進的客廳。

pins.title: House in Nesso
pins.description:
A lakeside house on a steep slope, shaped by climate simulations.

Nesso, Italy | Architecture | Climate-responsive house | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 內索湖畔住宅
zh-Hant.description:
一棟依氣候模擬塑形的陡坡湖畔住宅。

義大利內索｜建築｜氣候回應住宅｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Section showing sun paths and airflow through the house.
呈現日照與氣流穿越住宅的剖面圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A small single-family house sits on a steep slope above Lake Como in northern Italy. The brief asks how the form can answer the local climate instead of relying on machines.
captions: Local climate and lake breeze analysis.
Site location from region to slope.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一棟小型獨棟住宅，位於義大利北部科莫湖畔的陡坡上。設計題目是讓建築形體回應在地氣候，而不是依賴機械設備。
captions: 在地氣候與湖風分析。
從區域到坡地的基地位置圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Gable, flat and curved roofs in several orientations are tested with thermal simulations for the hottest and coldest days. An east-west gable roof gives the lowest indoor peak and becomes the base for a second round.
captions: First round of roof performance tests.
Second round comparing gable and hipped variants.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以熱環境模擬，在最熱與最冷的日子測試不同朝向的山牆屋頂、平屋頂與曲面屋頂。東西向山牆屋頂的室內峰值溫度最低，成為第二輪測試的基礎。
captions: 第一輪屋頂性能測試。
第二輪比較山牆與四坡屋頂變化。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Airflow simulations check how valley and lake breezes move around the chosen volume. Deep roof overhangs and solar panels on the roof and boundary walls are then tuned to the western sun.
captions: Airflow simulation around the house.
Second section through the slope.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 氣流模擬檢查山谷風與湖風如何繞過選定的量體。接著依西向日照調整深遠的屋簷，以及屋頂與邊牆上的太陽能板。
captions: 住宅周邊的氣流模擬。
穿越坡地的第二道剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The house turns west toward the lake and steps across three floors on the slope. Shading, cross-ventilation and solar energy work together to keep the rooms comfortable with less energy.
captions: Site plan.
Plans of the three floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 住宅面西朝向湖面，沿坡地分為三層。遮陽、對流通風與太陽能共同作用，以較少的能源維持室內舒適。
captions: 配置圖。
三個樓層的平面圖。

sections.heading: A House Above the Lake - Form Answering Climate Instead of Machines
sections.body: A small single-family house sits on a steep slope above a lake in northern Italy, and the brief asks how its form can answer the local climate rather than relying on machines. Thermal simulations for the hottest and coldest days tested gable, flat and curved roofs in several orientations, and an east-west gable roof produced the lowest indoor peak, becoming the base for a second round. Airflow simulations then checked how valley and lake breezes move around the chosen volume. Deep roof overhangs, along with solar panels on the roof and boundary walls, were tuned to the western sun. The finished house turns west toward the lake and steps across three floors on the slope, where shading, cross-ventilation and solar energy work together to keep the rooms comfortable with less energy. Data and landscape confirm each other here, and restraint itself becomes a quiet form of elegance.

zh-Hant.heading: 湖畔住宅-讓形體回應氣候而非機械
zh-Hant.body: 一棟小型獨棟住宅，坐落於義大利北部湖畔的陡坡上；設計題目要求建築形體回應在地氣候，而不是依賴機械設備。熱環境模擬在最熱與最冷的日子裡，測試不同朝向的山牆屋頂、平屋頂與曲面屋頂，東西向山牆屋頂的室內峰值溫度最低，成為第二輪測試的基礎。氣流模擬接著檢查山谷風與湖風如何繞過選定的量體，深遠的屋簷以及屋頂與邊牆上的太陽能板，則依西向日照加以調整。最終，住宅面西朝向湖面，沿坡地分為三層，遮陽、對流通風與太陽能共同作用，以較少的能源維持室內舒適。數據與風景在此彼此印證，節制成為一種優雅。

pins.title: Dongshan Bus Station
pins.description:
A small bus station with a folded canopy in an old Guangzhou quarter.
